detail.title: Developing Ethical AI: An Analysis about the Cause of AI Failing CSR and ESG when Being Adopted in the Decision-making Process in Companies

contentType.other: Research done during a Business Ethics and ESG class.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper was not sent to any journal or book.

detail.abstract: The world is highly relying on leveraging artificial tools in all the domains and notably in the business field. All firms use this technology to maximize their profits and meet their KPIs yearly. However, the AI dependency has obviously triggered CSR and ESG to investigate this phenomenon. Several ethical dilemmas have been highlighted, and discussion has given birth to multiple solutions and measures that should be taken to ensure that AI adhere to ethics and different stakeholders use it morally. Yet, the problem that arises is that machines are becoming increasingly autonomous and engineers are working on acquiring human neurological skills to these machines. Consequently, using these tools in the decision-making process is a threat for society by breaching human virtues.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨AI在商业领域的广泛应用如何引发伦理问题，特别是当AI系统获得自主决策能力时，可能威胁人类价值观和社会道德。研究分析了AI依赖与CSR/ESG框架之间的冲突，并提出确保AI符合伦理标准的解决方案。
AI.research_question: AI在商业决策中的自主性增强如何威胁人类价值观和社会道德，以及如何确保AI系统符合伦理标准？
AI.motivation: 企业普遍使用AI技术来最大化利润和实现KPI，但这种AI依赖引发了CSR和ESG框架的关注。随着AI系统变得越来越自主，甚至获得类似人类的神经技能，它们在决策过程中可能违反人类美德，对社会构成威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任(CSR)、环境社会治理(ESG)框架、AI伦理理论、利益相关者理论、技术伦理哲学
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，探讨AI伦理困境、现有解决方案，并分析AI自主性增强带来的新挑战
AI.findings: AI在商业中的广泛应用已引发多种伦理困境；现有讨论提出了确保AI符合伦理的解决方案；但AI自主性的增强和"人类神经技能"的获得使问题更加复杂，可能威胁人类价值观
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了CSR/ESG框架在AI伦理领域的应用；提出了AI自主性与人类价值观冲突的理论模型；丰富了技术伦理哲学在商业AI背景下的理论发展
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了AI伦理治理的实践指导；为政策制定者提出了监管AI自主决策的建议；为工程师开发符合伦理的AI系统提供了框架

title:
Sookshma: Intrinsic Governance and Obligational Compliance in the Age of AI 
A Framework for Preserving Truth in Long-Lived Digital Systems

detail.title:
Sookshma: Intrinsic Governance and Obligational Compliance in the Age of AI 
A Framework for Preserving Truth in Long-Lived Digital Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental subjects; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Modern digital systems operate at unprecedented scale and velocity, yet many struggle to retain institutional trust over time. Decisions that were correct when executed often become difficult to explain later. Exceptions are resolved, but the rationale disappears. Data is corrected, but history is silently rewritten. Governance exists, but largely outside the system-reconstructed after the fact through audits, reviews, and human interpretation.

This paper proposes Sookshma, a design framework for constructing systems in which governance and compliance are intrinsic properties of operation rather than external controls. Sookshma inverts the conventional model by embedding authority, intent, accountability, and rule applicability directly into system structure. Actions are treated as authorized expressions of intent; rules and obligations are explicit and versioned; events preserve contextual truth; and system behavior remains explainable through replay rather than post hoc inference.

The paper argues that this shift is increasingly critical in an AI-accelerated environment. As code, policies, and even narratives can now be generated and modified at scale, traditional governance and compliance mechanisms struggle to prevent silent drift, blurred authority, and erosion of truth. Sookshma treats obligational compliance-legal, regulatory, contractual, and policy - as a first-class design concern, binding external obligations explicitly to execution context and preserving that binding immutably.

Rather than prescribing tools or platforms, this work articulates a set of structural principles intended for long-lived enterprise and public-sector systems-systems expected to remain credible under scale, scrutiny, failure, and time. By making governance and compliance inseparable from execution, Sookshma aims to restore explainability, accountability, and institutional trust as systems evolve.

AI.tldr: Sookshma是一个设计框架，将治理和合规性作为系统运行的内在属性而非外部控制，通过嵌入权威、意图、问责和规则适用性来确保系统的可解释性、问责制和机构信任。
AI.research_question: 如何设计能够保持机构信任的数字系统，使治理和合规性成为系统运行的内在属性而非外部控制？
AI.motivation: 现代数字系统在规模和速度上达到前所未有的水平，但难以长期保持机构信任。决策执行时正确但事后难以解释，异常解决后原理消失，数据修正但历史被无声重写，治理主要存在于系统外部，通过审计、审查和人工解释进行事后重建。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理和合规性作为系统内在属性的设计框架；将权威、意图、问责和规则适用性直接嵌入系统结构；将义务性合规（法律、监管、合同和政策）作为首要设计关注点。
AI.method: 提出Sookshma设计框架，包含一系列结构原则：将行动视为授权的意图表达；规则和义务明确且版本化；事件保留上下文真实性；系统行为通过重放而非事后推断保持可解释性。
AI.findings: 通过将治理和合规性作为系统运行的内在属性，Sookshma框架能够恢复系统的可解释性、问责制和机构信任，特别是在AI加速环境中防止无声漂移、权威模糊和真相侵蚀。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将治理和合规性作为系统内在属性的新设计范式；发展了将外部义务明确绑定到执行上下文并不可变保存的理论框架；为长期企业级和公共部门系统的可信性提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建在规模、审查、故障和时间考验下保持可信性的系统提供了具体设计原则；使治理和合规性与执行不可分离，有助于防止AI加速环境中的治理失效；为恢复机构信任提供了可行的技术实现路径。

title: Collaborative Optimization of Battery Charging / Swapping Stations for Electric Vertical Take-off and Landing Aircraft Based on Closed-Loop Supply Chain and Space-Time Network
affiliations: Shanghai University of Electric Power, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shanghai University of Electric Power and University College London

detail.title: Collaborative Optimization of Battery Charging / Swapping Stations for Electric Vertical Take-off and Landing Aircraft Based on Closed-Loop Supply Chain and Space-Time Network
detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of the burgeoning global low-altitude economy, countries have successively introduced a series of policies to accelerate the application and commercialization of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. Nevertheless, purely electric eVTOLs confront constraints including limited battery energy density, high operational power requirements, and challenges associated with rapid energy replenishment, which collectively restrict their flight endurance and application scenarios. Furthermore, while eVTOL deployment is scaling up, supporting charging infrastructure and regulations remain underdeveloped. This situation presents emerging power distribution networks with new challenges in maintaining adequate electricity supply and ensuring operational continuity. To tackle these issues, following an investigation into battery energy replenishment strategies, a closed-loop supply chain-based model for eVTOL battery charging and swapping is proposed. Time-space network methods are utilized to characterize the scheduling of batteries and logistics throughout the system. Subsequently, aiming to maximize the operational revenue of the model, optimized management of battery swapping, transportation, and charging processes is implemented, facilitating coordinated operation among eVTOLs, swapping stations, and charging stations. Finally, the model is solved by Gurobi, verifying its feasibility. Simulation results further indicate that the model alleviates range anxiety for eVTOLs, offering strong support for their commercialization. Moreover, it enables coordinated scheduling between eVTOLs and the distribution network, thereby facilitating the network's gradual improvement and upgrading.

AI.tldr: 本文针对eVTOL飞机电池续航限制和充电基础设施不足的问题，提出了基于闭环供应链的电池充换电模型，通过时空网络方法优化电池调度，缓解续航焦虑并支持商业化应用。
AI.research_question: 如何解决eVTOL飞机因电池能量密度限制、高功率需求和快速能量补充挑战导致的续航限制问题，同时协调eVTOL与配电网的运营？
AI.motivation: 全球低空经济快速发展，eVTOL商业化面临电池续航限制、充电基础设施不足等挑战，现有配电网络难以满足eVTOL规模化部署的电力需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭环供应链理论、时空网络方法、优化调度理论
AI.method: 提出基于闭环供应链的eVTOL电池充换电模型，采用时空网络方法描述电池和物流调度，使用Gurobi求解器进行优化求解，通过仿真验证模型可行性。
AI.findings: 模型能有效缓解eVTOL的续航焦虑，支持其商业化应用；同时实现eVTOL与配电网的协调调度，促进电网逐步完善和升级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将闭环供应链理论应用于eVTOL电池管理领域；2) 提出基于时空网络的电池调度优化方法；3) 建立eVTOL与配电网协调调度理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为eVTOL运营商提供可行的电池充换电解决方案；2) 支持eVTOL商业化应用和规模化部署；3) 为配电网升级改造提供决策支持；4) 降低eVTOL运营成本和风险。

title: IoT Integration with Telecom: Challenges and Future Trends
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: IoT Integration with Telecom: Challenges and Future Trends
detail.abstract: This document reviews and analyzes the incorporation of the Internet of Things (IoT) within telecommunication networks. The document reviews the IoT and telecommunication networks convergence and analyzes the challenges faced during the integration of the two technologies. The challenges discussed are; gaps in the scalability and interoperability of networks, the security challenges of the IoT networks, and the other challenges in the infrastructure of the IoT technologies that impact the integration and management of the IoT networks and telecommunication networks convergence. This document summarizes the key trends that will affect the future of IoT within telecommunications networks. The authors assert that the roll-out of 5G technologies and the future 6G technologies will substantially improve the Internet of Things (IoT) by providing ultra-low latency, massive simultaneous connections, and higher communication bandwidth. The authors discuss the prospects of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the automation of management of IoT networks, security enhancement, and predictive maintenance. The authors discuss the impact of green IoT on the environment and the IoT networks and telecommunication networks in the reduction of energy and carbon emissions. The telecom sector's ever-growing challenges have potential solutions with the development of digital technology and improving telecom infrastructure. These enhancements will allow for sustained innovative growth in the integration of IoT. Enhanced IoT ecosystems will be more effective, resilient, and secure, allowing digital transformation of various sectors to be more rapidly accomplished.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了物联网与电信网络的融合，分析了整合过程中的挑战（可扩展性、互操作性、安全性、基础设施问题），并探讨了5G/6G、人工智能、绿色物联网等未来趋势对物联网发展的影响。
AI.research_question: 物联网与电信网络融合面临的主要挑战是什么？未来技术发展（如5G/6G、AI、绿色物联网）将如何影响物联网在电信网络中的整合与发展？
AI.motivation: 随着物联网技术的快速发展，其与电信网络的融合成为数字化转型的关键。然而，这种融合面临诸多挑战，需要系统分析以促进更有效的整合和未来发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术融合理论、网络可扩展性理论、网络安全框架、绿色信息技术理论
AI.method: 文献综述与分析：对物联网与电信网络融合的相关文献进行系统性回顾，分析整合过程中的技术挑战和未来趋势。
AI.findings: 主要挑战包括：网络可扩展性和互操作性差距、物联网网络安全问题、基础设施限制。未来趋势显示：5G/6G技术将提供超低延迟、海量连接和高带宽；AI将实现网络管理自动化、安全增强和预测性维护；绿色物联网将减少能源消耗和碳排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了物联网与电信网络融合的理论框架，提出了整合挑战的分类体系，构建了未来技术发展对物联网影响的分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信运营商和物联网服务提供商提供了整合挑战的实践指导；为技术开发者指明了5G/6G、AI和绿色物联网的发展方向；为政策制定者提供了促进数字化转型的参考依据。

title: Blockchain Applications in Secure Telecom Transaction
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Blockchain Applications in Secure Telecom Transaction
detail.abstract: Next-generation telecommunication networks have improved the speed and complexity of digital transactions. This has resulted in the amplification of telecom’s enduring issues of security, fraud, and transparency. Centre telecom operations have traditionally utilized a single centralized approach which struggles with multi stakeholder real-time confidence, and traceability in billing, identity systems, interoperability, and other management systems. The introduction of new technologies, such as blockchain, have the potential to change the way transactions are managed in telecom ecosystems. This piece of work uses a literature review of telecommunications and blockchain technologies that are peer-reviewed and seeks to construct recent technological and scholarly reviews to understand the dominant frameworks, fields of applications, and the performances of the reviewed frameworks and applications. With regards to the reviewed literature, the authors concluded that the telecom sector would benefit from the integration of blockchain technologies through the enhancement of transaction traceability, reduction of transactional fraud through the use of immutable ledgers, the application of smart contracts to automate processes, and the elimination of disputes through the reduction of manual processes. Furthermore, the authors stated that the blockchain model of decentralized trust reduces the dependency of telecom operators on central, predatory, and monopolistic intermediaries, making them more flexible and accountable to their customers (Pang et al., 2021; Li et al., 2022; Afraz et al., 2023). One of the key contributions of this paper is the integration of literature that supports the assertion that blockchain has the potential to serve as a primary technological building block for the telecommunications industry to achieve safe, real-time, and cost-effective transactions; however, it is emphasized that there are issues of high complexity of deployment, problems of systems interoperability, latency, costs, and so on that need to be resolved before the blockchain can be adopted on a large-scale basis (Chellvamathi and Kulkarni, 2023).

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述探讨区块链技术在电信行业的应用潜力，分析其如何通过不可篡改账本、智能合约等技术解决电信行业的安全、欺诈、透明度等问题，同时指出部署复杂性、系统互操作性等挑战。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术如何改变电信生态系统中的交易管理方式，以及其在解决电信行业安全、欺诈、透明度等长期问题方面的潜力和挑战？
AI.motivation: 新一代电信网络提高了数字交易的速度和复杂性，放大了电信行业长期存在的安全、欺诈和透明度问题。传统中心化电信运营方式在多利益相关方实时信任、计费可追溯性、身份系统、互操作性等方面存在不足，需要新的技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术的去中心化信任模型、不可篡改账本理论、智能合约自动化理论，以及电信生态系统中的交易管理理论。
AI.method: 采用文献综述方法，对电信和区块链技术的同行评审文献进行系统分析，构建技术和学术综述，理解主导框架、应用领域以及所评框架和应用的性能表现。
AI.findings: 电信行业将从区块链技术集成中受益：增强交易可追溯性、通过不可篡改账本减少交易欺诈、应用智能合约自动化流程、减少人工流程消除争议。去中心化信任模型减少电信运营商对中心化、掠夺性和垄断性中介的依赖，使其对客户更加灵活和负责。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合支持区块链作为电信行业主要技术构建块的文献；2. 提出区块链可作为实现安全、实时、成本效益交易的基础技术；3. 强调去中心化信任模型对电信生态系统的重要理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为电信运营商提供区块链集成的实际应用方向；2. 识别部署复杂性、系统互操作性、延迟、成本等实际挑战；3. 为大规模采用区块链技术前的关键问题解决提供指导。

title: Machine Learning for Predictive Maintenance in Telecom Equipment: Models, Architectures, and Operational Implications
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Machine Learning for Predictive Maintenance in Telecom Equipment: Models, Architectures, and Operational Implications
detail.abstract: Modern telecommunications infrastructure's complexity, heterogeneity, and scale contribute to increased equipment failure and operational cost, making traditional reactive and preventive maintenance strategies more difficult (Kommaragiri, 2021; Darwish, 2021). Consequently, the growing risk of equipment failure has created the need for ML-based predictive maintenance. This paper provides the first systematic review of machine learning applications for predictive maintenance in telecom equipment, including a comparison of supervised, unsupervised, and hybrid learning approaches (Carvalho et al., 2019; Murphy et al., 2023). The review assesses a variety of telecom applications including base stations, optical networks, and core telecom infrastructure, focusing on operational and economic impact, practical implementation, data input and model performance. Unplanned downtimes can be reduced by 20-40\% and maintenance costs can be lowered by 15-30\% through early fault detection and optimized asset utilization (Hegde & Varughese, 2022, Jabarullah 2022). ML-driven predictive maintenance has the potential to achieve these metrics and standards, yet challenges to be integrated and scaled in real world applications (data quality, model interpretability, legacy system integration, and real world solution scale) remain (Nurcahyanto et al., 2025). Most importantly, the study believes that machine learning is changing the paradigms of telecom maintenance from reactive to proactive models. Attaining the long lasting and large scale predictive maintenance models requires explainable machine learning, well structured data pathways, and data and operational focused adaptive frameworks (Çınar et al., 2020, Averineni, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文对电信设备预测性维护中的机器学习应用进行了首次系统性综述，比较了监督、无监督和混合学习方法，评估了基站、光网络和核心电信基础设施等应用场景，发现ML驱动的预测性维护可将非计划停机减少20-40%，维护成本降低15-30%。
AI.research_question: 机器学习在电信设备预测性维护中的应用现状、方法和效果如何？不同学习方法（监督、无监督、混合）在电信预测性维护中的表现和适用性是什么？
AI.motivation: 现代电信基础设施的复杂性、异构性和规模导致设备故障率上升和运营成本增加，传统反应性和预防性维护策略面临困难，需要ML驱动的预测性维护来降低设备故障风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习理论框架，包括监督学习、无监督学习和混合学习方法在预测性维护中的应用理论，以及从反应性维护向主动性维护范式转变的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，对机器学习在电信设备预测性维护中的应用进行综合分析，包括不同学习方法的比较、多种电信应用场景的评估，以及运营经济影响、实际实施、数据输入和模型性能的评估。
AI.findings: ML驱动的预测性维护可将非计划停机减少20-40%，维护成本降低15-30%；机器学习正在改变电信维护范式，从反应性转向主动性模型；但实际应用中仍面临数据质量、模型可解释性、遗留系统集成和规模化等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地综述了机器学习在电信设备预测性维护中的应用；建立了不同学习方法在电信维护场景下的比较框架；提出了从反应性到主动性维护的范式转变理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信运营商提供了ML预测性维护的实施指南和效益评估；识别了实际应用中的关键挑战和解决方案；提出了实现长期大规模预测性维护模型所需的可解释机器学习、结构化数据路径和适应性框架。

title: Cybersecurity Threats in Next Gen Telecom Networks
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cybersecurity Threats in Next Gen Telecom Networks
detail.abstract: This study examines the emerging landscape of cyber threats targeting next-generation telecommunication networks, including 5G, ITS 6G architectures, software-defined networking (SDN), and cloud-native telecom infrastructures. The study integrates recent industry and academic research to articulate major threat vectors, the principal structural weaknesses, and the systemic risks of network virtualization, artificial intelligence (AI), and high levels of device interconnectivity. The research employs a structured literature synthesis methodology alongside comparative threat analysis across primary telecom use cases, including critical infrastructure systems, autonomous systems, and cloud telecom operations. The results reflect that next-gen telecom networks provide unparalleled operational flexibility, performance, and scalability. However, the use of highly distributed architectures, AI-driven control and decision making, and distributed endpoint ecosystems increases the attack surface. Each of these characteristics increases the potential for supply chain compromise, manipulation of AI, signaling attacks, cross-layer vulnerabilities, etc. The study suggests that perimeter-based and static security models are insufficient for the rapidly changing and complex ecosystems of today's telecom environments. The study recommends security frameworks that are adaptive, AI-driven, and quantum-ready, specifically for the telecom network ecosystems (Srivastava and Koujalagi 2024; Pleshakova et al. 2024; Twum et al. 2025).

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了针对5G、6G、SDN和云原生电信基础设施等下一代电信网络的网络威胁格局，指出这些网络虽然提供了卓越的灵活性和性能，但分布式架构、AI控制和设备互联也扩大了攻击面，传统安全模型已不足够，需要自适应、AI驱动和量子就绪的安全框架。
AI.research_question: 下一代电信网络面临哪些主要网络威胁？这些威胁如何源于网络虚拟化、人工智能和高设备互联性等特性？需要什么样的安全框架来应对这些威胁？
AI.motivation: 随着5G、6G、SDN和云原生电信基础设施的快速发展，这些网络为关键基础设施、自动驾驶系统和云电信运营提供了前所未有的灵活性和性能，但同时也引入了新的安全风险。传统安全模型无法应对这些复杂、动态的威胁环境，因此需要系统性地分析威胁格局并制定相应的安全对策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络安全威胁分析框架、电信网络架构安全理论、AI安全理论、供应链安全理论、网络虚拟化安全理论
AI.method: 采用结构化文献综述方法，结合跨主要电信用例（关键基础设施系统、自动驾驶系统、云电信运营）的比较威胁分析
AI.findings:
1. 下一代电信网络提供了无与伦比的运营灵活性、性能和可扩展性
2. 高度分布式架构、AI驱动的控制决策和分布式终端生态系统扩大了攻击面
3. 这些特性增加了供应链妥协、AI操纵、信令攻击、跨层漏洞等风险
4. 基于边界和静态的安全模型对当今快速变化的复杂电信环境已不足够
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 系统性地识别和分类了下一代电信网络的主要威胁向量
2. 阐明了网络虚拟化、AI和高设备互联性等特性与安全风险之间的理论联系
3. 提出了针对电信网络生态系统的自适应安全框架理论
4. 为AI驱动和量子就绪的安全模型提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为电信运营商和网络提供商提供了具体的威胁识别指南
2. 推荐了适用于下一代电信网络的自适应、AI驱动和量子就绪的安全框架
3. 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了网络安全标准制定的参考依据
4. 为电信设备制造商和安全解决方案提供商提供了产品开发方向

Robin Garewal wrote this case solely to provide material for the class discussion. The author does not intend to illustrate either effective or ineffective handling of a managerial situation. The author may have disguised the name of the organization, certain names, and other identifying information to protect confidentiality.

A management policy FRAUD: The archaic yet steadfast belief in the 'art of sales', fraud can be committed at any time. Either with internal (one's team) or external customers. An intentional or unintentional action designed to provide the perpetrator with a gain or deny a right to a victim. Types of fraud in sales include falsifying data, breaching commitments made during the sales call, and presenting a forged purchase order. In all, such actions are unethical but also have a devastating effect on the team and organization. To explore further all three elements of the fraud triangle, if an organization or a team leader is aware of the prevailing conditions, it might help prevent falling into such a treacherous pit. THE D (triangle): Known criminologist Donald R. Cressy, in the 1970s, published a model called the 'fraud triangle.' Learning from the fraud triangle, developed by criminologist Donald Cressey, factors that cause people to commit fraud, especially in sales, are 1) Pressure, 2) Opportunity, and 3) Rationalization 4 Pressure Opportunity Rationalization.

AI.tldr: 该案例探讨销售欺诈问题，分析欺诈三角理论（压力、机会、合理化）在销售环境中的应用，旨在帮助管理者识别和预防销售团队中的欺诈行为。
AI.research_question: 在销售环境中，如何应用欺诈三角理论（压力、机会、合理化）来识别和预防销售团队中的欺诈行为？
AI.motivation: 销售欺诈对团队和组织具有破坏性影响，包括数据伪造、违背销售承诺、伪造采购订单等行为。管理者需要理解欺诈发生的条件，以便预防此类不道德行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于犯罪学家Donald Cressey在1970年代提出的欺诈三角理论，该理论认为欺诈行为由三个要素驱动：压力、机会和合理化。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，通过具体的管理情境分析，探讨销售欺诈的实际表现和预防策略。
AI.findings: 销售欺诈可以通过多种形式发生（内部/外部、有意/无意）。理解欺诈三角的三个要素（压力、机会、合理化）有助于组织识别潜在风险并采取预防措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典的欺诈三角理论应用于销售管理领域，扩展了该理论在商业环境中的应用范围，特别是针对销售团队的特殊情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了识别销售欺诈风险的具体框架，帮助组织建立预防机制，减少不道德行为对团队和组织的破坏性影响。

title: Digital Twin Technology in Network Design and Management
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Digital Twin Technology in Network Design and Management
detail.abstract: Digital twin (DT) technology is redefining the ways communication networks can be designed, operated, and managed. DTs allow for monitoring, analysis, and improvement of networks at any point in the network's lifecycle through the construction of replica networks. As networks become more sophisticated, more research and consideration is warranted for DT networks (DTNs) as the basis for smart network planning and self-managing systems (Barricelli et al.; Wu et al.; Mashaly). This research utilizes a systematized, literature-based analytical approach. It focuses on the peer-reviewed literature related to DTNs and surveys, in particular, the literature related to DTNs and surveys, in particular, the literature related to modeling, control loops, and integration of DTs, and real-world implementations of DTs. The works of recent authors in DT architectures, AI-enabled management, and the real-world implementations of DTs have been used to identify the trends, potential, and challenges of the chosen authors (Wu et al.; Almasan et al.; Khan et al.). The analysis shows that predictive network planning, real-time performance optimization, and closed-loop control are possible from the integration of sensing, analytics, and actuation within DTNs. Persistent challenges include network-wide scalability, high data-fidelity, and sustained synchronization between the physical and virtual components (Zhao et al.; Hui et al.; Poorzare et al.). DTN's influence on network planning and management is profound, especially in digital twin technology. However, for the construct to attain its operational best, issues of architecture, interoperability, and standardization of DTN are needed (Lin et al.; Wieme et al.).

AI.tldr: 数字孪生网络(DTNs)通过构建网络副本实现全生命周期监控、分析和优化，为智能网络规划和自主管理系统提供基础，但面临可扩展性、数据保真度和同步等挑战。
AI.research_question: 数字孪生网络(DTNs)如何影响通信网络的设计、运营和管理？其发展趋势、潜力和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着网络日益复杂，需要更多研究考虑将数字孪生网络作为智能网络规划和自主管理系统的基础，以重新定义通信网络的设计、运营和管理方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生技术理论、网络建模理论、控制循环理论、人工智能赋能管理理论、物理-虚拟系统集成理论。
AI.method: 系统化的文献分析方法，聚焦于DTNs相关的同行评审文献，特别调查建模、控制循环、DT集成以及实际实现等方面的文献。
AI.findings: 分析表明，通过将感知、分析和执行集成到DTNs中，可以实现预测性网络规划、实时性能优化和闭环控制。主要挑战包括全网可扩展性、高数据保真度以及物理与虚拟组件之间的持续同步。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了数字孪生网络的理论框架，整合了建模、控制循环和AI赋能管理等理论，为DTNs研究提供了系统的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了DTNs在实际应用中的趋势和潜力，为网络规划和管理提供了实践指导，同时指出了架构、互操作性和标准化等需要解决的实际问题。

title: Is the Endowment for Us?
affiliations: Northwestern law

detail.title: Is the Endowment for Us?
detail.abstract:
Recent crises-the pandemic, natural disasters, and political targeting-have caused enormous suffering, sparing no one, including charitable nonprofits. Charities have faced severe revenue losses, leading to reductions in programming, staff layoffs, and even bankruptcy. Amid these crises, significant sums have remained locked in endowments, unavailable to mitigate harms to charities, their beneficiaries, employees, and purposes, and ultimately the public. 

These rather inflexible restrictions raise serious questions about their justification. Were regulators right to remind charities that legal constraints on the use of endowment funds had to be observed? Even during the pandemic? Engaging decades of scholarly debate on the legal, economic, and moral justifications for restrictions on charitable assets, particularly endowment restrictions, this article uses recent crises as a stress test of charities law. 

The article largely rejects the arguments for granting charities unilateral ability to release restrictions, even during a crisis. Moreover, it shows that existing law almost always provides sufficient tools for charities to respond to needs. Properly understood, charities law requires charitable assets to remain devoted to their legally mandated purposes, even if advancing those purposes is at odds with the survival of any particular charity. Nevertheless, there are exceptions, including existential risks to charitable purposes and the sector more generally. The article concludes by considering whether recent political targeting of universities and foundations poses such risks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨慈善机构在危机期间动用受限捐赠基金的法律、经济和道德合理性，认为现有法律已提供足够应对工具，反对单方面解除限制，但承认存在例外情况。
AI.research_question: 在危机期间，慈善机构是否有权单方面解除捐赠基金的使用限制？现有法律框架是否足以应对危机需求？
AI.motivation: 近年来疫情、自然灾害和政治针对等危机导致慈善机构收入严重损失，而大量捐赠基金因限制无法动用，引发对限制合理性的质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数十年来关于慈善资产限制（特别是捐赠基金限制）的法律、经济和道德合理性学术辩论，将近期危机作为慈善法的压力测试。
AI.method: 理论分析，通过对现有法律框架的批判性审查，结合近期危机案例作为实证参考。
AI.findings: 1. 反对慈善机构单方面解除限制的能力，即使在危机期间；2. 现有法律几乎总是提供足够工具应对需求；3. 慈善资产必须继续用于法定目的，即使这与特定慈善机构的生存相冲突；4. 存在例外情况，如慈善目的和整个行业面临生存风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了慈善法中关于捐赠基金限制的理论基础，为危机时期的资产使用提供了法律框架，挑战了单方面解除限制的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为慈善机构、监管机构和捐赠者提供危机应对指南，强调现有法律工具的充分性，同时识别例外情况的处理原则。

title: Stress imaging arthrometry for assessing anterior talofibular ligament strain in-vivo
affiliations: London South Bank University, Maastricht University, German Sport University Cologne, affiliation not provided to SSRN, London South Bank University and London South Bank University

detail.title: Stress imaging arthrometry for assessing anterior talofibular ligament strain in-vivo
detail.abstract: Lateral ankle sprain is the most common musculoskeletal injury that happens as a result of excessive ankle joint supination and typically involves trauma to the anterior talofibular ligament (ATFL) due to over-elongation and exceeding its ultimate strain threshold. The purpose of this study is to present a novel in-vivo method for assessing ATFL strain within and beyond the normal kinematic range of ankle joint inversion. In addition, sex differences are investigated. The feet of 54 healthy participants (28f/26m; 18 to 40yrs) were fixated within a custom-made arthrometer and the ankle joint was passively rotated from 0° (neutral) to inversion angles of 5°, 10° and 20°. Electromyographic activity of the peroneus longus muscle was monitored to ensure passive ankle joint rotation. At each angle, ATFL length was imaged via B-mode ultrasound and calculated as the curved path between its enthesis points. Deformation was calculated relative to neutral position and expressed as strain (%). Both ATFL length and strain significantly increased with increasing ankle inversion (p<0.001) up to 20.9 mm and 7.8% at 20°, respectively. The ligament was significantly longer in males (20.0 vs 21.8 mm; p<0.01) but no sex differences in strain were evident across all angles. These findings support the notion that high ankle joint inversion places a substantial mechanical demand on the ATFL and suggest that stress imaging arthrometry could be a valuable tool for the early detection of ligament overuse injuries and objective assessment of rehabilitation effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种新的体内方法来评估踝关节内翻时距腓前韧带（ATFL）的应变，并调查性别差异。结果显示ATFL长度和应变随内翻角度增加而显著增加，男性韧带更长但应变无性别差异。
AI.research_question: 1. 如何开发一种新的体内方法来评估踝关节内翻时距腓前韧带（ATFL）的应变？2. ATFL应变在正常和超出正常运动范围的踝关节内翻角度下如何变化？3. ATFL应变是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 踝关节外侧扭伤是最常见的肌肉骨骼损伤，通常涉及距腓前韧带（ATFL）因过度伸长而损伤。目前缺乏有效的体内方法来评估ATFL在踝关节内翻时的应变，这对于早期检测韧带过度使用损伤和客观评估康复效果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物力学和运动医学理论，特别是韧带应变与关节角度关系的生物力学原理，以及性别差异在解剖结构和损伤风险中的潜在影响。
AI.method: 采用定制关节测量仪对54名健康参与者（28女/26男；18-40岁）进行被动踝关节内翻（0°、5°、10°、20°）。使用B型超声成像测量ATFL长度，计算相对于中立位的应变（%）。监测腓骨长肌肌电活动以确保被动旋转。
AI.findings: 1. ATFL长度和应变随踝关节内翻角度增加而显著增加（p<0.001），在20°时分别达到20.9 mm和7.8%。2. 男性ATFL显著更长（20.0 vs 21.8 mm；p<0.01），但所有角度下的应变均无性别差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了高踝关节内翻对ATFL产生显著机械负荷的理论假设。2. 建立了ATFL应变与踝关节内翻角度的定量关系。3. 揭示了ATFL长度存在性别差异但应变无性别差异的重要发现。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了一种新的应力成像关节测量方法，可用于早期检测韧带过度使用损伤。2. 为客观评估康复效果提供了量化工具。3. 为预防踝关节扭伤和制定个性化康复方案提供了科学依据。

title: Drivers of Patients’ Intention To Use Digital Serious Games in Psoriatic Arthritis Care
affiliations: University of Lisbon, University of Lisbon, Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus Medical Center (MC), Albert Schweitzer Hospital, University of Oxford - Nuffield Department of Orthopaedics, Rheumatology and Musculoskeletal Sciences (NDORMS), NOVA University Lisbon, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki - Fourth Department of Internal Medicine, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and Khalifa University

detail.title: Drivers of Patients’ Intention To Use Digital Serious Games in Psoriatic Arthritis Care
detail.abstract: Digital serious games (SGs) are emerging tools for chronic disease self‑management, yet their adoption among people with psoriatic arthritis (PsA) remains unknown. This lack of evidence on what drives SG uptake limits the design of interventions patients will actually use. Here we examined whether interaction technology in SGs shapes PsA patients’ enjoyment and intention to use SGs by mediating the effects of core serious and game design elements. Data from a cross‑sectional web‑based survey across four European countries (n=381 PsA patients) were analysed with a hybrid structural equation modelling framework to test the hypothesised pathways. Bootstrapped path coefficients (0.133–0.864; all p<0.001) and adjusted R² (up to 0.863), supported all associations. Interaction technology emerged as the central mediator, linking serious and game elements to enjoyment and, most strongly, to intention to use SGs. Reliability, validity, effect sizes, predictive relevance, and subgroup invariance were also confirmed. Interaction technology drives SG engagement, showing that therapeutic content must be paired with engaging interactive features for personalised PsA self‑management.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现互动技术是数字严肃游戏在银屑病关节炎患者中采纳的关键中介因素，将严肃内容和游戏元素与使用意愿联系起来
AI.research_question: 互动技术是否通过中介严肃内容和游戏设计元素的效果，来塑造银屑病关节炎患者对严肃游戏的享受和使用意愿？
AI.motivation: 数字严肃游戏是慢性病自我管理的新兴工具，但银屑病关节炎患者对其采纳情况未知，缺乏驱动采纳的证据限制了设计患者实际会使用的干预措施
AI.theoretical_framework: 严肃游戏设计理论、技术接受模型、互动技术中介作用框架
AI.method: 横断面网络调查（欧洲四国381名银屑病关节炎患者），采用混合结构方程建模框架，使用自助法路径系数检验假设路径
AI.findings: 互动技术是核心中介因素，连接严肃和游戏元素与享受感，特别是与严肃游戏使用意愿的关联最强；所有关联均得到支持（路径系数0.133-0.864，p<0.001；调整R²最高0.863）
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了互动技术在严肃游戏采纳中的核心中介作用，扩展了技术接受理论在医疗游戏领域的应用，为严肃游戏设计提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为银屑病关节炎自我管理游戏设计提供指导：治疗内容必须与吸引人的互动功能结合；验证了可靠性、效度、效应大小、预测相关性和亚组不变性

title: AI-Powered Network Optimization in Telecommunication Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI-Powered Network Optimization in Telecommunication Systems
detail.abstract: The rapid development of 5G technology and the introduction of 6G networks have created new types of complexity, including heterogeneous service offerings and dynamic traffic patterns. These developments have exposed severe shortcomings in traditional, rule-based, and optimization-centered approaches to network management. Operational methods focused on the management of networks show a lack of adaptability, efficiency, and resilience during highly variable periods of operation, which leads to suboptimal use of network resources and excessive management of operational overhead. This study reviews the positive impact of artificial intelligence (AI) as an enabler for optimization in next generation telecom networks. The methodology employs a unique structured synthesis of the empirical literature, combined with architectural research and performance evaluation of AI-based optimization models. Various optimization techniques in artificial intelligence, such as optimization through machine learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning, are used for assessment of the primary network functions based on the validated outcomes of the most recent studies. The research is directed towards the demonstration of the capacity of artificial intelligence models as opposed to traditional models in a multitude of network scenarios. The results showed that the use of AI-based methods increases efficiency in the areas of allocation of resources, proactive fault detection, adaptive traffic control, and overall network resilience. These improvements are noted in all network layers and use cases showing the ability of the AI to learn, predict, and improve in real time. The study concludes that optimization through AI tools is an emerging fundamental change, rather than a change of degree, for 5G and 6G systems. However, the challenges of governance, scalability and deployment in telecom ecosystems need to be addressed in order to realize such a potential.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了AI在5G/6G网络优化中的应用，通过结构化文献综合和性能评估，证明AI方法在资源分配、故障检测、流量控制和网络弹性方面优于传统方法，但面临治理、可扩展性和部署挑战。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何作为优化使能器在下一代电信网络中发挥作用？与传统方法相比，AI模型在各种网络场景中的性能表现如何？
AI.motivation: 5G技术快速发展和6G网络引入带来了异构服务提供和动态流量模式等新型复杂性，传统基于规则和优化为中心的网络管理方法在适应性、效率和弹性方面存在严重不足，导致网络资源利用次优和运营开销过大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能优化理论，包括机器学习、深度学习和强化学习等AI优化技术，应用于网络功能优化；网络管理理论；电信网络架构理论。
AI.method: 采用独特的结构化文献综合方法，结合架构研究和AI优化模型的性能评估；基于最新研究的验证结果，评估AI优化技术在主要网络功能中的应用。
AI.findings: AI方法在资源分配、主动故障检测、自适应流量控制和整体网络弹性方面提高了效率；这些改进在所有网络层和用例中都得到体现，展示了AI实时学习、预测和改进的能力；AI优化是5G/6G系统的根本性变革而非程度性改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AI在电信网络优化中的理论框架；证明了AI优化相对于传统方法的理论优势；为AI驱动的网络管理提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信运营商提供了AI优化的实用指导；展示了AI在资源分配、故障检测、流量控制等具体网络功能中的应用价值；指出了实现AI优化潜力需要解决的治理、可扩展性和部署挑战。

title: Behavioral Interventions for Waste Reduction: A Systematic Review of Experimental Studies
affiliations: University of California San Diego, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), Anderson School of Management, Students and UCLA Institute of the Environment and Sustainability

detail.title: Behavioral Interventions for Waste Reduction: A Systematic Review of Experimental Studies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by the California Air Resources Board (Contract 20RD008)

detail.abstract: Wasteful behavior poses major environmental, economic, and social challenges, yet the behavioral science literature on waste reduction remains fragmented. This systematic review synthesizes 99 experimental and quasi-experimental studies published between 2017 and 2021 that test behavioral interventions to reduce waste. This period captures a critical phase when global waste management systems faced unprecedented disruptions, including the 2017 launch of China's National Sword policy, which dramatically reshaped global recycling markets and exposed critical weaknesses in international waste systems. We adopt a broad definition of waste-including both discarded materials (e.g., food, trash, recyclables) and inefficient resource use (e.g., electricity, water, fuel)to better capture the full range of behaviors where interventions can reduce environmental impact and allow cross-domain comparisons. Our goal is to examine the behavioral interventions used, how interventions are structured, how behavior is measured, and whether they target individuals, households, communities, or broader systems. We identify six common types of behavioral interventions: education/informational feedback, social norms, economic incentives, cognitive biases and choice architecture, goal setting, and emotional appeals. Interventions targeting electricity and water use were most common, while food and solid waste remain under studied, largely due to measurement challenges. Although most studies used real-world field designs with direct behavioral outcomes, they focused heavily on individual and household behavior. This individual focus risks overlooking the structural and systemic changes needed to achieve broader, sustained reductions in waste. To advance the field, we call for greater use of community-level and system-wide interventions, investment in scalable measurement tools, and stronger collaboration between researchers, governments, and practitioners. Building on this foundation can help create more effective, scalable strategies to reduce waste across behavioral contexts.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述分析了2017-2021年间99项关于减少浪费行为干预的实验研究，识别了六类常见干预措施，发现研究过度关注个体行为而忽视系统变革，呼吁加强社区和系统层面的干预。
AI.research_question: 在减少浪费的行为干预研究中，使用了哪些类型的干预措施？这些干预措施如何构建？行为如何测量？干预针对的是个体、家庭、社区还是更广泛的系统？
AI.motivation: 浪费行为带来严重的环境、经济和社会挑战，但行为科学关于减少浪费的研究仍然分散。2017年中国"国剑政策"等全球性事件暴露了国际废物管理系统的脆弱性，需要系统梳理行为干预的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为科学理论，包括社会规范理论、认知偏差理论、选择架构理论、目标设定理论等，为理解浪费行为提供了理论基础。
AI.method: 系统综述方法，分析2017-2021年间发表的99项实验和准实验研究，采用广泛的浪费定义（包括废弃材料和资源低效使用）。
AI.findings: 识别了六类常见行为干预：教育/信息反馈、社会规范、经济激励、认知偏差与选择架构、目标设定、情感诉求。电力和水资源干预最常见，食物和固体废物研究不足。大多数研究采用现实世界实地设计，但过度关注个体和家庭层面。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了分散的浪费减少行为干预研究，提出了跨领域比较的分析框架，识别了研究空白和理论局限性，特别是对系统层面变革的忽视。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供了行为干预的分类框架，指出了需要加强社区和系统层面干预，呼吁投资可扩展的测量工具，促进研究者、政府和从业者之间的合作。

title: Feed input investment, grazing management and milk performance in family-based mountain dairy goat systems in Kabylia, Algeria
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Feed input investment, grazing management and milk performance in family-based mountain dairy goat systems in Kabylia, Algeria
detail.abstract: Goat farming is a cornerstone of rural livelihoods in the mountainous region of Kabylia (Tizi-Ouzou and Bejaia, Algeria), where family-based systems depend mainly on natural rangelands, complemented by purchased feeds. This study had two objectives: first, to build a typology of goat farms based on their level of feed input investment, and second, to assess how this investment is linked to grazing practices and milk performance. We surveyed 178 farms using a structured questionnaire that captured socio-economic features, herd management, feeding practices, feed expenditure and milk yield. Feed investment profiles were derived through principal component analysis followed by Ward’s hierarchical clustering, and the determinants of investment level were explored using a mixed-effects ordinal logistic regression model. Four clearly distinct profiles emerged-Low, Medium, High and Very High feed investment-which differed markedly in herd size, daily grazing time, concentrate allocation, feed expenditure and milk yield (P < 0.0001). Farms in the Medium group produced 553 Liter/goat/lactation at a feed cost of 12,291 Algerian Dinars (AD)/goat, a performance comparable to that of the Very High group (562 L, 82,537 AD/goat), highlighting the strong efficiency of combining extended grazing (~6 hour/day) with moderate supplementation (~340 grammes/head/day). The ordinal regression indicated negative associations of feed investment with herd size and daily grazing time, whereas households whose main activity was commerce were more likely to belong to higher investment categories (P < 0.05). Natural rangelands remained the backbone of feeding strategies in all profiles. Overall, the results show that economic performance in mountain dairy goat systems is driven less by maximal concentrate use than by optimising rangeland utilisation through targeted, cost-effective supplementation, and they argue in favour of policies that focus on rangeland management, technical training and better organisation of input and product value chains rather than on blanket concentrate subsidies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过阿尔及利亚卡比利亚山区178个山羊养殖场的调查，建立了基于饲料投入水平的农场分类，发现中等饲料投入组通过延长放牧时间（约6小时/天）与适度补充饲料（约340克/头/天）相结合，实现了与高投入组相似的产奶量但成本显著降低，表明优化牧场利用比最大化精料使用更能提升经济效益。
AI.research_question: 山羊养殖场的饲料投入水平如何分类？这些投入水平与放牧实践和产奶性能有何关联？
AI.motivation: 阿尔及利亚卡比利亚山区山羊养殖是农村生计的重要支柱，家庭养殖系统主要依赖天然牧场并辅以购买饲料。需要了解不同饲料投入策略对养殖绩效的影响，为制定有效的农业政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农场分类理论（typology）和投入产出效率分析框架，结合资源优化配置和可持续农业管理理论。
AI.method: 对178个农场进行结构化问卷调查，收集社会经济特征、畜群管理、饲养实践、饲料支出和产奶量数据。采用主成分分析和Ward层次聚类建立饲料投入分类，使用混合效应序数逻辑回归模型分析投入水平的决定因素。
AI.findings: 识别出四种明显不同的饲料投入类型：低、中、高和非常高投入。中等投入组每头山羊产奶553升/哺乳期，饲料成本12,291阿尔及利亚第纳尔，与非常高投入组（562升，82,537第纳尔）表现相当，表明延长放牧时间（约6小时/天）与适度补充饲料（约340克/头/天）相结合具有高效性。饲料投入与畜群规模和每日放牧时间呈负相关，而以商业为主要活动的家庭更可能属于高投入类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于饲料投入水平的山羊养殖场分类框架，揭示了在山区乳山羊系统中，经济效益主要来自优化牧场利用而非最大化精料使用，挑战了传统的高投入高产出假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体建议：应重点关注牧场管理、技术培训和优化投入品及产品价值链组织，而非提供统一的精料补贴。为养殖户提供了成本效益优化的饲养策略参考。

title: Gripezinha: Evidence for retrospective voting amid government misinformation
affiliations: University of Zurich and University of Reading

detail.title: Gripezinha: Evidence for retrospective voting amid government misinformation
detail.abstract: Retrospective voting underpins electoral accountability. However, recent research shows that false beliefs rooted in misinformation may obstruct retrospective voting. We therefore ask: Does retrospective voting work in a context of widespread misinformation? We address this question through the lens of the Covid-19 pandemic in Brazil. Jair Bolsonaro, president at the time, ran a massive misinformation campaign about Covid-19, coining the myth of “Gripezinha” (Engl.: small flu) – with fatal consequences. We show that voters with a larger propensity to be exposed to information about the true state of the world punished Bolsonaro more in the 2022 Presidential Election. We measure information exposure by spatial proximity to hospitals with more intensive care units (ICUs). The severity of the pandemic and the breakdown of the healthcare system became salient in those locations. The effect is sizeable: If information exposure had been 5 points lower (on a 10-point scale), the election result would have been flipped.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨在广泛错误信息背景下，选民是否仍能基于过往表现进行投票（追溯性投票）。通过分析巴西新冠疫情和博索纳罗的"小流感"错误信息运动，研究发现接触真实世界信息越多的选民（通过ICU床位密度衡量）在2022年大选中对博索纳罗的惩罚越严厉，信息接触程度足以影响选举结果。
AI.research_question: 在广泛错误信息的背景下，追溯性投票是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: 追溯性投票是选举问责的基础，但最近的错误信息研究表明，基于错误信息的虚假信念可能阻碍追溯性投票。巴西新冠疫情提供了一个理想的研究背景，因为博索纳罗总统发起了大规模的"小流感"错误信息运动，导致了致命后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 追溯性投票理论、选举问责理论、错误信息对民主决策的影响理论、空间信息暴露理论
AI.method: 利用巴西新冠疫情作为自然实验，通过空间接近性（与拥有更多ICU床位的医院的距离）来衡量选民接触真实世界信息的程度，分析这种信息暴露如何影响2022年总统选举中对博索纳罗的投票惩罚。
AI.findings: 接触真实世界信息程度越高的选民（通过ICU床位密度衡量）在2022年总统选举中对博索纳罗的惩罚越严厉。如果信息暴露程度降低5个百分点（在10分制上），选举结果将会翻转，这表明信息暴露对选举结果有实质性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在错误信息广泛存在的背景下验证了追溯性投票理论的适用性；2. 提出了通过空间信息暴露衡量选民接触真实信息程度的新方法；3. 展示了即使在系统性错误信息运动中，真实世界信息仍能影响选举问责。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于错误信息对民主问责影响的经验证据；2. 强调了公共卫生危机中信息透明度的重要性；3. 为选举策略提供了关于信息暴露与投票行为关系的洞见；4. 展示了空间因素如何通过信息渠道影响政治结果。

title: Electoral Neutrality and the Incumbency Paradox: Executive Power, Appointment Authority, and the Subversion of Political Rights in Uganda
affiliations: We Care Legal Aid Agency

detail.title: Electoral Neutrality and the Incumbency Paradox: Executive Power, Appointment Authority, and the Subversion of Political Rights in Uganda
detail.abstract: Electoral neutrality is frequently treated as an administrative or procedural concern, reducible to polling-day conduct and the technical competence of electoral management bodies. This paper rejects that narrow framing and instead conceptualizes electoral neutrality as a structural and constitutional question grounded in power, institutional design, and human rights. Using Uganda as a case study, and engaging constitutional provisions, electoral legislation, international and regional human rights treaties, and Supreme Court jurisprudence, the paper argues that where an incumbent executive remains in office throughout the electoral cycle while retaining decisive appointment authority over electoral institutions and security forces, neutrality becomes largely illusory. Executive dominance constitutionalizes incumbency advantage and normalizes elections that are formally lawful yet substantively compromised. The paper concludes that without a redistribution of executive power and a reconfiguration of appointment regimes, electoral processes may satisfy procedural legality while violating the deeper human rights norms of political equality, participation, and democratic selfdetermination.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将选举中立性简化为行政或程序问题的传统观点，认为选举中立性是一个涉及权力、制度设计和人权的结构性宪法问题。以乌干达为例，研究发现当现任行政长官在整个选举周期中保持职位并保留对选举机构和安全部队的决定性任命权时，中立性基本是虚幻的。行政主导将现任优势宪法化，使形式上合法但实质上受损的选举正常化。
AI.research_question: 选举中立性是否仅仅是一个行政或程序问题？在现任行政长官在整个选举周期中保持职位并保留对选举机构和安全部队决定性任命权的情况下，选举中立性如何实现？
AI.motivation: 传统上选举中立性被简化为投票日行为和选举管理机构的技术能力问题，这种狭隘框架忽视了选举中立性的结构性、宪法性和权力维度。需要重新概念化选举中立性，将其视为涉及权力分配、制度设计和人权保障的根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 选举中立性的结构性宪法理论；2. 权力分配与制度设计理论；3. 人权理论（政治平等、参与、民主自决）；4. 行政主导与选举公正性理论
AI.method: 案例研究法（乌干达），分析宪法条款、选举立法、国际和区域人权条约、最高法院判例，采用法律分析和制度分析相结合的方法
AI.findings: 1. 当现任行政长官在整个选举周期中保持职位并保留对选举机构和安全部队的决定性任命权时，选举中立性基本是虚幻的；2. 行政主导将现任优势宪法化；3. 导致形式上合法但实质上受损的选举正常化；4. 仅满足程序合法性而违反更深层次的人权规范
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将选举中立性从行政/程序问题重新概念化为结构性宪法问题；2. 建立了权力、制度设计与选举中立性的理论联系；3. 提出了"宪法化现任优势"的理论概念；4. 区分了程序合法性与实质性人权规范的选举评估框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出需要重新分配行政权力和重新配置任命制度；2. 为选举改革提供制度设计建议；3. 为国际选举观察和人权评估提供分析框架；4. 为民主巩固国家的宪法改革提供参考

title: Health Policy Responses To Pandemic Preparedness And Resilience
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Health Policy Responses To Pandemic Preparedness And Resilience
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic revealed the deep-seated weaknesses in the global health systems and also reinstated the importance of preparedness and resilience as the policy priorities in addressing future health emergencies. In various parts of the world and on both low-cost and high-cost pillars, inconsistent response capacities, disrupted core services, and continued imbalances outlined the extent of responsive measures and instilled stress on forward-looking and long-term policy frameworks (Sundarararam et al., 2021; Haldane et al., 2021). It is within this backdrop that this research study will analyze how the design and implementation of health policies determine the preparedness and resilience during pandemics in various settings. In methodology, the paper takes the form of a systematic policy analysis along with a critical review of the world and regional empirical evidence, relying on comparative research, international documents, and scholarly publications to uncover recurrent patterns and determinants of policies (Mustafa et al., 2022; Maccaro et al., 2023). The analysis indicates that the quality of governance, the sustainability of health financing, and policy decisions based on equity remain the decisive issues contributing to resilient reaction to pandemics affecting coordination, trust, and coverage of services (Sagan et al., 2021; Alberti et al., 2020). Meanwhile, the evidence points to the continued fragmentation of policies, the lack of adequate intersequestration, and considerable gaps in implementation that traverse across a low-, middle-, and high-income context, and worsen preparedness, even in a setting where there are formal strategies and plans in place (Radford et al., 2024; Chavez et al., 2025). The research finds that it is not possible to maintain pandemic resilience only with technical capacity, but adaptive, equity-based, and learning-based health policies are needed that institutionalise accountability, bring evidence into decision-making, and focus on vulnerable groups. These policy orientations are essential to make preparedness commitments translate into functional and long-term level resiliency to future outbreaks associated with pandemics (Okyere et al., 2024; Lal et al., 2022).

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了卫生政策设计与实施如何影响不同环境下应对大流行病的准备和韧性。研究发现，治理质量、卫生融资可持续性和基于公平的政策决策是决定大流行应对能力的关键因素，而政策碎片化、部门间协调不足和实施差距则削弱了准备能力。
AI.research_question: 卫生政策的设计和实施如何决定不同环境下应对大流行病的准备和韧性？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行暴露了全球卫生系统的深层次弱点，突显了准备和韧性作为应对未来卫生紧急事件政策优先事项的重要性。全球各地在应对能力、核心服务中断和持续不平衡方面的问题，凸显了需要分析政策如何影响大流行应对能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于卫生系统韧性理论、政策分析框架和公平性理论，强调治理、融资和公平决策在构建卫生系统韧性中的核心作用。
AI.method: 采用系统性政策分析和批判性文献综述方法，结合比较研究、国际文件和学术出版物，揭示政策模式和决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 治理质量、卫生融资可持续性和基于公平的政策决策是决定大流行应对能力的关键因素；2. 政策碎片化、部门间协调不足和实施差距普遍存在，削弱了准备能力；3. 仅靠技术能力无法维持大流行韧性，需要适应性、基于公平和学习型的卫生政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了卫生系统韧性理论，强调政策设计在构建韧性中的核心作用；2. 提出了适应性、公平性和学习型政策框架；3. 丰富了政策实施与韧性关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了构建大流行韧性的具体政策方向；2. 强调了将问责制制度化、基于证据决策和关注弱势群体的重要性；3. 为不同收入水平国家提供了改善准备和韧性的实践指导。

title: Paradigm Shift from Territory to Connectivity: Introducing Corridor Economics and Its Contributions
affiliations: and University of Isfahan

detail.title: Paradigm Shift from Territory to Connectivity: Introducing Corridor Economics and Its Contributions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Conflict of Interest has been reported

detail.abstract: This paper offers Corridor Economics as a new way of understanding how contemporary economic corridors operate in the global system. Rather than viewing corridors only as physical infrastructure projects designed to move goods more efficiently, the paper argues that they have increasingly become institutional and monetary spaces where new forms of economic coordination are being tested. Corridors such as the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC), the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), etc. are not merely transport routes; they are emerging platforms for digital payments, alternative settlement mechanisms, and corridor-based governance. This shift reflects broader structural changes, including the expansion of South-South cooperation, the rapid digitization of financial systems, and the gradual weakening of dollar-centered monetary arrangements, particularly within multipolar groupings such as BRICS. On this basis, the paper introduces two theoretical innovations. The first is the Asymmetric Distance Optimum Currency Area (ADOCA) model, which revisits Robert Mundell's classical OCA (Optimum Currency Area) framework by moving beyond its emphasis on geographic proximity. Instead, it highlights the role of corridor connectivity, institutional coordination, and technological integration in shaping monetary compatibility. The second is the Ideal Global Currency (IGC) framework, inspired by John Nash's idea of Ideal Money. The IGC does not seek to replace national currencies, but rather envisions digitally anchored, corridor-based units of account that can support cross-border trade while improving stability, lowering transaction costs, and preserving monetary sovereignty. Methodologically, the paper follows a theoretical and conceptual approach. It brings together insights from monetary theory, institutional economics, digital finance, and geoeconomics, and draws on policy documents, corridor initiatives, and emerging payment systems such as CBDCs and BRICS Pay. This allows the study to show how corridors are increasingly functioning as institutional ecosystems rather than as simple trade channels. The paper makes four main contributions: it conceptualizes Corridor Economics as a distinct analytical field; it reformulates OCA theory through the ADOCA model; it translates Nash's Ideal Money into an operational framework through the IGC; and it questions the long-standing assumption that monetary integration must be based on territorial proximity or political unification. In doing so, it advances a post-territorial understanding of monetary integration grounded in connectivity, institutional trust, and digital interoperability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"走廊经济学"作为理解当代经济走廊在全球体系中运作的新视角。走廊不仅是物理基础设施项目，更成为制度与货币空间，测试新型经济协调形式。文章引入ADOCA模型和IGC框架，挑战传统货币一体化基于地理邻近的假设，推进基于连接性、制度信任和数字互操作性的后领土货币一体化理解。
AI.research_question: 当代经济走廊如何在全球体系中运作？它们如何从单纯的运输路线转变为制度与货币空间？走廊在塑造新型经济协调、数字支付和替代结算机制方面扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将经济走廊视为物理基础设施项目，但现实中走廊已演变为制度与货币空间，测试新型经济协调形式。这一转变反映了南南合作扩大、金融系统快速数字化、美元中心货币安排逐渐弱化等结构性变化，需要新的理论框架来理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 走廊经济学作为分析框架；2. 非对称距离最优货币区(ADOCA)模型，修正蒙代尔的OCA理论；3. 理想全球货币(IGC)框架，基于纳什的理想货币概念；4. 结合货币理论、制度经济学、数字金融和地缘经济学。
AI.method: 理论概念研究方法，整合货币理论、制度经济学、数字金融和地缘经济学的见解，分析政策文件、走廊倡议和新兴支付系统（如CBDC和BRICS Pay）。
AI.findings: 经济走廊正从简单的贸易通道转变为制度生态系统，成为数字支付、替代结算机制和走廊治理的平台。走廊连接性、制度协调和技术整合在塑造货币兼容性方面比地理邻近更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将走廊经济学概念化为独立分析领域；2. 通过ADOCA模型重新表述OCA理论；3. 通过IGC将纳什的理想货币转化为操作框架；4. 挑战货币一体化必须基于领土邻近或政治统一的长期假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解经济走廊作为制度与货币空间的新视角，支持跨境贸易的数字锚定走廊账户单位设计，降低交易成本，保持货币主权，促进基于连接性、制度信任和数字互操作性的后领土货币一体化。

title: Business Agility and Socio-Technical Resilience: An Assessment of Large-Scale Agile Frameworks
affiliations: , The Open University, The Open University, UK, The Open University, UK, The Open University and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Business Agility and Socio-Technical Resilience: An Assessment of Large-Scale Agile Frameworks

declarations.funderStatement: This research was partly funded by grant EP/T017465/1 from EPSRC to project STRIDE (Socio-technical resilience in software development).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Systems and Software, Forthcoming

detail.abstract: In today's volatile and complex business environment, large-scale Agile frameworks (LSAFs) have emerged as pivotal enablers of organisation-wide agility, with many organisations seeking improved resilience. However, many of these frameworks were not originally designed for this purpose, raising questions about their adequacy and alignment with these multidimensional concepts. Compounding this challenge is the absence of a unified view of business agility and the dimensions of business that it encompasses, which impedes consistent assessment and benchmarking. In this study, we developed a thematic clustering of business agility dimensions derived from academic literature and practitioner perspectives (which we call domains). We also adapted Hollnagel's RAG (resilience analysis grid) for organisational resilience to apply to LSAFs. Using these instruments, we assess the extent to which widely adopted LSAFs incorporate and support business agility and resilience. A matrix-based assessment tool employing a Likert scale was developed to collect quantitative ratings and qualitative justifications, which were then analysed using descriptive statistical methods. The findings reveal substantial variability in how different frameworks address core agility domains and resilience concepts, uncovering both strengths and critical gaps. This research contributes a novel empirical framework for assessing the support for business agility and organisational resilience provided by LSAFs, offering insights for practitioners and researchers regarding the relationship between business agility and socio-technical resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了业务敏捷性维度的主题聚类，并改编了Hollnagel的RAG（韧性分析网格）来评估大规模敏捷框架（LSAFs）对业务敏捷性和组织韧性的支持程度。研究发现不同框架在核心敏捷领域和韧性概念方面存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 大规模敏捷框架（LSAFs）在多大程度上纳入并支持业务敏捷性和组织韧性？
AI.motivation: 在动荡复杂的商业环境中，大规模敏捷框架被视为组织范围内敏捷性的关键推动因素，但许多框架最初并非为此目的设计，且缺乏对业务敏捷性的统一理解，阻碍了一致的评估和基准测试。

3. 业务敏捷性与社会技术韧性之间的关系理论

1. 开发基于矩阵的评估工具，采用李克特量表

3. 使用描述性统计方法分析数据
4. 评估广泛采用的大规模敏捷框架（LSAFs）
AI.findings: 研究发现不同框架在核心敏捷领域和韧性概念方面存在显著差异，揭示了各自的优势和关键差距。不同框架对业务敏捷性和韧性的支持程度存在实质性变异性。

title: Fiscal Decentralization as a Structural Ecological Modifier: Evidence from Kenya’s Post-Devolution Biocapacity Balance
affiliations: University of Embu

detail.title: Fiscal Decentralization as a Structural Ecological Modifier: Evidence from Kenya’s Post-Devolution Biocapacity Balance
detail.abstract: Economic growth in developing economies increasingly unfolds under binding ecological constraints, yet empirical assessments of decentralization reforms continue to rely on emissions-based indicators that overlook biophysical limits. This study examines whether Kenya’s post-2013 fiscal decentralization altered the structural relationship between economic growth, population pressure, and ecological sustainability. Guided by an extended STIRPAT framework, fiscal decentralization is treated as a structural institutional shift capable of modifying environmental elasticities rather than producing direct level effects. Using annual national time-series data for 2013–2024 and estimating models with Newey–West corrected standard errors, the analysis tests both baseline and interaction specifications. Results reveal persistent ecological overshoot throughout the post-devolution period, with ecological footprint consistently exceeding domestic biocapacity despite rising incomes and relatively low emissions. Fiscal decentralization exhibits no direct environmental effect; however, interaction models show that decentralization significantly reshapes ecological elasticities. Specifically, higher fiscal decentralization amplifies the growth–ecological footprint and growth–emissions elasticities, while attenuating the per-capita ecological pressure associated with population growth. These findings are robust across alternative outcome measures, first-difference models, and exclusion of COVID-19 years. The study contributes new evidence that fiscal decentralization in biocapacity-constrained, low-emissions economies operates as a structural moderator rather than an environmental corrective. By integrating biocapacity constraints into decentralization analysis, the paper advances sustainability scholarship beyond emissions-centric and Environmental Kuznets Curve frameworks, highlighting that governance reforms interact with fixed ecological limits in non-linear and trade-off-laden ways.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨肯尼亚2013年后财政分权是否改变了经济增长、人口压力与生态可持续性之间的结构关系。研究发现财政分权不直接影响环境，但显著重塑生态弹性：分权程度越高，经济增长对生态足迹和排放的弹性越大，但减弱了人口增长对人均生态压力的影响。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚2013年后的财政分权是否改变了经济增长、人口压力与生态可持续性之间的结构关系？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家经济增长面临生态约束，但现有分权改革评估仍依赖排放指标，忽视了生物物理限制。需要将生物承载力约束纳入分权分析，超越以排放为中心的环境库兹涅茨曲线框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的STIRPAT框架（人口、富裕、技术对环境影响），将财政分权视为结构性制度转变，能够修改环境弹性而非产生直接水平效应。
AI.method: 使用2013-2024年年度国家时间序列数据，采用Newey-West校正标准误差估计模型，测试基准模型和交互模型，通过替代结果测量、一阶差分模型和排除COVID-19年份进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) 分权后时期持续存在生态超载，生态足迹始终超过国内生物承载力；2) 财政分权无直接环境效应；3) 分权显著重塑生态弹性：更高的分权程度会放大增长-生态足迹和增长-排放弹性，同时减弱人口增长带来的人均生态压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将生物承载力约束整合到分权分析中，推进可持续发展研究超越排放中心和环境库兹涅茨曲线框架；2) 证明在生物承载力受限、低排放经济体中，财政分权作为结构性调节器而非环境矫正器运作；3) 揭示治理改革与固定生态限制以非线性和充满权衡的方式相互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供证据，表明在生态约束经济体中，分权改革可能加剧经济增长的环境影响；2) 强调需要将生态限制纳入分权政策设计；3) 为其他面临类似生态约束的发展中国家提供参考。

title: Continuity of Care and Patient Onboarding in U.S. Home-Based Healthcare

detail.title: Continuity of Care and Patient Onboarding in U.S. Home-Based Healthcare

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Home-based healthcare is a critical part of the U.S. healthcare provision system. It serves elderly individuals, people with disabilities, and patients with chronic or post-acute care needs. As reliance on in-home care increases, continuity of care is a key determinant of clinical outcomes, healthcare quality, and system sustainability. This paper investigates patient onboarding as a mechanism that influences continuity of care in U.S. home-based healthcare. Instead of viewing onboarding solely as an operational process, the study situates it within a broader framework. It emphasizes the role of onboarding in care continuity, patient engagement, care integration, patient safety, and healthcare system performance. Drawing on healthcare systems and public health literature, the analysis explores how onboarding practices affect patient engagement, care stability, and service continuity, and how these factors impact government-funded home care programs. The paper concludes with recommendations to enhance care continuity in U.S. home-based healthcare.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了患者入职流程如何影响美国家庭医疗保健中的护理连续性，将入职视为影响患者参与、护理整合和安全的关键机制，并提出了改善建议。
AI.research_question: 患者入职流程如何影响美国家庭医疗保健中的护理连续性？
AI.motivation: 家庭医疗保健在美国医疗体系中至关重要，服务于老年人、残疾人和慢性病患者。随着对家庭护理依赖的增加，护理连续性成为临床结果、医疗质量和系统可持续性的关键决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗系统和公共卫生文献，将患者入职置于更广泛的框架中，强调其在护理连续性、患者参与、护理整合、患者安全和医疗系统绩效中的作用。
AI.method: 文献分析，探讨入职实践如何影响患者参与、护理稳定性和服务连续性，以及这些因素如何影响政府资助的家庭护理项目。
AI.findings: 患者入职流程显著影响护理连续性，通过影响患者参与度、护理稳定性和服务连续性，进而影响政府资助的家庭护理项目的效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将患者入职从单纯的操作流程重新概念化为影响护理连续性的关键机制，扩展了家庭医疗保健的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善美国家庭医疗保健中的护理连续性提供具体建议，帮助政策制定者和医疗机构优化患者入职流程。

title: CBAM and Its Economic Impact on India and China: A Comparative Study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: CBAM and Its Economic Impact on India and China: A Comparative Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary data analysis and does not involve human subjects. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) marks a fundamental shift in global trade governance by integrating climate objectives directly into market access rules. Unlike traditional tariffs, CBAM introduces carbon-based cost adjustments and mandatory emissions reporting for selected imported goods. This paper presents a comparative analysis of CBAM's economic impact on India and China, two major developing economies with significant carbon-intensive exports to the European Union. Using secondary data, peer-reviewed literature, and sectoral exposure analysis, the study evaluates direct cost impacts, compliance burdens, competitiveness effects, and policy response capacities in both countries. The findings indicate that while China faces larger absolute exposure due to export scale and deeper integration into EU value chains, it possesses stronger institutional and financial capacity to adapt. India, though less exposed at the macroeconomic level, experiences sharper sector-specific pressures, particularly in steel and aluminium, with constraints related to emissions measurement, financing, and technological readiness. The paper concludes that CBAM functions less as a short-term tariff and more as a long-term structural filter that rewards credible low-carbon production, reshaping global trade patterns and accelerating industrial decarbonization.

AI.tldr: 欧盟碳边境调节机制(CBAM)将气候目标直接融入市场准入规则，对印度和中国这两个主要发展中经济体的碳密集型出口产生不同影响。中国因出口规模和欧盟价值链深度整合面临更大绝对风险，但具备更强的适应能力；印度虽然宏观风险较小，但在钢铁和铝等特定行业面临更尖锐压力，受限于排放测量、融资和技术准备度。
AI.research_question: 欧盟碳边境调节机制(CBAM)对印度和中国这两个主要发展中经济体的经济影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: CBAM代表了全球贸易治理的根本转变，将气候目标直接融入市场准入规则，对依赖碳密集型出口到欧盟的发展中经济体产生重要影响，需要比较分析不同经济体的应对能力和影响差异。

AI.findings: 中国因出口规模和欧盟价值链深度整合面临更大绝对风险，但具备更强的制度性和财务适应能力；印度虽然宏观风险较小，但在钢铁和铝等特定行业面临更尖锐压力，受限于排放测量、融资和技术准备度
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出CBAM作为长期结构性过滤器而非短期关税的理论框架；2) 发展了气候贸易措施对不同发展中经济体差异化影响的理论；3) 贡献于气候政策与全球贸易治理整合的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为印度和中国政策制定者提供CBAM应对策略建议；2) 识别特定行业的脆弱性和适应需求；3) 为其他发展中经济体提供CBAM影响评估的参考框架；4) 促进工业脱碳和低碳生产转型

title: Narrating Inflation: How German Economic Journalists explained Post-Covid Price Rises
affiliations: Institute of Journalism at TU Dortmund University

detail.title: Narrating Inflation: How German Economic Journalists explained Post-Covid Price Rises
detail.abstract: Economic narratives play a central role in shaping expectations, particularly during periods of high uncertainty. While a growing literature examines how media narratives affect economic beliefs, little is known about the journalists who articulate and/or reproduce these narratives. Using a mixed-methods design that combines survey data with media content analysis, this study investigates how German economic journalists explained inflation causes and persistence in 2022, how their views compared with those of professional economists, and how these narratives were reflected in inflation-related media coverage. The findings reveal broad alignment between journalists and economists regarding the main drivers of inflation – most notably energy shocks and supply-chain disruptions – but also systematic differences in emphasis. Journalists were more pessimistic about inflation persistence and placed greater weight on monetary policy and corporate profiteering. Narrative embedding and clustering analyses show that both groups drew on two latent narrative templates, a supply-oriented and a policy-oriented narrative, that cut across professional boundaries. Media analysis further shows that journalists’ narratives aligned more closely with 2022 inflation coverage, particularly in the prominence given to the European Central Bank. Taken together, the results suggest that economic journalism neither merely transmits expert consensus nor operates independently of it, challenging the view of the media as a mere transmission channel of monetary policy communication. Incorporating the producers of economic narratives into narrative economics offers a more complete understanding of how economic meaning is constructed in the public sphere.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过混合方法分析德国经济记者在2022年如何解释通胀原因和持续性，发现记者与经济学家在通胀驱动因素上基本一致，但记者更悲观、更关注货币政策和企业牟利，媒体并非仅仅是专家共识的传播渠道。
AI.research_question: 德国经济记者如何解释2022年的通胀原因和持续性？他们的观点与专业经济学家相比有何异同？这些叙事如何反映在通胀相关的媒体报道中？

AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事经济学、媒体经济学、专业边界理论、经济新闻生产理论
AI.method: 混合方法设计：结合调查数据（记者和经济学家的观点比较）与媒体内容分析（通胀相关报道的叙事分析），包括叙事嵌入和聚类分析

4. 记者叙事与2022年通胀报道更一致，特别是对欧洲央行的关注
AI.theory_contributions:

2. 将叙事生产者纳入叙事经济学，提供更完整的经济意义构建理解
