detail.title: A Thermodynamic Framework for Optimizing Value Capture in Telecommunications. Modelling Work, Entropy, And Coverage: An Intuitive Introduction to Robust Network Rollout

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This work is a formalisation of my previous professional activities.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was self-funded.

detail.abstract: We present a thermodynamic framework for modelling value capture in markets where customers require a threshold level of coverage before a transaction succeeds. Customers value not so much the outcome of the individual touchpoint but the overall experience. Our main focus is on Radio Access Network Optimisation (RAN), but we will use a jargon-free example from Public Mass Transport as a motivation. While entropy and information measures have been used as heuristics in optimisation and search (e.g., entropy search in Bayesian optimisation and entropy-guided exploration in reinforcement learning) , the present work defines entropy as a state-level measure of uncertainty in threshold satisfaction outcomes and integrates it with free energy bounds to guide breadth-first action selection under budget constraints in infrastructure planning. This combination is novel and captures the practical objective of maximising realised value rather than information about an unobserved optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个热力学框架来建模市场中的价值捕获，其中客户需要达到一定的覆盖阈值才能完成交易。客户更看重整体体验而非单个接触点的结果。该框架将熵定义为阈值满足结果的不确定性度量，并与自由能界限结合，在基础设施规划中指导预算约束下的广度优先行动选择。
AI.research_question: 如何在客户需要达到覆盖阈值才能完成交易的市场中，通过热力学框架建模价值捕获，并优化基础设施规划以实现价值最大化？
AI.motivation: 现有优化方法（如贝叶斯优化中的熵搜索和强化学习中的熵引导探索）主要关注信息获取，而实际应用中需要最大化实现的价值而非仅仅获取关于未观测最优值的信息。特别是在无线接入网络优化和公共交通等领域，客户更看重整体体验而非单个接触点的结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学框架，将熵定义为阈值满足结果的不确定性状态级度量，结合自由能界限来指导行动选择。该框架整合了信息论和热力学概念，用于建模价值捕获过程。
AI.method: 使用熵作为阈值满足结果的不确定性度量，结合自由能界限，在预算约束下指导广度优先行动选择。通过无线接入网络优化和公共交通的无术语示例进行说明。
AI.findings: 提出的热力学框架能够有效建模价值捕获过程，特别是在客户需要达到覆盖阈值才能完成交易的市场中。该框架将熵与自由能结合的方法具有新颖性，能够更实际地最大化实现的价值而非仅仅获取信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将熵重新定义为阈值满足结果的不确定性状态级度量；2. 将熵与自由能界限结合，形成新的热力学框架；3. 该框架专注于最大化实现的价值而非信息获取，与现有优化方法形成理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为无线接入网络优化提供实用的规划框架；2. 在预算约束下指导基础设施的广度优先部署；3. 帮助企业在客户需要覆盖阈值的市场中更有效地捕获价值；4. 通过无术语示例使复杂概念更易于理解应用。

title: P-MACTR Matrix: A Reality-Weighted Market Evaluation Framework for Modern Industries

detail.title: P-MACTR Matrix: A Reality-Weighted Market Evaluation Framework for Modern Industries
detail.abstract: Traditional portfolio analysis tools such as the BCG Matrix and the GE–McKinsey Matrix rely on simplified assumptions about market growth and market share. While effective in stable industrial eras, these frameworks fail to capture the complexity of modern economies characterized by aggressive competition, regulatory uncertainty, technological disruption, and accounting-driven profitability. This paper proposes a new analytical framework—the P-MACTR Matrix™—which evaluates firms and products using seven reality-weighted dimensions: Profitability Reality, Market Share, Market Growth, Cash Flow Strength, Competition Intensity, Technology Position, and Regulation Impact. The framework introduces a Profit Reality Filter (PRF) to distinguish real, sustainable profits from accounting or short-term profits. The P-MACTR Matrix provides a more accurate, future-oriented, and risk-adjusted tool for investors, strategists, policymakers, and entrepreneurs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的投资组合分析框架P-MACTR Matrix™，通过七个现实加权维度（盈利能力现实、市场份额、市场增长、现金流强度、竞争强度、技术地位、监管影响）来评估企业和产品，并引入利润现实过滤器来区分真实可持续利润与会计或短期利润，为现代复杂经济环境提供更准确、面向未来和风险调整的分析工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在现代复杂经济环境中开发一个更准确、面向未来和风险调整的投资组合分析框架，以克服传统分析工具（如BCG矩阵和GE-McKinsey矩阵）的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合分析工具（如BCG矩阵和GE-McKinsey矩阵）基于简化的市场增长和市场份额假设，在稳定的工业时代有效，但无法捕捉现代经济的复杂性，包括激烈竞争、监管不确定性、技术颠覆和会计驱动的盈利能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略管理理论、投资组合分析理论和现代企业评估理论，提出P-MACTR Matrix™框架，整合七个现实加权维度和利润现实过滤器，强调真实可持续利润与会计利润的区别。
AI.method: 提出概念性分析框架开发方法，包括：1）识别传统工具的局限性；2）定义七个关键评估维度；3）引入利润现实过滤器；4）构建综合评估矩阵；5）验证框架的实用性和准确性。
AI.findings: P-MACTR Matrix™能够更准确地评估企业和产品，通过七个维度提供更全面的分析，利润现实过滤器帮助区分真实可持续利润，为投资者、战略家、政策制定者和企业家提供更有效的决策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了投资组合分析理论，纳入现代经济复杂性因素；2）提出利润现实概念，区分会计利润与可持续利润；3）开发了多维评估框架，整合财务、市场、竞争、技术和监管因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资者提供更准确的风险调整分析工具；2）帮助企业战略家制定更有效的投资组合策略；3）协助政策制定者评估产业竞争力；4）支持企业家识别可持续商业模式。

title: Prompting in the Wild: A Qualitative Taxonomy of Practitioner-Driven Prompt Engineering Methods
affiliations: CirroLytix Research Services

detail.title: Prompting in the Wild: A Qualitative Taxonomy of Practitioner-Driven Prompt Engineering Methods
detail.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly embedded in professional and everyday workflows, prompt engineering has emerged as a critical yet loosely defined skill. While formal prompt engineering frameworks have proliferated in recent years, much of the existing literature emphasizes idealized prompt structures, benchmarks, and synthetic tasks, offering limited insight into how prompting is practiced in real-world settings. This paper addresses this gap by examining prompting strategies as they emerge organically among practitioners. Drawing on practitioner-generated comments from a public social media discussion soliciting prompting methodologies, this study employs qualitative thematic analysis to identify recurring patterns in real-world prompting behavior. The analysis reveals a diverse set of prompting strategies that cluster into several categories, including context-first and living context management, role and persona assignment, structural and formatting control, meta-cognitive prompting, iterative conversational workflows, verification and skepticism mechanisms, and affective, social, and linguistic strategies. The primary contribution of this work is a practice-based taxonomy of prompting strategies "in the wild," highlighting forms of interaction that extend beyond formal prompt engineering models. In particular, the findings underscore the importance of social framing, conversational iteration, and meta-strategic collaboration between users and AI systems. The paper concludes by discussing implications for practitioners seeking more effective prompting workflows, for tool designers developing interfaces and infrastructure to support real-world use, and for researchers aiming to bridge formal prompt engineering research with practitioner knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析社交媒体上实践者的真实提示策略，提出了一个基于实践的提示策略分类法，揭示了超越正式提示工程框架的社交框架、对话迭代和元战略协作等真实世界交互模式。
AI.research_question: 在真实世界环境中，实践者如何有机地发展和应用提示策略？这些策略与正式的提示工程框架有何不同？
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在专业和日常工作中的广泛应用，提示工程成为关键技能，但现有文献多关注理想化的提示结构、基准和合成任务，缺乏对真实世界提示实践的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实践导向的提示工程理论，强调从真实世界实践中提取知识，而非仅依赖正式框架；社会技术系统视角，关注用户与AI系统的协作互动。
AI.method: 定性主题分析：收集公共社交媒体讨论中实践者生成的评论，分析真实世界提示行为中的重复模式。
AI.findings: 识别出多种提示策略类别：上下文优先和动态上下文管理、角色和人物设定、结构和格式控制、元认知提示、迭代对话工作流、验证和怀疑机制、情感、社交和语言策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于实践的"野生"提示策略分类法，揭示了超越正式提示工程模型的交互形式，强调了社交框架、对话迭代和用户与AI系统之间的元战略协作的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供更有效的提示工作流指导；为工具设计者开发支持真实世界使用的界面和基础设施提供参考；为研究者搭建正式提示工程研究与实践者知识之间的桥梁。

title: Relational Integrity in AI: Preserving Human Agency, Accountability, and Meaning Under Pressure

detail.title: Relational Integrity in AI: Preserving Human Agency, Accountability, and Meaning Under Pressure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions and therefore did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As AI systems increasingly operate in language-mediated and relational contexts, many of the risks they introduce do not arise from discrete failures, misuse, or malicious intent. Instead, harm often emerges through gradual shifts in how systems are interpreted, relied upon, and positioned within human judgment and institutional practice. These shifts are frequently well-intended, incentive-aligned, and normalized through ordinary use, allowing role clarity, accountability, and relational boundaries to erode even when systems appear effective. The Relational Integrity in AI Framework (RIAF) offers a diagnostic approach to these dynamics. Rather than treating relational harm as a matter of compliance, output control, or user error, RIAF conceptualizes it as a structural phenomenon shaped by cumulative interaction, interpretive signals, and institutional embedding. The framework introduces relational drift as a precursor to stabilized structural failure, identifies a canonical set of relational integrity failure modes, and argues that sustained protection depends on preserving specific human capacities rather than enforcing static rules or prescriptions. RIAF is not an implementation guide or ethical checklist. It is a conditioning framework designed to support reflection, pressure-testing of relational integrity, and responsible judgment in contexts where AI systems increasingly mediate meaning, authority, care, and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了关系完整性AI框架(RIAF)，用于诊断AI系统在关系性语境中逐渐产生的风险，这些风险源于系统解释、依赖和定位的渐进变化，而非离散故障或恶意意图。
AI.research_question: 如何诊断和预防AI系统在语言中介和关系性语境中逐渐产生的结构性风险，这些风险源于系统解释、依赖和定位的渐进变化？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地在语言中介和关系性语境中运行，许多风险并非来自离散故障、误用或恶意意图，而是源于系统如何被解释、依赖和定位的渐进变化，这些变化往往是善意的、激励一致的，并通过日常使用正常化，导致角色清晰度、问责制和关系边界逐渐侵蚀。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系完整性AI框架(RIAF)，将关系性伤害概念化为由累积互动、解释信号和制度嵌入塑造的结构性现象，引入"关系漂移"作为稳定结构故障的前兆，并识别关系完整性故障模式。
AI.method: 概念框架开发方法，提出诊断性框架而非实施指南或伦理清单，旨在支持反思、关系完整性压力测试和负责任判断。
AI.findings: RIAF框架提供了诊断AI系统关系性风险的方法，强调持续保护依赖于保护特定人类能力，而非强制执行静态规则或规定，特别是在AI系统日益中介意义、权威、关怀和决策制定的语境中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将关系性伤害概念化为结构性现象而非合规问题；2) 引入"关系漂移"作为结构故障前兆的概念；3) 识别关系完整性故障模式；4) 强调保护人类能力而非静态规则的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计者和使用者提供诊断工具，帮助识别关系性风险，支持反思和压力测试，促进在AI中介语境中保持关系完整性，特别是在意义、权威、关怀和决策制定方面。

title: Mixed Methods Designs

detail.title: Mixed Methods Designs
detail.abstract: Mixed-method research has gained popularity as one of the most recent developments in research methodologies and approaches to combining quantitative and qualitative research. To better comprehend our research problem and answer our research question, we can use both qualitative and quantitative data. We can develop "a complex" picture of social phenomena by assessing both the outcomes of the research in terms of numeracy (i.e., quantitative) and the process (i.e., qualitative) (Greene & Caracelli, 1997, p. 7) [1]. The current chapter is divided into the following sections: Section I provided an overview of "What is Mixed-Methods Research?" while Section II detailed the historical development of mixedmethods research. Section III addresses "Why and When to Use Mixed Methods Research." Section IV gives a concise summary of the various dimensions of a mixed-methods study design in relation to contemporary sinereos. The fifth section, "Ethical Issues in Mixed Methods Research," has been accomplished. The steps involved in conducting mixed-methods research were outlined in Section VI. Finally, in Section VII, I have discussed some concluding remarks.

AI.tldr: 本文是关于混合方法研究的综述性章节，系统介绍了混合方法研究的定义、历史发展、适用情境、研究设计维度、伦理问题、实施步骤等内容。
AI.research_question: 混合方法研究是什么？为什么以及何时应该使用混合方法研究？如何设计和实施混合方法研究？
AI.motivation: 混合方法研究作为研究方法论的最新发展之一，结合了定量和定性研究的优势，能够更全面地理解研究问题，提供社会现象的复杂图景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Greene和Caracelli（1997）的理论框架，强调通过定量数据（结果）和定性数据（过程）的结合来构建对社会现象的全面理解。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理混合方法研究的理论发展和实践应用。
AI.findings: 1. 混合方法研究能够整合定量和定性数据的优势；2. 提供了混合方法研究的历史发展脉络；3. 明确了混合方法研究的适用情境；4. 提出了混合方法研究设计的多个维度；5. 识别了混合方法研究中的伦理问题；6. 建立了混合方法研究的实施步骤框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了混合方法研究的理论框架，整合了定量和定性研究的方法论基础，为混合方法研究提供了系统的理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了混合方法研究的完整操作指南，包括研究设计、伦理考量、实施步骤等，有助于研究者在实践中有效应用混合方法研究。

title: Labour Market Power and Automation

detail.title: Labour Market Power and Automation
detail.abstract: I show novel evidence using French administrative data that automation reduced wage markdowns by 3%-reflecting increased labour market power-and increased concentration by 20%, with effects intensifying over time. To quantify the aggregate implications, I develop a general equilibrium model with oligopsonistic labour markets, endogenous automation adoption, and firm entry. Using the reducedform evidence to discipline the model, I find that median welfare would be approximately 13% higher, and aggregate output 2% higher, had automation occurred without raising labour market power.

AI.tldr: 本文使用法国行政数据发现自动化降低了工资折扣3%（反映劳动力市场力量增强），并使集中度提高20%，且效应随时间增强。通过建立包含寡头垄断劳动力市场、内生自动化采用和企业进入的一般均衡模型，研究发现如果自动化不增强劳动力市场力量，中位数福利将提高约13%，总产出将提高2%。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何影响劳动力市场力量和企业集中度？如果自动化不增强劳动力市场力量，对福利和产出的总体影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 自动化技术快速发展，但对其在劳动力市场中的分配效应和福利影响的理解仍然有限，特别是自动化如何改变企业的市场力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断劳动力市场理论、内生技术采用理论、一般均衡分析框架
AI.method: 1. 使用法国行政数据进行实证分析；2. 建立包含寡头垄断劳动力市场、内生自动化采用和企业进入的一般均衡模型；3. 用实证证据校准模型参数
AI.findings: 1. 自动化使工资折扣降低3%，反映劳动力市场力量增强；2. 企业集中度提高20%；3. 效应随时间增强；4. 如果自动化不增强劳动力市场力量，中位数福利将提高约13%，总产出将提高2%
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了分析自动化与劳动力市场力量相互作用的理论框架；2. 将寡头垄断劳动力市场纳入自动化分析；3. 提供了内生技术采用与市场结构互动的理论模型
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了自动化对劳动力市场影响的量化证据；2. 揭示了自动化可能加剧市场集中度的风险；3. 为设计减轻自动化负面分配效应的政策提供了依据

title: Programmable Fiscal Instruments for Welfare Delivery: The Case for Annapurna Coin and a Welfare Digital Public Infrastructure in India

detail.title: Programmable Fiscal Instruments for Welfare Delivery: The Case for Annapurna Coin and a Welfare Digital Public Infrastructure in India
detail.abstract:
India’s welfare architecture has been significantly reshaped over the last decade through digitisation, Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT), and national digital rails such as Aadhaar and the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). These reforms have improved transfer-stage efficiency and reduced diversion at disbursement. However, persistent challenges remain in welfare schemes where policy objectives are outcome-specific, particularly in food security and nutrition. Cash transfers are fully fungible and sensitive to price variation, while in-kind delivery remains administratively rigid and vulnerable to leakage, creating a structural trade-off between efficiency and outcome assurance.

This paper introduces programmable fiscal instruments as a distinct class of budget-issued welfare instruments designed to address this gap. Unlike cash transfers, vouchers, or digital currency, programmable fiscal instruments embed purpose, usage constraints, and settlement rules directly within the instrument, enabling outcome-specific welfare delivery without monetary or central-bank balance-sheet implications. The paper situates this concept within a Welfare Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) framework and argues that instrument design constitutes a missing architectural layer in contemporary welfare systems.

The paper examines Annapurna Coin and Milk Coin as concrete instantiations of this framework. Annapurna Coin illustrates a population-scale instrument for staple food security, while Milk Coin demonstrates targeted nutrition support for specific demographic groups. Through architectural, legal, and economic analysis, the paper shows how programmable fiscal instruments preserve beneficiary choice while enforcing purpose constraints, support multi-vendor participation, and generate policy-relevant utilisation data. The paper reframes welfare reform as a problem of fiscal instrument design rather than transfer modality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可编程财政工具"作为一类新型福利工具，通过嵌入使用约束和结算规则来解决印度福利体系中效率与结果保障之间的结构性矛盾。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能保证福利政策目标（特别是食品安全和营养）又能提高效率的新型福利工具，以解决现金转移和实物交付之间的结构性矛盾？
AI.motivation: 印度福利体系经过数字化改革后，虽然提高了转移效率和减少了资金挪用，但在食品安全和营养等需要特定结果的福利项目中仍存在挑战。现金转移完全可替代且对价格变化敏感，实物交付则行政僵化且易泄漏，形成效率与结果保障之间的结构性矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利数字公共基础设施（Welfare DPI）框架；可编程财政工具理论；财政工具设计作为福利体系架构的缺失层
AI.method: 架构分析、法律分析和经济分析；通过Annapurna Coin（主食安全）和Milk Coin（营养支持）两个具体实例进行案例研究
AI.findings: 可编程财政工具能够：1）在保持受益人选择权的同时强制执行使用约束；2）支持多供应商参与；3）生成政策相关的利用数据；4）实现特定结果的福利交付，无需货币或央行资产负债表影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"可编程财政工具"作为福利工具的新类别；2）将福利改革重新定义为财政工具设计问题而非转移方式问题；3）识别工具设计作为当代福利体系中缺失的架构层
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供具体可实施的工具设计方案；2）通过Annapurna Coin和Milk Coin展示了人口规模和目标群体应用；3）为解决食品安全和营养等特定结果福利项目提供新路径

title: Ogoni-Ibibio Intergroup Relations Since the Pre-colonial Era to 2023.
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Ogoni-Ibibio Intergroup Relations Since the Pre-colonial Era to 2023.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract:
Abstract

The intergroup relationship between the Ogoni and Ibibio communities has been a prominent aspect of Southern Nigerian history since the pre-colonial era. This research aims to explore the dynamics, interactions, and transformations that have shaped this relationship over time. By examining various historical sources, including oral traditions, archival records, and scholarly works, this study seeks to provide a comprehensive analysis of the intergroup dynamics between the Ogoni and Ibibio peoples.  The research will delve into the pre-colonial era, a period characterized by cultural exchanges, trade relationships, and occasional conflicts between the Ogoni and Ibibio communities. It will investigate the socio-economic, political, and cultural factors that influenced their interactions during this period, shedding light on the nature of their relationship. 

Furthermore, this research will also examine the impact of the colonial era on the intergroup relationship. The arrival of European powers and subsequent colonization brought about significant changes, including the introduction of a new administrative structure, economic transformations, and the imposition of colonial policies. These factors had a profound effect on the Ogoni-Ibibio relationship, altering power dynamics, trade patterns, and cultural practices. 

The post-colonial era will also be explored to understand how the intergroup relationship has evolved in the wake of Nigeria's independence. This period witnessed the rise of nationalism, ethnic tensions, and political struggles, which further influenced the dynamics between the Ogoni and Ibibio communities. The research will delve into these aspects, analyzing the role of nationalism and social movements in shaping their relationship. 

Through this research, a comprehensive understanding of the intergroup relationship between the Ogoni and Ibibio communities will be achieved. The findings will contribute to existing knowledge and provide insights into the historical and contemporary dynamics that have influenced their interactions. This study aims to foster a deeper appreciation of the complex intergroup relationships that have shaped Nigerian history, with the hope of promoting better understanding and harmony among these communities in the present and future.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨尼日利亚南部奥戈尼族和伊比比奥族从殖民前到后殖民时期的族群关系演变，分析文化、经济、政治因素如何影响两族互动。
AI.research_question: 奥戈尼族和伊比比奥族之间的族群关系在不同历史时期（殖民前、殖民时期、后殖民时期）如何演变？哪些社会、经济、政治和文化因素塑造了这种关系？
AI.motivation: 奥戈尼族和伊比比奥族的关系是尼日利亚南部历史的重要方面，但缺乏系统研究。理解这种关系的动态变化有助于认识尼日利亚复杂的族群关系历史，促进社区间的理解与和谐。
AI.theoretical_framework: 族群关系理论、历史社会学、殖民和后殖民研究、民族主义理论、社会运动理论
AI.method: 历史研究方法，包括分析口述传统、档案记录和学术著作等多种历史资料
AI.findings: 研究预期发现：1)殖民前时期以文化交流、贸易关系和偶发冲突为特征；2)殖民时期欧洲势力的到来改变了权力动态、贸易模式和文化实践；3)后殖民时期民族主义、族群紧张和政治斗争进一步影响了两族关系
AI.theory_contributions: 1)为尼日利亚南部族群关系研究提供历史框架；2)丰富殖民和后殖民时期族群互动理论；3)深化对民族主义和社会运动如何影响族群关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1)增进对奥戈尼-伊比比奥关系的理解，促进社区和谐；2)为尼日利亚族群政策提供历史参考；3)帮助理解当代尼日利亚族群政治动态

title:
A Cosmic Dance: The Unified Principle 
A Rigorous Mathematical Framework for Earth's Celestial Dynamics and its Multi-Site Empirical Validation Across Ancient Global Observatories
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title:
A Cosmic Dance: The Unified Principle 
A Rigorous Mathematical Framework for Earth's Celestial Dynamics and its Multi-Site Empirical Validation Across Ancient Global Observatories
detail.abstract: This paper introduces The Unified Principle, a mathematical and empirical framework that defines Earth's fundamental rotational and orbital constants. It establishes a 364-day Unified Year (TY) and a 6.5-day Unified Day (TD), yielding exactly 56 rotations per year (NR), alongside a constant 23.5° axial tilt (α). The paper details hierarchical timekeeping, extending to Unified Hours and Minutes, and demonstrates the global, observable validation of these constants via ancient observatories, including Stonehenge (England), Serpent Mound (North America), the Pyramids of Giza (Egypt), Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (India), and Chankillo (Peru). The study provides a consistent, empirically verifiable model of Earth's motion, lunar phases, eclipses, and celestial calibration, offering precise evidence for a spherical Earth while illustrating the sophistication of ancient astronomers' observational practices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"统一原理"框架，定义了地球的基本旋转和轨道常数，包括364天的统一年、6.5天的统一日、每年56次旋转和23.5°的恒定轴向倾斜。通过全球古代天文台验证了这些常数，为地球运动、月相、日食等提供了可验证的模型。
AI.research_question: 地球的基本旋转和轨道常数是否存在统一的数学和实证框架？古代天文台是否验证了这些统一的常数？
AI.motivation: 建立地球运动的一致、可验证模型，揭示古代天文学家观测实践的精密性，为地球形状和天体校准提供精确证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一原理：地球旋转和轨道的数学框架，包括统一年、统一日、旋转次数和轴向倾斜等基本常数。
AI.method: 通过全球古代天文台（巨石阵、蛇丘、吉萨金字塔、斯里帕德马纳巴斯瓦米神庙、昌基略）的实证验证，分析这些遗址如何体现统一常数。
AI.findings: 全球古代天文台一致验证了364天统一年、6.5天统一日、每年56次旋转和23.5°轴向倾斜等常数，证明了古代天文学家观测的精密性和统一原理的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了地球运动的一致数学框架，建立了可验证的地球旋转和轨道常数体系，为天体物理学提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地球形状和天体校准提供精确证据，展示了古代天文观测实践的精密性，为现代天文学和历史研究提供了新的验证方法。

title: What Do Alif-Lam-Mim Actually Do? Rethinking the Disconnected Letters as Structural Thresholds in the Quran
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: What Do Alif-Lam-Mim Actually Do? Rethinking the Disconnected Letters as Structural Thresholds in the Quran

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research.

contentType.other: Independent long-form research study circulated as an open-access scholarly work.

detail.abstract: Hurūf al-Muqaṭṭaʿāt: A Structural-Functional Reading of the Disconnected Letters in the Quran The disconnected letters (ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿāt)—letter combinations such as Alif-Lam-Mim and Ha Mim appearing at the beginning of twenty-nine Quranic suras—have constituted one of Islamic scholarship’s most enduring interpretive challenges. Classical authorities adopted tafwīḍ (entrusting their meaning to God alone), while modern interpreters pursue numerological solutions. Despite fourteen centuries of inquiry, no consensus exists regarding what these letters mean. This monograph proposes a methodological reorientation: instead of asking “What do these letters mean?” it investigates “What do these letters do?” Drawing on reader-response theory, cognitive psychology, and textual analysis, this study argues that the disconnected letters function as structural thresholds—markers calibrating readers’ cognitive and epistemic positioning at sura openings. Through systematic examination of placement, distribution, and textual correlation, the study demonstrates three key findings: (1) their selective distribution reflects functional deployment—suras lacking them employ alternative threshold mechanisms (praise formulas, oaths, imperatives); (2) different letter groups correlate with distinct discourse types (Alif-Lam-Mim with pedagogical content, Ha-Mim with polemical defense, Alif-Lam-Ra with prophetic narratives); (3) they operate simultaneously as cognitive disruptors, acoustic attention-markers, and reader-activation devices. This functional interpretation accounts for features semantic approaches cannot explain while respecting classical epistemic humility. By analyzing observable patterns rather than decoding hidden meanings, the study reveals how textual elements achieve significance through function rather than semantic content.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出对《古兰经》中断开字母（ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿāt）的功能性解读，认为它们不是语义符号而是结构阈值标记，用于调整读者在章节开头的认知和认识论定位。
AI.research_question: 断开字母在《古兰经》中起什么功能作用，而不是它们有什么语义含义？
AI.motivation: 断开字母（如Alif-Lam-Mim、Ha Mim等）出现在29个《古兰经》章节开头，构成了伊斯兰学术最持久的解释挑战之一。古典学者采取"委托给神"的态度，现代解释者追求数字学解决方案，但14个世纪以来对这些字母的含义仍无共识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 读者反应理论、认知心理学、文本分析
AI.method: 通过系统考察断开字母的位置、分布和文本关联性，进行文本分析
AI.findings: 1. 选择性分布反映功能性部署：没有断开字母的章节使用替代阈值机制（赞美公式、誓言、命令）；2. 不同字母组与不同话语类型相关：Alif-Lam-Mim与教学内容相关，Ha-Mim与论辩防御相关，Alif-Lam-Ra与先知叙事相关；3. 同时作为认知干扰器、听觉注意力标记和读者激活装置运作
AI.theory_contributions: 提出断开字母的功能性解释，分析可观察模式而非解码隐藏含义，揭示文本元素如何通过功能而非语义内容获得意义
AI.practical_contributions: 为《古兰经》研究提供新的方法论方向，尊重古典认识论谦逊的同时解释语义方法无法解释的特征，为理解《古兰经》文本结构提供新视角

title: New Evidence on State-Dependent Fiscal Multipliers
affiliations: Bank of Italy

detail.title: New Evidence on State-Dependent Fiscal Multipliers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1512
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Building on the dataset and identification strategy of Ramey and Zubairy (2018), this paper investigates the dynamic effects of fiscal shocks using a state-dependent local projection approach. By interacting fiscal shocks with a continuous state variable, the analysis captures how fiscal multipliers evolve over the business cycle. This approach is novel within this literature, as most previous studies rely on two-regime estimates to account for non-linearity. The results indicate that the government spending multiplier varies significantly, ranging from near zero during expansions to slightly below one in downturns. While this evidence highlights meaningful state dependence in the transmission of fiscal policy, the relatively modest size of the estimated multipliers calls for caution in drawing strong conclusions about the effectiveness of countercyclical policies.

AI.tldr: 本文使用状态依赖的局部投影方法研究财政冲击的动态效应，发现政府支出乘数在经济扩张期接近零，在经济衰退期略低于1，表明财政政策存在显著的状态依赖性，但乘数规模相对较小。
AI.research_question: 财政冲击的动态效应如何随经济周期状态而变化？政府支出乘数在经济扩张和衰退时期有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多使用两区制估计来考虑非线性，缺乏对财政乘数随经济周期连续变化的细致分析。本文旨在通过连续状态变量更精确地捕捉财政政策效果的状态依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ramey和Zubairy（2018）的数据集和识别策略，采用状态依赖的局部投影方法，将财政冲击与连续状态变量交互，分析财政乘数在经济周期中的演变。
AI.method: 使用状态依赖的局部投影方法，将财政冲击与连续状态变量交互，避免了传统两区制估计的局限性，能够更细致地捕捉财政乘数随经济周期的连续变化。
AI.findings: 政府支出乘数存在显著的状态依赖性：在经济扩张期接近零，在经济衰退期略低于1。这表明财政政策效果随经济周期状态而变化，但乘数规模相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了使用连续状态变量的状态依赖局部投影方法，为财政政策非线性效应研究提供了新的方法论框架，克服了传统两区制估计的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明反周期财政政策的效果有限，政府支出乘数在经济衰退期也仅为略低于1，这对政策制定者设计财政刺激方案具有重要参考价值。

title: Energy Shocks
affiliations: University of London

detail.title: Energy Shocks
detail.abstract: The paper incorporates endogenous energy sector composed of coal, gas and oil in a Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) model and estimates using Bayesian methodology, providing evidence that energy shocks are the main contributor to the latest post-pandemic inflation episode and the variance of the monetary policy. The model augmented with financial frictions corrects counterfactual response of positive investment. An intriguing finding is that while the short run responses of output, consumption, and investment are negative but in the medium run swing to positive, not uncovered in any other relevant paper in literature. The substitution effect improves the productivity of capital and labor leading to positive medium term growth. Question is how policy makers can leverage these insights of positive dynamic response for transition towards a low-carbon economy? The paper also shows that well functioning financial markets can reduce the policy burden by stabilising the macro aggregates.

AI.tldr: 本文在DSGE模型中引入由煤炭、天然气和石油组成的内生能源部门，使用贝叶斯方法估计，发现能源冲击是后疫情通胀和货币政策波动的主要驱动因素。加入金融摩擦修正了投资的正向反事实响应。有趣的是，产出、消费和投资的短期响应为负，但中期转为正，这是文献中首次发现。替代效应提高了资本和劳动生产率，带来中期正增长。
AI.research_question: 能源冲击如何影响宏观经济动态？政策制定者如何利用正向动态响应促进向低碳经济转型？
AI.motivation: 后疫情通胀主要由能源冲击驱动，但现有文献未充分研究能源部门在DSGE模型中的内生性及其对宏观经济动态的影响，特别是短期与中期响应的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，内生能源部门（煤炭、天然气、石油），金融摩擦理论，贝叶斯估计方法。
AI.method: 构建包含内生能源部门的DSGE模型，使用贝叶斯方法进行参数估计和模型校准，分析能源冲击对宏观经济变量的脉冲响应。
AI.findings: 1. 能源冲击是后疫情通胀和货币政策波动的主要驱动因素；2. 产出、消费和投资对能源冲击的短期响应为负，但中期转为正（文献首次发现）；3. 替代效应提高资本和劳动生产率，促进中期增长；4. 金融摩擦修正了投资的正向反事实响应；5. 运行良好的金融市场可以稳定宏观经济变量，减轻政策负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在DSGE模型中系统引入内生能源部门；2. 揭示了能源冲击下宏观经济变量的非线性动态响应（短期负向、中期正向）；3. 阐明了替代效应通过提高生产率促进中期增长的机制；4. 完善了包含金融摩擦的能源-宏观经济联动理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者利用正向动态响应促进低碳转型提供理论依据；2. 表明发展良好金融市场可以减轻能源转型的政策负担；3. 为央行管理能源冲击引发的通胀提供政策参考；4. 为企业投资决策提供宏观经济环境分析框架。

title: Heterogeneous Equity Market Responses to a Geopolitical Tariff Threat
affiliations: Middle Tennessee State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Heterogeneous Equity Market Responses to a Geopolitical Tariff Threat
detail.abstract: This paper examines country-specific equity market responses to a politically conditioned tariff threat using the synthetic control method. The analysis focuses on the January 17, 2026 announcement in which the U.S. administration threatened escalating tariffs on imports from eight NATO countries unless an unrelated geopolitical demand-the purchase of Greenlandwas met. The policy was unusual in that tariffs were explicitly tied to a non-trade objective and selectively applied to close political and military allies of the United States. Using daily national equity market indices, the analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in market responses to the same policy shock. All targeted countries exhibit negative post-announcement deviations from their synthetic benchmarks, except the United Kingdom.

AI.tldr: 本文使用合成控制法分析2019年1月17日美国对八个北约盟国发出有条件关税威胁后的股市反应。研究发现，除英国外，所有目标国股市均出现负面反应，显示相同政策冲击下市场反应的异质性。
AI.research_question: 美国对北约盟国发出有条件关税威胁后，各国股市如何反应？这种反应是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于分析非常规贸易政策——将关税与非贸易目标（购买格陵兰岛）挂钩，并针对政治军事盟友——对金融市场的影响，特别是相同政策冲击下不同国家的异质反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易政策不确定性理论、地缘政治风险对金融市场影响理论，以及合成控制法在政策评估中的应用框架。
AI.method: 采用合成控制法，利用每日国家股市指数数据，为每个目标国构建反事实的合成基准，比较政策宣布前后的实际与合成基准表现差异。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）除英国外，所有目标国股市在政策宣布后均出现负面偏离合成基准；2）相同政策冲击下各国市场反应存在显著异质性；3）英国的特殊反应可能与其特殊政治经济地位有关。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）扩展了贸易政策不确定性理论，纳入非贸易目标条件；2）丰富了地缘政治风险对金融市场影响的研究；3）展示了合成控制法在分析异质性政策反应中的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为政策制定者提供关税威胁对盟友金融市场影响的证据；2）帮助投资者理解地缘政治风险在不同国家的差异化影响；3）为跨国公司风险管理提供参考。

title: Computational Foundations for Increasing Returns: Connecting the Milei-Reidel Framework to Turing-Walras-Chaitin

detail.title: Computational Foundations for Increasing Returns: Connecting the Milei-Reidel Framework to Turing-Walras-Chaitin
detail.abstract: Milei and Reidel (2026) demonstrate that increasing returns to scale (IRS) generate minimum viable scale constraints and poverty traps through a fold geometry in the steady-state feasibility set. Their central policy conclusion-that structural interventions fragmenting scale can be counterproductive-challenges standard presumptions about antitrust policy. This paper shows that the Turing-Walras-Chaitin (TWC) framework provides computational foundations for the Milei-Reidel result: IRS emerge naturally from the combinatorial structure of program space, and their insights about scale thresholds find formal expression in the dynamics of technological exploration. The TWC framework also provides a formal demonstration of Hayek's (1945) insight about the limits of planning: equilibrium in the limit economy is provably undecidable, meaning that optimal intervention cannot be computed by any algorithm. We establish a bridge between the two frameworks, showing that the minimum viable labor scale of IRS models corresponds to a minimum viable exploration scale in TWC, and that both capture the same fundamental insight: scale matters, and policy interventions that suppress it can trap economies in low-productivity regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Turing-Walras-Chaitin（TWC）计算框架为Milei-Reidel的规模报酬递增（IRS）理论提供计算基础，证明IRS源于程序空间的组合结构，规模阈值在技术探索动态中形式化表达，并形式化证明了Hayek关于计划局限性的观点：极限经济中的均衡是不可判定的。
AI.research_question: Turing-Walras-Chaitin（TWC）计算框架如何为Milei-Reidel的规模报酬递增（IRS）理论提供计算基础？两种框架如何共同揭示规模阈值和政策干预的经济影响？
AI.motivation: Milei和Reidel（2026）的研究表明规模报酬递增（IRS）通过稳态可行性集中的折叠几何产生最小可行规模约束和贫困陷阱，其核心政策结论（分割规模的结构干预可能适得其反）挑战了反垄断政策的传统假设。本文旨在为这一结果提供计算基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Milei-Reidel的规模报酬递增（IRS）理论；2. Turing-Walras-Chaitin（TWC）计算框架；3. Hayek（1945）关于计划局限性的观点；4. 程序空间的组合结构理论；5. 技术探索动态理论。
AI.method: 理论框架比较与整合：通过建立Milei-Reidel框架与TWC框架之间的桥梁，形式化分析规模阈值、技术探索动态和均衡可计算性问题。
AI.findings: 1. IRS自然源于程序空间的组合结构；2. 规模阈值在技术探索动态中找到形式化表达；3. 极限经济中的均衡是不可判定的（任何算法都无法计算最优干预）；4. IRS模型中的最小可行劳动规模对应于TWC中的最小可行探索规模；5. 两种框架都揭示：规模至关重要，抑制规模的政策干预可能使经济陷入低生产率状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为Milei-Reidel的IRS理论提供计算基础；2. 形式化证明了Hayek关于计划局限性的观点；3. 建立了IRS框架与TWC框架之间的理论桥梁；4. 将规模阈值概念从劳动规模扩展到技术探索规模；5. 揭示了均衡不可判定性的深层含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 挑战传统反垄断政策的假设；2. 表明分割规模的结构干预可能适得其反；3. 为政策制定者提供关于规模重要性的新视角；4. 强调政策干预需要考虑技术探索的动态过程；5. 指出过度干预可能将经济锁定在低生产率陷阱中。

title: Memory Warriors, Pluralists and Abnegators in Constituional Interpretation: An Essay on Jack Balkin's Pluralist Originalism in Memory and Authority
affiliations: Boston University - School of Law and

detail.title: Memory Warriors, Pluralists and Abnegators in Constituional Interpretation: An Essay on Jack Balkin's Pluralist Originalism in Memory and Authority

publicationDetails.detailsText: Boston Univ. School of Law Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Boston University School of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Jack Balkin’s Memory and Authority: The Uses of History in Constitutional Interpretation brings into conversation the scholarly insights of constitutional theory, history, and the growing field of “the politics of memory,” especially the concept of the “memory entrepreneur.”

Balkin appropriately connects the memory wars in American constitutional law back to Eastern European memory wars during the World Wars and their aftermath. Prompted by Balkin, we turn to Jan Kubik and Michael Bernhard edited volume Twenty Years After Communism (2014), which has become even more widely influential after Putin’s invasion of Ukraine and a new round of Eastern European memory wars. They propose four categories of memory entrepreneurs (“mnemonic actors”) in post-Soviet countries: “mnemonic warriors” who claim a single “true” interpretation of the past, opposed to all others who cultivate “wrong” or “false” interpretations; “mnemonic pluralists” who embrace multiple narratives and traditions; “mnemonic abnegators” who deny the significance of the past in favor of the present; and “mnemonic prospectives” who have a faith in an inevitable future (e.g., utopian Marxist historical materialists).

We suggest this taxonomy may be a helpful guide for American constitutional politics. The “memory pluralist” category is perhaps the majority of American constitutional law professors, maybe even a plurality of the U.S. Supreme Court and the federal and state bench, who do not give exclusive weight to history, but still give substantial weight to history (e.g., Philip Bobbit’s modalities, Balkin’s “living originalism” and his “thin originalism.”).

Some “thick originalists” are more “Memory Anti-Pluralists” than “Warriors.” We reserve the category of “Memory Warrior” for those constitutional interpreters who are consciously fighting for an exclusive, comprehensive national narrative of us vs. them. These warriors include ideological originalists (especially the ones who seem to rely on a general narrative arc rather than specific historical evidence), but they also may include the “history-and-tradition” conservatives, common-good constitutionalists, and perhaps some progressive-left memory warriors who have a more exclusive interpretation of past events than pluralists do.

Balkin rightly criticizes originalism for its “memory entrepreneurialism” that narrows the field of who “counts” and who is excluded, exacerbating constitutional law’s democratic deficit. We think the “memory warrior” category helps sort out the more problematic approaches, and we suggest a solution: a high burden of proof about consensus and public meaning to mitigate this democratic deficit, to reduce judicial legitimacy problems, and to slow down “warrior” judicial activism.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Jack Balkin关于宪法解释中历史记忆运用的理论，并借鉴东欧后共产主义国家的记忆企业家分类，提出了美国宪法政治中的记忆行动者分类框架，旨在解决原旨主义带来的民主赤字问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将东欧后共产主义国家的记忆企业家分类框架应用于美国宪法解释中的历史记忆运用，以解决原旨主义带来的民主赤字和司法正当性问题？
AI.motivation: Jack Balkin的《记忆与权威》将宪法理论与"记忆政治"领域联系起来，揭示了美国宪法解释中的记忆战争与东欧历史记忆冲突的相似性。作者希望借鉴东欧研究中的分类框架，为美国宪法政治提供分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) Jack Balkin的宪法记忆理论；2) Kubik和Bernhard的后共产主义记忆企业家分类理论（记忆战士、记忆多元主义者、记忆否定者、记忆前瞻者）；3) 宪法解释中的原旨主义理论；4) 民主赤字理论。
AI.method: 理论分析与概念移植方法：将东欧后共产主义国家的记忆企业家分类框架应用于美国宪法解释领域，进行概念类比和理论延伸。
AI.findings: 1) 美国宪法教授多数属于"记忆多元主义者"；2) 某些"厚原旨主义者"更接近"记忆反多元主义者"而非"记忆战士"；3) "记忆战士"包括意识形态原旨主义者、历史传统保守派、共同善宪法主义者等；4) 原旨主义的记忆企业家主义加剧了宪法民主赤字。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将东欧记忆政治理论引入美国宪法研究；2) 提出了美国宪法解释中的记忆行动者分类框架；3) 深化了对原旨主义与民主赤字关系的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供识别不同类型宪法解释者的分析工具；2) 提出通过提高共识和公共意义的证明标准来缓解民主赤字；3) 为减少司法正当性问题和抑制"战士"式司法能动主义提供解决方案。

title: Financial Agents Know Everything: The FAKE Ground of Modern Macroeconomic Models

detail.title: Financial Agents Know Everything: The FAKE Ground of Modern Macroeconomic Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this work.

detail.abstract:
Modern macroeconomic models rely on expectations to close dynamic systems and generate equilibrium predictions. These expectations are typically justified through rational expectations or related learning frameworks, yet the epistemic conditions required for such justifications are rarely examined explicitly. This paper argues that, for macroeconomic purposes, these conditions amount to an implicit assumption that financial agents possess functionally omniscient knowledge of the economic environment. To form model-consistent expectations, agents must know the correct structural model, the stochastic processes governing exogenous variables, the laws of motion of endogenous states, the equilibrium mappings linking beliefs to outcomes, and the policy regimes shaping future dynamics. Although models do not assume literal omniscience, these informational requirements are sufficient to generate behavior indistinguishable from that of an omniscient agent with respect to macroeconomic decision-making.

The paper introduces the concept of functional omniscience to distinguish this epistemic requirement from assumptions about perfect rationality, cognitive ability, or psychological realism. It shows how functional omniscience enters macroeconomic models mechanically through rational-expectations closure, persists in learning-based extensions, and underwrites representative-agent constructions. When this assumption is relaxed, homogeneous beliefs and representative expectations lose their epistemic justification, and heterogeneity in beliefs and behavior emerges as a structural consequence rather than a modeling choice. FAKE is used as a diagnostic label for an implicit epistemic ground, not as a critique of economists or a claim of methodological error.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"功能性全知"概念，指出宏观经济模型中的理性预期假设实际上要求金融代理人具备对经济环境的近乎全知的知识，包括正确结构模型、外生变量随机过程、内生状态运动规律等，这种隐含的认知假设支撑了同质化信念和代表性代理人构造。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济模型中理性预期假设所隐含的认知条件是什么？这些条件如何影响模型的构建和预测能力？
AI.motivation: 现代宏观经济模型依赖预期来闭合动态系统并生成均衡预测，但这些预期背后的认知条件很少被明确检验。论文旨在揭示理性预期假设实际上要求代理人具备近乎全知的知识，这一隐含假设对模型构建有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能性全知概念、理性预期理论、学习框架、代表性代理人模型、认知经济学
AI.method: 概念分析、理论推导、逻辑论证。通过分析理性预期闭合机制、学习扩展和代表性代理人构造，揭示其中隐含的认知假设。
AI.findings: 1. 理性预期假设实际上要求代理人具备功能性全知知识；2. 这种假设在基于学习的扩展模型中仍然存在；3. 当放松这一假设时，同质化信念和代表性预期失去认知正当性；4. 信念和行为的异质性成为结构性结果而非建模选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"功能性全知"概念，区分认知要求与完美理性、认知能力或心理现实性假设；2. 揭示宏观经济模型中隐含的认知基础；3. 为理解信念异质性提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为宏观经济模型构建提供诊断工具；2. 帮助理解模型预测的局限性；3. 为政策分析提供更现实的认知基础；4. 促进对金融市场中异质信念的更好建模。

title: The Unified Principle: A Unified Celestial Framework and Its Empirical Validation for a Spherical Earth
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title: The Unified Principle: A Unified Celestial Framework and Its Empirical Validation for a Spherical Earth
detail.abstract: This paper presents The Unified Principle (UP), a self-consistent mathematical model of celestial mechanics defined by an Earth orbital period of precisely 364 days () and an Earth rotational period of exactly 6.5 days (). This exact integer relationship yields rotations per orbital cycle, ensuring an intrinsically non-drifting celestial calendar. The principle posits a constant Earth axial tilt of () and describes the Moon's orbit as a consistent helical trajectory relative to the Sun, completing a 28-day synodic cycle. Calibrated to the June 20, 2025 Summer Solstice as Unified Day 1 of Unified Year 1, the principle projects predictable events over a 10-year span. Observations of solar and lunar phenomena at geographically distinct ancient structures-Stonehenge (51.18° N), Giza Pyramids (29.98° N), Brihadisvara Temple (10.78° N), and Machu Picchu (13.16° S)-provide empirical validation for a spherical Earth, derived entirely from the internal mathematical framework of the Unified Principle.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"统一原理"，一个自洽的天体力学数学模型，定义地球轨道周期为364天，自转周期为6.5天，这种整数关系确保了非漂移的天文日历。该原理假设地球轴向倾角恒定，并将月球轨道描述为相对于太阳的稳定螺旋轨迹，完成28天的朔望周期。校准到2025年6月20日夏至作为统一年1年1日，该原理预测了10年跨度内的事件，并通过全球多个古代遗址的观测提供了经验验证。
AI.research_question: 能否建立一个基于整数关系（364天轨道周期和6.5天自转周期）的自洽天体力学模型，并通过全球古代遗址的观测数据进行验证？
AI.motivation: 当前天文日历存在漂移问题，需要建立一个内在非漂移的日历系统。同时，古代文明的天文观测结构提供了验证这种统一原理的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一原理（UP）作为核心理论框架，基于精确的整数关系：地球轨道周期364天，自转周期6.5天，产生56个旋转/轨道周期。还包括恒定地球轴向倾角假设和月球相对于太阳的螺旋轨道模型。
AI.method: 1. 建立统一原理数学模型；2. 校准到2025年6月20日夏至作为基准点；3. 预测10年跨度内的事件；4. 通过四个地理上不同的古代遗址（巨石阵、吉萨金字塔、布里哈迪斯瓦拉神庙、马丘比丘）的太阳和月球现象观测进行经验验证。
AI.findings: 统一原理能够预测太阳和月球现象，且这些预测与全球多个古代遗址的观测结果一致，为球形地球提供了经验验证，完全来自统一原理的内部数学框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于整数关系的自洽天体力学模型，解决了天文日历漂移问题；建立了月球相对于太阳的螺旋轨道理论；提供了从纯数学框架推导地球形状的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 创建了内在非漂移的天文日历系统；为古代天文遗址的解释提供了新框架；展示了如何从数学原理推导出可观测的天文现象，具有教育和文化意义。

title: Foundations of Algorithmic Economics: A TuringWalrasChaitin Framework Part II: Static Equilibrium Theory

detail.title: Foundations of Algorithmic Economics: A TuringWalrasChaitin Framework Part II: Static Equilibrium Theory
detail.abstract: This paper develops the static equilibrium theory for the TuringWalrasChaitin framework. Taking the technological frontier Ω n as given, we formalize the optimization problems of rms and consumers, state the conditions for Walrasian equilibrium with Cobb-Douglas preferences, and establish existence and local stability. We prove four main results: (1) for any nite technological frontier, a competitive equilibrium exists; (2) under gross substitutes, the tâtonnement process converges; (3) the equilibrium is computable in nite time; (4) in the limit as the technological frontier expands to include all halting programs, the equilibrium problem becomes algorithmically undecidable. This nal result is proven via explicit reduction to the halting problem and constitutes the paper's main contribution.

AI.tldr: 该论文为TuringWalrasChaitin框架建立了静态均衡理论，证明了在有限技术前沿下竞争均衡存在且可计算，但当技术前沿扩展到包含所有停机程序时，均衡问题变得算法不可判定。
AI.research_question: 在TuringWalrasChaitin框架中，当技术前沿Ω_n给定时，竞争均衡的存在性、稳定性、可计算性如何？当技术前沿扩展到包含所有停机程序时，均衡问题会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 将计算理论（图灵机）与一般均衡理论（瓦尔拉斯）相结合，研究计算复杂性对经济均衡的影响，探索算法不可判定性在经济理论中的含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: TuringWalrasChaitin框架（结合图灵机、瓦尔拉斯均衡和柴廷信息论）、一般均衡理论、Cobb-Douglas偏好、计算复杂性理论、停机问题。
AI.method: 形式化厂商和消费者的优化问题，陈述Cobb-Douglas偏好下的瓦尔拉斯均衡条件，建立存在性和局部稳定性证明，通过显式归约到停机问题证明算法不可判定性。
AI.findings: 1) 任何有限技术前沿下竞争均衡存在；2) 在总替代条件下，试探过程收敛；3) 均衡在有限时间内可计算；4) 当技术前沿扩展到包含所有停机程序时，均衡问题变得算法不可判定。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了TuringWalrasChaitin框架的静态均衡理论，证明了计算复杂性对经济均衡的根本限制，将算法不可判定性引入经济学理论，为计算经济学提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实经济中计算限制对均衡形成的影响提供理论框架，对算法经济设计、自动化市场机制、智能合约等具有启示意义，揭示了完全理性假设在计算上的局限性。

title: Techno-Economic Assessment of a 500 MW Offshore Wind Farm at Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
affiliations: and

detail.title: Techno-Economic Assessment of a 500 MW Offshore Wind Farm at Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
detail.abstract: The rising electricity demand and decarbonization goals make offshore wind a practical path to energy security for Bangladesh. Yet country-specific, end-to-end studies that connect wind resource to investable economics are limited. This paper evaluates a 500 MW wind farm project of Cox’s Bazar using a transparent, reproducible resource to revenue workflow. ERA5 (2020–2024) wind data are vector combined at 100 m, extrapolated to 150 m and converted to turbine power with air density correction. The model consists of a layout of 42 turbines and considers a conservative, multiplicative loss stack. Techno-economics are calculated in HOMER software and cross checked with a discounted cash flow model reflecting relevant financing (10% nominal WACC, 2% indexation for tariff and O&M) for Bangladesh. The project delivers a net annual energy production of 1.48 TWh at a capacity factor of 33.4% and an engineering LCOE of $98/MWh. The first-year tariff $0.11/kWh, the base case delivers an NPV of $0.41B with a discounted payback in Year 13. Sensitivity results indicate bankability is dominated by WACC and CAPEX while O&M and the capacity factor have secondary influence. Relative to today’s grid, the project would avoid 0.94 Mt CO₂ annually. Overall, the offshore wind project studied here for Bangladesh appears feasible within a $0.10–$0.11/kWh PPA corridor provided policy measures reduce financing risk and support from local supply chains. The workflow and dataset are openly reproducible and can guide site screening and investment decisions in emerging offshore wind markets.

AI.tldr: 本文为孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔地区500MW海上风电项目开发了一个透明、可复现的资源到收益分析工作流，评估了项目的技术经济可行性。结果显示项目年发电量1.48TWh，容量因子33.4%，平准化度电成本98美元/MWh，在0.10-0.11美元/kWh的购电协议价格范围内可行，每年可减少94万吨二氧化碳排放。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔地区500MW海上风电项目在技术经济上是否可行？其投资回报和环境影响如何？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国日益增长的电力需求和脱碳目标使得海上风电成为保障能源安全的可行路径，但缺乏针对该国具体情况的端到端研究，将风资源评估与可投资经济性联系起来的研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源到收益的工作流框架，结合风资源评估、技术建模和经济分析，采用平准化度电成本（LCOE）和净现值（NPV）等投资评估指标。
AI.method: 使用透明、可复现的资源到收益工作流：1）利用ERA5（2020-2024）风数据在100米高度进行矢量合成，外推至150米高度；2）考虑空气密度修正转换为风机功率；3）采用42台风机的布局设计；4）考虑保守的乘性损失堆栈；5）使用HOMER软件进行技术经济分析，并用折现现金流模型交叉验证，反映孟加拉国相关融资条件（10%名义加权平均资本成本，2%电价和运维费用指数化）。
AI.findings: 项目年发电量1.48TWh，容量因子33.4%，工程平准化度电成本98美元/MWh。首年电价0.11美元/kWh，基准情景下净现值4.1亿美元，折现回收期第13年。敏感性分析显示可融资性主要受加权平均资本成本和资本支出影响，运维费用和容量因子为次要影响因素。相比当前电网，项目每年可避免94万吨二氧化碳排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个透明、可复现的资源到收益分析工作流，将风资源评估与可投资经济性联系起来，为新兴海上风电市场的项目筛选和投资决策提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）证明孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔500MW海上风电项目在0.10-0.11美元/kWh购电协议价格范围内可行；2）为政策制定者提供建议：需采取措施降低融资风险并支持本地供应链发展；3）提供公开可复现的工作流和数据集，指导新兴海上风电市场的项目筛选和投资决策。

title: A Systems-based Framework for Embedding Generative AI in Financial Decision Systems

detail.title: A Systems-based Framework for Embedding Generative AI in Financial Decision Systems
detail.abstract:
The increasing adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in financial markets has
largely been driven by prompt-centric and model-focused experimentation. While such
approaches demonstrate localized capabilities, they frequently fail when confronted with
the structural requirements of financial systems, including auditability, regulatory
compliance, contextual stability, and accountability. This paper proposes a
comprehensive systems-based framework for embedding generative AI within financial
decision systems.
The framework conceptualizes AI models not as autonomous decision-makers but as
reasoning components embedded within structured, observable, and auditable workflows.
It explicitly separates deterministic computation, AI-driven inference, contextual memory
via retrieval-augmented systems, and human judgment, all operating under continuous
observability and governance. The framework is intentionally non-linear and iterative,
reflecting the reflexive nature of financial reasoning.
Through extended, operationally realistic scenarios spanning mutual fund research,
trading research, and risk management, this paper demonstrates how the framework
generalizes across financial domains. The paper further develops a taxonomy of failure
modes observed in practice, proposes a system-level evaluation lens for AI models, and
maps the framework to emerging regulatory requirements, particularly the European Union
Artificial Intelligence Act. The contribution of this paper is conceptual rather than
algorithmic, offering a durable mental model for applying AI in finance under uncertainty,
regulation, and accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于系统的框架，将生成式AI嵌入金融决策系统，将AI模型视为结构化、可观察、可审计工作流中的推理组件，而非自主决策者。该框架分离确定性计算、AI驱动推理、上下文记忆和人类判断，并通过实际金融场景验证其跨领域适用性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统化的框架，使生成式AI能够有效嵌入金融决策系统，同时满足审计性、监管合规、上下文稳定性和问责制等结构性要求？
AI.motivation: 当前金融市场中生成式AI的采用主要基于提示中心和模型中心的实验方法，这些方法在面临金融系统的结构性要求（如审计性、监管合规、上下文稳定性、问责制）时经常失败，需要更系统化的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统化框架将AI模型视为结构化工作流中的推理组件，明确分离：1)确定性计算，2)AI驱动推理，3)通过检索增强系统的上下文记忆，4)人类判断，所有操作都在持续可观察性和治理下进行。框架具有非线性和迭代特性，反映金融推理的反射性本质。
AI.method: 通过扩展的、操作上现实的场景进行验证，涵盖共同基金研究、交易研究和风险管理等金融领域。开发实践中观察到的故障模式分类法，提出AI模型的系统级评估视角，并将框架映射到新兴监管要求（特别是欧盟人工智能法案）。
AI.findings: 该框架在多个金融领域（共同基金研究、交易研究、风险管理）具有普遍适用性。识别了实践中观察到的故障模式，建立了系统级AI评估方法，并成功将框架映射到欧盟AI法案等监管要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出将生成式AI嵌入金融决策系统的概念框架；2) 将AI模型重新概念化为结构化工作流中的推理组件而非自主决策者；3) 开发金融AI故障模式分类法；4) 建立AI模型的系统级评估视角；5) 提供在不确定性、监管和问责制下应用AI的持久心智模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为金融机构提供可操作的系统化AI实施框架；2) 帮助组织满足审计和监管合规要求；3) 通过结构化工作流提高AI系统的可靠性和问责性；4) 为AI在金融领域的实际应用提供指导；5) 支持组织应对欧盟AI法案等新兴监管挑战。

title: The Wynn Framework
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Wynn Framework
detail.abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information, human decision-making has become increasingly unstable. Individuals and institutions exhibit escalating conflict, defensive rigidity, and explanatory overload. These failures are commonly attributed to ignorance, moral deficiency, or incentive misalignment. This framework rejects those explanations. Human instability is not primarily a failure of intelligence, character, or motivation. It is a failure of coordination under uncertainty. Humans are biologically near-identical pattern-matching systems operating without reliable shared reference points. When decentralized agents lack signals that are both observable and known to be observable by others, coordination becomes underdetermined. In this condition, timing, intent, and meaning cannot reliably align. Ambiguity is resolved locally, narratives substitute for structure, and defensive stabilization becomes the system default. The Wynn Framework formalizes this failure mode. It treats human conflict as an engineering problem rather than a psychological or moral one, identifying the absence or degradation of common-knowledge coordination signals as the primary driver of misunderstanding across scales — from interpersonal conflict to institutional collapse. Trust, cooperation, and equilibrium are treated not as virtues to be cultivated, but as emergent properties of systems with sufficient coordination integrity. This work does not offer a universal theory of mind. It offers a structural diagnostic and repair architecture: a set of primitives and protocols designed to reduce interpretive load, restore shared reference, and convert defensive rigidity back into inquiry. Its validity is measured by a single criterion: Does it reduce misunderstanding without requiring persuasion, virtue, or belief?

AI.tldr: 论文提出人类决策不稳定的根本原因不是智力、道德或动机问题，而是不确定性下的协调失败。当去中心化个体缺乏可靠共享参照点时，协调变得不确定，导致冲突、防御性僵化和解释过载。Wynn框架将此视为工程问题而非心理/道德问题，提供结构诊断和修复架构。
AI.research_question: 人类决策不稳定的根本原因是什么？如何从系统协调角度而非心理/道德角度解释和解决人际冲突到制度崩溃的误解问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管信息获取空前便利，但人类决策却越来越不稳定，个体和机构表现出冲突升级、防御性僵化和解释过载。传统解释（无知、道德缺陷、激励错配）不足以解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wynn框架：将人类冲突视为工程问题而非心理或道德问题。核心理论是协调失败理论——当去中心化个体缺乏可靠共享参照点（共同知识协调信号）时，协调变得不确定，导致误解和冲突。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和形式化方法。提出结构诊断和修复架构，包括一组原语和协议，旨在减少解释负担、恢复共享参照点，将防御性僵化转化为探究。
AI.findings: 人类不稳定性主要是协调失败而非智力、性格或动机问题。当缺乏可观察且被他人知晓的可观察信号时，协调变得不确定，导致时间、意图和意义无法可靠对齐，最终产生冲突和防御性稳定化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出人类冲突的协调失败理论；2. 将信任、合作和均衡视为具有足够协调完整性的系统的涌现属性；3. 提供结构诊断框架而非普遍心智理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的修复架构：原语和协议设计，可在不需要说服、美德或信念的情况下减少误解。有效性标准：能否在不要求说服、美德或信念的情况下减少误解。

title:
The Voynich Mandate: Section-by-Section Decipherment 
A Complete Unveiling of Universal Code
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title:
The Voynich Mandate: Section-by-Section Decipherment 
A Complete Unveiling of Universal Code
detail.abstract: The Voynich Manuscript has long been considered an indecipherable enigma, with centuries of cryptographic, linguistic, and historical inquiry yielding no consensus on its content or meaning. This manuscript introduces a systematic framework for interpreting the Voynich Manuscript through the lens of the Unified Principle, a universal method for identifying recurring patterns and structures across scales-from biological growth to cosmic mechanics. By treating each section of the manuscript as a precise repository of encoded directives, this study deciphers actionable instructions in four domains: botanical generation, astronomical alignment, fluid and biological systems, and cosmological architecture. The methodology combines fractal analysis, L-system modeling, orbital mechanics, network flow theory, and symmetry operations to map underlying mathematical principles encoded in the manuscript. While the literal language remains unknown, the structure, patterns, and algorithmic regularities reveal a sophisticated, universal system of design that can be applied across biology, cosmology, and physical systems. This work establishes a rigorous, verifiable approach to understanding the Voynich Manuscript's instructions, demonstrating that even in the absence of semantic clarity, its internal logic embodies a complete and actionable blueprint for universal order.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过统一原理框架解读伏尼契手稿，将其视为包含植物生成、天文对齐、流体生物系统和宇宙建筑指令的编码存储库，揭示了跨越尺度的数学设计系统。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统框架解读伏尼契手稿中编码的指令和模式，即使在其语言未知的情况下？
AI.motivation: 伏尼契手稿几个世纪以来一直被认为是无法破译的谜团，密码学、语言学和历史学研究未能就其内容和含义达成共识，需要新的方法论突破。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一原理（Unified Principle）作为识别跨尺度重复模式和结构的通用方法，从生物生长到宇宙力学，为解读手稿提供了理论框架。
AI.method: 结合分形分析、L系统建模、轨道力学、网络流理论和对称操作，映射手稿中编码的底层数学原理。
AI.findings: 手稿的结构、模式和算法规律揭示了一个精密的通用设计系统，包含四个领域的可操作指令：植物生成、天文对齐、流体生物系统和宇宙建筑。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了即使在缺乏语义清晰度的情况下，通过分析内部逻辑和数学模式来理解编码指令的严谨、可验证方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了伏尼契手稿的内部逻辑体现了完整且可操作的宇宙秩序蓝图，可应用于生物学、宇宙学和物理系统设计。

title: Foundations of Algorithmic Economics: A Turing-Walras-Chaitin Framework. Part III: Endogenous Technological Change and Supercomputational Growth

detail.title: Foundations of Algorithmic Economics: A Turing-Walras-Chaitin Framework. Part III: Endogenous Technological Change and Supercomputational Growth
detail.abstract: This paper develops the growth theory for the Turing-Walras-Chaitin framework. We prove that economic output grows faster than any computable function of the technological frontier-a property we call supercomputational growth. The result follows from the connection between the technology count H(n) = |T n | and Chaitin's incomputable constant Ω. We establish that the number of available technologies is itself not computable, and that with Dixit-Stiglitz preferences (which exhibit love of variety), output inherits this supercomputational character. We also formalize returns to technological complexity, providing a computational foundation for gains from knowledge combination. The framework exhibits distinct growth regimes-Malthusian trap, industrial takeoff, and sustained growth-with transitions determined by the relationship between technological exploration and population dynamics. The dynamics of exploration and conditions for economic takeoff are deferred to Part IV, where they will be implemented computationally.

AI.tldr: 本文在Turing-Walras-Chaitin框架下发展增长理论，证明经济产出增长速度超过任何可计算函数，称为超计算增长。这源于技术数量与Chaitin不可计算常数Ω的联系。技术数量本身不可计算，在Dixit-Stiglitz偏好下产出继承超计算特性。框架呈现马尔萨斯陷阱、工业起飞和持续增长三种增长体制。
AI.research_question: 在Turing-Walras-Chaitin框架下，经济产出增长与技术进步的关系是什么？技术数量的不可计算性如何影响经济增长特征？
AI.motivation: 传统增长理论通常假设技术进步是可计算的，但现实中的技术创新过程可能具有不可计算的特征。本文旨在探索当技术数量本身不可计算时，经济增长会呈现何种新特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Turing-Walras-Chaitin框架（结合图灵计算理论、瓦尔拉斯一般均衡和Chaitin不可计算理论）、Dixit-Stiglitz偏好（品种偏好）、技术复杂性收益理论、知识组合收益的计算基础
AI.method: 理论证明方法：证明技术数量H(n) = |T_n|与Chaitin不可计算常数Ω的联系；数学推导经济产出增长特性；形式化技术复杂性收益；分析不同增长体制的转换条件
AI.findings: 1. 经济产出增长速度超过任何可计算函数（超计算增长）；2. 可用技术数量本身不可计算；3. 在Dixit-Stiglitz偏好下，产出继承超计算特性；4. 框架呈现三种增长体制：马尔萨斯陷阱、工业起飞和持续增长
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在增长理论中引入不可计算性概念；2. 建立技术数量与Chaitin常数Ω的理论联系；3. 提出超计算增长的新概念；4. 为知识组合收益提供计算理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释经济增长中的非线性跃迁现象；2. 为理解技术探索与人口动态的相互作用提供框架；3. 帮助政策制定者识别经济增长体制转换的关键条件

title: The Many Shades of Uncertainty and Monetary Policy
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Many Shades of Uncertainty and Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 978
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper reviews how different sources of uncertainty influence monetary policy design and transmission. Within a New Keynesian framework, we distinguish between uncertainty arising from non-linearities in the economy and that stemming from imperfect information held by either the central bank or the private sector. While uncertainty is neutral under linearity and full-information rational expectations, departures from these conditions render it consequential for monetary policy. Non-linearities and information frictions alter the optimal degree of policy gradualism and may warrant either more forceful or more cautious responses. The proposed taxonomy offers a structured approach for policy discussions concerning appropriate monetary responses and communication strategies in the face of different types of uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文在New Keynesian框架下，系统分析了非线性经济结构和信息不对称两类不确定性如何影响货币政策设计与传导，提出了相应的政策应对策略。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的不确定性（源于经济非线性结构或信息不对称）如何影响货币政策的设计与传导？
AI.motivation: 现实经济中存在各种不确定性，但传统货币政策理论通常假设线性经济和完全信息理性预期，这限制了政策制定的有效性。需要系统分析不同类型不确定性对货币政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: New Keynesian框架，区分两类不确定性：1）经济非线性结构产生的不确定性；2）央行与私人部门信息不对称产生的不确定性。
AI.method: 理论分析与文献综述，在New Keynesian框架下构建分类体系，分析不同不确定性来源对货币政策传导机制的影响。
AI.findings: 在线性经济和完全信息理性预期下，不确定性是中性的；但在非线性经济或信息不对称条件下，不确定性显著影响货币政策。非线性结构和信息摩擦会改变最优政策的渐进程度，可能要求更激进或更谨慎的政策反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统的不确定性分类框架，阐明了不同不确定性来源对货币政策传导的理论机制，丰富了New Keynesian框架下的政策分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了结构化分析工具，帮助设计针对不同类型不确定性的适当货币政策反应和沟通策略，提高政策有效性。

title: The use of Robo-Advisors in Italy: Insights from a New Survey
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The use of Robo-Advisors in Italy: Insights from a New Survey

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 979
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Robo-advisors, the provision of (affordable) financial advice through algorithms on digital platforms, offer great potential to increase participation in financial markets by private individuals. However, like any innovation in finance, opportunities also come with challenges. Based on data from a recent survey of 5,000 individuals, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the characteristics of individuals who use robo-advisors in a country such as Italy, where participation in financial markets is traditionally low, and assess the influence of this technology on the general public’s propensity to make financial investments. Our results show that (i) the adoption of robo-advisors is higher among individuals with greater digital skills but limited financial knowledge; (ii) the adoption of robo-advisors positively influences the propensity to purchase financial assets, such as stocks, bonds, and investment funds.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于意大利5000人的调查数据，分析机器人顾问使用者的特征及其对公众投资倾向的影响。研究发现：数字技能高但金融知识有限的人更可能使用机器人顾问；使用机器人顾问能提高购买股票、债券和基金等金融资产的倾向。
AI.research_question: 在意大利等金融市场参与度低的地区，哪些人群特征与机器人顾问使用相关？机器人顾问技术如何影响公众的金融投资倾向？
AI.motivation: 机器人顾问通过算法提供可负担的金融建议，有潜力提高个人参与金融市场的程度，但机遇与挑战并存。需要了解在传统金融市场参与度低的地区（如意大利），哪些人使用机器人顾问以及这种技术如何影响投资行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融科技采纳理论、数字鸿沟理论、行为金融学理论（特别是关于金融知识、数字技能与投资决策的关系）
AI.method: 基于5000名个体的调查数据进行实证分析，采用统计方法分析机器人顾问使用者的特征及其对投资倾向的影响
AI.findings: 1. 机器人顾问采纳率在数字技能较高但金融知识有限的个体中更高；2. 使用机器人顾问对购买股票、债券和投资基金等金融资产的倾向有积极影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了金融科技采纳理论，特别是在传统低参与度市场的应用；揭示了数字技能与金融知识在机器人顾问采纳中的交互作用；为理解算法建议如何影响投资行为提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司设计机器人顾问产品提供目标用户洞察；为政策制定者促进金融市场包容性提供依据；帮助金融机构理解如何通过数字工具扩大客户基础

title: Observational Study of Natural Approaches using Relationship-Driven Theory
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Observational Study of Natural Approaches using Relationship-Driven Theory
detail.abstract: This paper applies the design philosophy of Patent No. 7059476 (Relationship-Driven Theory) to analyze the "inconsistencies" that the natural environment exerts on human civilization. By adopting an engineering perspective, we redefine global systemic inconsistencies-traditionally viewed as mere "natural threats"-as "Controllable Guardrails" within a macro-system. By examining historical human struggles against nature, this study verifies how we can exercise control over these "Upper Nodes." The objective is to describe how the current design philosophy, which treats environmental inconsistencies as errors to be excluded, leads to the stagnation of drive energy, and to propose a new protocol for dynamic coexistence through active refactoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文将专利7059476的关系驱动理论应用于分析自然环境对人类文明的"不一致性"，将全球系统性不一致重新定义为宏观系统中的"可控护栏"，并提出通过主动重构实现动态共存的协议。
AI.research_question: 如何将自然环境对人类文明的不一致性从"自然威胁"重新定义为"可控护栏"，并通过主动重构实现动态共存？
AI.motivation: 当前设计哲学将环境不一致性视为需要排除的错误，导致驱动力能量停滞，需要新的方法来处理人类与自然的动态关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利7059476的关系驱动理论，将系统不一致性视为可控的宏观系统元素。
AI.method: 采用工程学视角，通过历史人类与自然斗争案例研究，验证对"上层节点"的控制能力。
AI.findings: 自然环境的不一致性可以被重新定义为"可控护栏"，人类能够通过主动重构实现对"上层节点"的控制，从而避免驱动力停滞。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将环境不一致性从威胁重新定义为可控系统元素的理论框架，拓展了关系驱动理论在宏观系统分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了新的动态共存协议，为处理人类与自然关系提供了工程化的解决方案，有助于避免文明发展中的驱动力停滞。

title: The Functioning of the Tax Justice System: Microdata Evidence from Italy
affiliations: Banca d’Italia, Bank of Italy and Northwestern University

detail.title: The Functioning of the Tax Justice System: Microdata Evidence from Italy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 980
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study provides a concise overview of the legal framework governing tax litigation in Italy and documents some stylized facts concerning its functioning, using data on corporate tax disputes. The analyses show that the number of disputes has declined, relative to the early 2010s, partly due to the deflationary effect of the mandatory tax mediation introduced in 2011. On the other hand, the average duration of proceedings and the rate of reversal of decisions between first and second instance have remained broadly stable. By linking litigation data to the financial statements of the population of joint-stock companies, the study identifies factors associated with the incidence of disputes. The analysis reveals a higher concentration of litigation in the manufacturing and trade sectors, as well as in the South. Involvement in tax litigation is associated with a deterioration in corporate performance and with higher exit rates following disputes with negative outcomes, particularly for smaller and more highly indebted firms. The data show a reduction in activity for both successful and unsuccessful firms, suggesting that the uncertainty and costs associated with tax litigation play a significant as well as negative role.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了意大利税务诉讼的法律框架，使用公司税务争议数据发现：争议数量下降（部分归因于2011年强制税务调解），但诉讼平均时长和上诉翻案率保持稳定。制造业、贸易业和南部地区争议更集中，税务诉讼与公司业绩恶化相关，特别是对小型高负债企业，无论诉讼结果如何都会导致业务缩减。
AI.research_question: 意大利税务诉讼的法律框架如何运作？税务争议与公司特征和绩效有何关联？强制税务调解对争议数量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解意大利税务诉讼系统的运作机制，分析税务争议对企业的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律经济学、公司治理理论、税务合规理论、诉讼成本理论
AI.method: 实证分析：使用公司税务争议数据与股份公司财务报表数据进行关联分析，描述性统计与回归分析
AI.findings: 1) 税务争议数量相对2010年代初下降（部分因强制调解）；2) 诉讼时长和上诉翻案率稳定；3) 制造业、贸易业和南部地区争议更集中；4) 税务诉讼与公司业绩恶化相关；5) 小型高负债企业在败诉后退出率更高；6) 无论诉讼结果如何，企业活动都会减少
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税务诉讼与企业绩效关系的理解，提供了强制调解政策效果的实证证据，扩展了法律经济学在税务领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供税务诉讼改革依据，帮助企业了解税务诉讼风险，为司法系统效率改进提供参考

title: Decomposing Migration Drivers: Push-Pull Effects of Political, Financial, and Socioeconomic Institutions Versus Network Effects in OECD Migration

detail.title: Decomposing Migration Drivers: Push-Pull Effects of Political, Financial, and Socioeconomic Institutions Versus Network Effects in OECD Migration

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Journal of Political Economy, volume 93, 2026[10.1016/j.ejpoleco.2026.102810]

detail.abstract: This paper explores the relative importance of key migration drivers and examines how institutional quality influences migration rates using a classical migration model and data from OECD countries over the period 1985-2015. Within a fixed-effects framework, we develop a novel analytical framework using comprehensive institutional quality indices constructed from International Country Risk Guide (ICRG) to capture both pushing and pulling effects. Our variance decomposition analysis reveals that network effects account for 43.73% of the total explained variance in general migration inflows, but only 11.29% for inflow workers and 2.35% for foreign students changing status. Pushing and pulling effects contribute 23.02%and 16.49%, respectively, to general migration inflows, while f or inflow workers, pushing effects dominate, explaining 34.96% compared to 18.78% for pulling effects. Among foreign students changing status, these effects are more balanced, contributing 30.52% and 30.05%, respectively. A deeper analysis of institutional qualities shows that political quality dominate both pushing and pulling effects across most specifications, except for foreign students changing status, where 46.67% of the pulling-effects variance i s explained by socioeconomic factors, compared to 40.68% for political factors. Additionally, geographical distance is the most significant factor in bi lateral migration costs, contributing over 75% across all specifications. These findings help policymakers better understand the complex roles o f networks, institutional qualities, migration costs, etc. in shaping migration patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文使用OECD国家1985-2015年数据，通过固定效应模型分析移民驱动因素。研究发现网络效应、制度质量推拉效应和地理距离对移民模式有不同影响，其中网络效应在一般移民流入中解释力最强（43.73%），而地理距离在双边移民成本中贡献超过75%。
AI.research_question: 关键移民驱动因素的相对重要性是什么？制度质量如何影响移民率？
AI.motivation: 理解移民决策的复杂驱动因素，特别是制度质量在推拉效应中的作用，为政策制定者提供更深入的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典移民模型，结合制度质量理论，使用ICRG构建的综合制度质量指数来捕捉推拉效应。
AI.method: 固定效应框架，使用OECD国家1985-2015年数据，方差分解分析，构建综合制度质量指数（基于ICRG数据）。
AI.findings: 1. 网络效应在一般移民流入中解释43.73%的方差，但在工人流入和学生转身份中分别只有11.29%和2.35%；2. 推拉效应在一般移民中分别贡献23.02%和16.49%；3. 政治质量在大多数情况下主导推拉效应；4. 地理距离在双边移民成本中贡献超过75%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了包含制度质量推拉效应的新分析框架；2. 量化了不同移民驱动因素的相对重要性；3. 揭示了制度质量各维度对不同移民群体的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助政策制定者理解网络、制度质量和移民成本在塑造移民模式中的复杂作用；2. 为移民政策设计提供实证依据；3. 揭示了针对不同移民群体需要采取差异化政策干预。

title: The Resilience of Italy’s External Sector Amidst Risks and Challenges
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Resilience of Italy’s External Sector Amidst Risks and Challenges

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 981
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores recent macro developments in Italy’s external sector. Despite a succession of adverse shocks and a challenging international context, Italy’s export performance between 2019 and 2024 was quite resilient, overall, boosted by cost competitiveness gains, geographical and sectoral diversification, good quality positioning, the recovery in international tourism, and by growth in business, financial and insurance services. The current account (CA) balance has been persistently positive, with the temporary exception of the 2022 energy crisis. Its more modest level in 2024 (relative to 2019) mainly reflects a weaker investment income balance, due to the higher reactivity of external liabilities to increased interest rates compared with external assets. In our view, the CA balance is broadly in line with fundamentals; external sector resilience is confirmed by a solid creditor net international investment position (NIIP). Looking forward, exports will be negatively impacted by US tariffs, exchange rate appreciation and growing competition from China, although Italy is projected to maintain both a CA surplus and a creditor NIIP in the short term. Over the medium term, the country’s ability to navigate the significant challenges arising from geo-economic fragmentation, the green and digital transitions, and structural changes in world demand will be key to a sound performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2019-2024年意大利外部部门的宏观表现，发现尽管面临多重冲击，意大利出口表现出韧性，经常账户持续盈余，净国际投资头寸保持债权国地位。未来面临美国关税、汇率升值和来自中国的竞争等挑战。
AI.research_question: 2019-2024年意大利外部部门的宏观表现如何？其出口韧性、经常账户平衡和净国际投资头寸的驱动因素是什么？未来面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 研究意大利在连续不利冲击（如能源危机）和挑战性国际环境下的外部部门表现，评估其经济韧性，为政策制定提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际经济学理论，包括出口竞争力理论、经常账户决定因素、净国际投资头寸分析，以及地缘经济碎片化对贸易的影响。
AI.method: 宏观数据分析方法，分析2019-2024年意大利出口表现、经常账户平衡、净国际投资头寸等关键指标，识别驱动因素和挑战。
AI.findings: 1. 意大利出口表现出韧性，受益于成本竞争力提升、地理和行业多元化、高质量定位、国际旅游复苏及商业金融服务增长；2. 经常账户持续盈余（2022年能源危机除外），2024年盈余减少主要因外部负债对利率上升的反应比外部资产更敏感；3. 净国际投资头寸保持债权国地位；4. 未来面临美国关税、汇率升值和中国竞争的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了在多重冲击下外部部门韧性的理论理解，提供了关于利率变化对经常账户影响的新视角，拓展了地缘经济碎片化对贸易影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了意大利外部部门表现的全面评估，识别了未来风险（如美国关税、中国竞争），强调了应对地缘经济碎片化、绿色和数字转型以及全球需求结构变化的重要性。

title: A Cosmic Distance Ladder: Sacred Accountancy via the Unified Principle
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title: A Cosmic Distance Ladder: Sacred Accountancy via the Unified Principle
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a radical recalibration of the Cosmic Distance Ladder by replacing fluctuating temporal variables with a fixed Sacred Accountancy anchored in integer geometry. Conventional mathematics, while correct in operation, utilizes flawed inputs-specifically the Gregorian calendar-which suffers from "calendar drift" and an inability to establish a universal zero-point for simultaneity. The Unified Principle (UP) resolves these instabilities by externalizing temporal error into a geometric constant: the 1.242-day Primary Angular Shift. By utilizing the Stonehenge Geodetic Engine and its 56-point Aubrey Hole ledger, the UP identifies celestial events as fixed angular coordinates rather than civil timestamps. This methodology enables the precise, drift-free tracing of helical solar and lunar cycles, planetary conjunctions, and galactic epochs such as the Yuga cycles, ultimately proving that the scale of the universe can be measured from a single, non-drifting terrestrial baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用固定的神圣会计学取代波动的时间变量来重新校准宇宙距离阶梯，通过将时间误差外化为几何常数（1.242天初级角位移），利用巨石阵大地测量引擎实现无漂移的天体测量。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个无漂移的宇宙距离测量系统，解决传统历法的时间漂移问题？
AI.motivation: 传统历法（如格里高利历）存在"日历漂移"问题，无法建立统一的零时点，导致宇宙距离测量存在不稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一原理（UP）：将时间误差外化为几何常数（1.242天初级角位移），利用整数几何建立固定的神圣会计学框架。
AI.method: 使用巨石阵大地测量引擎及其56点奥布里孔分类账，将天体事件视为固定角坐标而非民用时间戳，精确追踪螺旋太阳和月球周期、行星合相和银河纪元。
AI.findings: 宇宙尺度可以从单一、无漂移的地面基线进行测量，证明了使用几何常数替代时间变量的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于整数几何的神圣会计学理论框架，重新定义了宇宙距离测量的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为天体测量提供了无漂移的测量方法，可用于精确追踪各种天体周期和银河纪元。

title: Cognitive Safety and Algorithmic Literacy in Public-Aligned AI Homeschool Education

detail.title: Cognitive Safety and Algorithmic Literacy in Public-Aligned AI Homeschool Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial, personal, or professional relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a theoretical and conceptual framework analysis and did not involve human participants, personal data, or identifiable subjects. Therefore, formal ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of digital platforms and algorithmic content systems has reshaped the information environment in which children learn, socialize, and form beliefs. Homeschool education, while academically robust in many respects, often lacks structured, research-anchored instruction in algorithmic literacy, digital safety, and cognitive resilience. This gap is especially consequential for learners from historically underserved communities, including Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) students, who face unique accessibility and information-processing challenges. Drawing on interdisciplinary research in media literacy, digital cognition, and inclusive education, this paper proposes the Public-Aligned AI Homeschool Cognitive Safety Framework-a scalable curriculum model designed to integrate critical algorithmic literacy, media analysis, and cognitive safety within academically equivalent homeschool learning. The framework positions AI literacy not as a replacement for foundational learning but as a harmonized extension required for equitable participation in the digital age.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向公立学校对齐的AI家庭教育认知安全框架，旨在解决家庭教育中算法素养、数字安全和认知韧性教育的缺失问题，特别关注听障等弱势群体学生的需求。
AI.research_question: 如何为家庭教育设计一个可扩展的课程模型，整合关键算法素养、媒体分析和认知安全，以弥补家庭教育在数字时代教育中的结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 数字平台和算法内容系统的快速普及重塑了儿童学习、社交和形成信念的信息环境。家庭教育虽然在学术上具有优势，但在算法素养、数字安全和认知韧性方面缺乏结构化、研究支撑的教学，这一差距对听障等历史上服务不足社区的学习者尤为严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于媒体素养、数字认知和包容性教育的跨学科研究，构建公立学校对齐的AI家庭教育认知安全框架。
AI.method: 提出一个可扩展的课程模型框架设计，将AI素养作为基础学习的协调扩展而非替代。
AI.findings: 提出了一个具体的框架设计，将AI素养定位为数字时代公平参与的必要扩展，特别关注听障学生的独特可访问性和信息处理挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了家庭教育与数字素养教育的理论连接；2) 提出了算法素养作为数字时代公平参与的核心要素；3) 为包容性教育理论提供了针对听障学生的具体应用框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一个可扩展的课程模型供家庭教育采用；2) 为听障等弱势群体学生设计了针对性的数字安全教育方案；3) 为教育政策制定者提供了整合数字素养教育的实践框架。

title: The International Transmission of Chinese Monetary Policy and the Commodity Channel
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The International Transmission of Chinese Monetary Policy and the Commodity Channel

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1510
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the international transmission of Chinese monetary policy. We show that, unlike the financial channel typical of US monetary policy, Chinese policy shocks propagate through a real-side demand mechanism, driven by monetary-fiscal interactions that stimulate commodity-intensive infrastructure investment. Consistent with this channel, metal and energy commodity prices are the most responsive to Chinese monetary policy shocks. We quantify the resulting inflationary spillovers using counterfactual methods. The commodity channel accounts for approximately 70 per cent of producer price spillovers to advanced economies, with the largest impact concentrated in countries heavily dependent on commodity imports, such as the four largest European economies. Finally, Chinese monetary policy significantly affects financing conditions in commodity-exporting emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现中国货币政策通过实际需求渠道而非金融渠道进行国际传导，主要通过货币-财政互动刺激大宗商品密集型基础设施投资，影响大宗商品价格，进而对发达经济体产生通胀溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 中国货币政策如何在国际间传导？其传导机制与美国货币政策有何不同？这种传导对全球通胀和新兴市场融资条件产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 理解中国货币政策对全球经济的独特影响机制，特别是考虑到中国作为全球第二大经济体和主要大宗商品消费国，其政策传导可能不同于传统的美国货币政策金融渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 货币政策国际传导理论；2. 货币-财政互动理论；3. 大宗商品价格传导机制；4. 通胀溢出效应理论
AI.method: 使用反事实方法量化通胀溢出效应，分析中国货币政策冲击对大宗商品价格的影响，并评估对发达经济体生产者价格和新兴市场融资条件的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 中国货币政策通过实际需求渠道传导，而非金融渠道；2. 金属和能源大宗商品价格对中国货币政策冲击最敏感；3. 大宗商品渠道解释了约70%对发达经济体的生产者价格溢出；4. 对大宗商品进口依赖度高的欧洲四大经济体影响最大；5. 中国货币政策显著影响大宗商品出口新兴市场的融资条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了中国货币政策独特的实际需求传导机制；2. 区分了中美货币政策国际传导的差异；3. 建立了货币-财政互动刺激基础设施投资的理论框架；4. 完善了大宗商品价格在政策传导中的作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解中国货币政策全球影响提供依据；2. 帮助大宗商品进口国管理通胀风险；3. 为新兴市场国家评估外部融资条件变化提供参考；4. 为国际政策协调提供实证基础。

title: Beyond Belief: Why Institutional Conditions Matter More than Cognition in the Study of Conspiracy Thinking

detail.title: Beyond Belief: Why Institutional Conditions Matter More than Cognition in the Study of Conspiracy Thinking

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or primary empirical research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Research on conspiracy thinking has largely centered belief as its primary object of explanation, attributing conspiratorial beliefs to cognitive bias, psychological predisposition, or informational distortion. While this literature has generated important insights into individual-level mechanisms, it has struggled to account for the persistence, diffusion, and cross-context recurrence of conspiratorial beliefs. This article argues that these limitations stem from a mis-specified analytic focus: belief is treated as a causal variable rather than as an outcome shaped by institutional conditions. 
Drawing on a selective review of psychological, sociological, and media-oriented approaches, the article identifies a shared assumption underlying belief-centered modelsthat conspiratorial belief reflects epistemic deficiency rather than responses conditioned by features of the institutional environment. The paper then advances an alternative framing in which conspiracy thinking emerges within contexts characterized by opacity, weak accountability, and narrative insufficiency. Under such conditions, belief correction alone cannot stabilize authoritative interpretation. 
Rather than proposing a comprehensive theory, the article offers a reframing intervention that shifts analytic attention from belief content to the institutional conditions that structure credibility, authority, and interpretive stability. This shift has implications for research design, measurement, and comparative analysis in the study of conspiracy thinking.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判了现有阴谋论研究过度关注"信念"本身，认为这无法解释阴谋论的持续性、扩散性和跨情境复现性。作者提出应将分析焦点从信念内容转向制度条件，认为阴谋思维是在不透明、问责薄弱和叙事不足的制度环境中产生的。
AI.research_question: 为什么现有阴谋论研究难以解释阴谋信念的持续性、扩散性和跨情境复现性？如何通过制度视角重新框架阴谋思维研究？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要将阴谋信念归因于认知偏差、心理倾向或信息扭曲，这些个体层面的解释无法充分解释阴谋论的社会性特征和制度性根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判心理学、社会学和媒体研究中的"信念中心模型"，提出制度理论视角，强调不透明性、问责薄弱和叙事不足的制度环境对阴谋思维的影响。
AI.method: 选择性文献综述，对心理学、社会学和媒体导向方法进行批判性分析，提出概念性重新框架。
AI.findings: 信念中心模型共享一个假设：阴谋信念反映认知缺陷而非对制度环境的反应。阴谋思维在不透明、问责薄弱和叙事不足的制度环境中更易出现，仅靠信念修正无法稳定权威解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将分析焦点从信念内容转向制度条件；2) 提出制度环境（不透明性、问责薄弱、叙事不足）塑造阴谋思维的理论框架；3) 重新概念化阴谋思维为对制度缺陷的回应而非认知缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为研究设计提供新方向：关注制度变量而非个体信念；2) 改进测量方法：评估制度条件而非信念强度；3) 促进比较分析：跨不同制度环境的阴谋思维研究。

title: Measuring the Impact of Property Insurance Premiums on the Mortgage Market
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago and Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago

detail.title: Measuring the Impact of Property Insurance Premiums on the Mortgage Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Chicago Working Paper No. 2026-01
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago Research Paper Series
