detail.abstract: We document that increases in property insurance premiums reduce mortgage originations. The effect is strongest for the rate refinancing and cash-out refinancing segments. We show that denials associated with increased premiums are significantly more likely attributed to high debt-to-income ratios and insufficient collateral. Across the income spectrum, the effect is concentrated among highly levered borrowers. Our results suggest that increases in property insurance premiums could attenuate the refinancing channel of monetary policy as fewer borrowers are able to take advantage of lower rates.

AI.tldr: 房产保险费上涨会减少抵押贷款发放，特别是再融资和现金再融资，主要影响高杠杆借款人，可能削弱货币政策的再融资传导渠道
AI.research_question: 房产保险费上涨如何影响抵押贷款发放，特别是对不同类型贷款和借款人的影响？
AI.motivation: 房产保险费上涨可能影响借款人获得抵押贷款的能力，进而影响货币政策的再融资传导渠道，但相关研究较少
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷约束理论，保险费上涨增加借款人总债务负担，影响债务收入比和抵押品价值评估
AI.method: 实证分析，使用房产保险费和抵押贷款发放数据，考察不同贷款类型和借款人特征的影响差异
AI.findings: 1) 保险费上涨减少抵押贷款发放；2) 对利率再融资和现金再融资影响最大；3) 拒绝原因主要是高债务收入比和抵押品不足；4) 主要影响高杠杆借款人
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了信贷约束理论在保险费变化情境下的应用，揭示了保险费作为信贷约束机制的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提醒政策制定者注意保险费上涨对货币政策传导的影响；2) 帮助贷款机构理解保险费变化对信贷风险的影响；3) 为借款人提供风险预警

title: Building a Multi-Topic Kafka Streams Pipeline for Real-Time SKU Enrichment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Building a Multi-Topic Kafka Streams Pipeline for Real-Time SKU Enrichment

contentType.other: Event Driven Architecture : Kafka Streaming from multiple topics No Joins), group by Key and Merging objects and Streaming out - Proof of Concept

detail.abstract: Modern data ecosystems often receive fragmented data from multiple upstream platforms. Each domain system publishes only a partial representation of the same business entity-such as product catalog metadata, substitutions, reviews, or operational OTCHS attributes. To create a unified, enriched SKU representation in real time, we need a streaming pipeline that can merge partial events across multiple Kafka topics into a complete domain object. This article explains how to build such a solution using Apache Kafka Streams and Spring Boot.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍如何使用Apache Kafka Streams和Spring Boot构建实时流式管道，将来自多个Kafka主题的部分事件合并为完整的领域对象，以解决现代数据生态系统中数据碎片化的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个实时流式管道，能够将来自多个Kafka主题的部分事件合并为完整的领域对象，以创建统一的SKU表示？
AI.motivation: 现代数据生态系统经常从多个上游平台接收碎片化数据，每个领域系统只发布同一业务实体的部分表示（如产品目录元数据、替代品、评论或操作属性），需要实时创建统一、丰富的SKU表示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流式数据处理理论、事件驱动架构和领域驱动设计原则，结合实时数据集成和状态管理概念。
AI.method: 使用Apache Kafka Streams和Spring Boot构建流式管道，通过多个Kafka主题的事件合并技术实现实时数据集成。
AI.findings: 成功构建了一个能够实时合并多个Kafka主题中部分事件的流式管道，实现了从碎片化数据到完整领域对象的转换。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于流式处理的实时数据集成框架，扩展了事件驱动架构在数据碎片化场景下的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了使用Apache Kafka Streams和Spring Boot构建实时数据集成管道的具体实施方案，解决了企业级数据碎片化问题，可用于创建统一的SKU表示系统。

title: Antecedents of risk perception and intention to fly during COVID-19: The role of predetermination, traditionality and trust in authorities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Mugla Sitki Kocman University

detail.title: Antecedents of risk perception and intention to fly during COVID-19: The role of predetermination, traditionality and trust in authorities
detail.abstract: Despite being significant cultural characteristics, it is believed that there is insufficient information on how predetermination and traditionalism influence trust in authority and risk perception. The COVID-19 pandemic has provided a suitable context for investigating the factors that affect people's perceived risk in the face of hazards and how this risk perception impacts their intention to engage in air travel.,In this study, a comprehensive model was developed to examine how predetermination, traditionalism, and trust in the decisions of authorities within the scope of risk management influence perceived risk, as well as how the intention to engage in air travel is affected by perceived risk and fear arising from this context. The model was tested on 934 Turkish citizens using data obtained from an online survey through the Partial Least Square – Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) method.,The results of the structural equation modeling confirmed the positive impact of predetermination on traditionalism and trust in authority. Additionally, it was revealed that traditionalism mediates the relationship between predetermination and trust in authority, while trust in authority serves as a mediator between predetermination and perceived risk. On the other hand, the findings indicate that perceived risk negatively affects the intention to fly. Furthermore, fear was found to play a negative mediating role between perceived risk and the intention to fly.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨宿命论、传统主义、对权威的信任如何影响风险感知，以及风险感知和恐惧如何影响航空旅行意愿。基于934名土耳其公民的调查数据，发现宿命论正向影响传统主义和对权威的信任，传统主义在宿命论与对权威信任间起中介作用，对权威的信任在宿命论与风险感知间起中介作用，风险感知负向影响飞行意愿，恐惧在风险感知与飞行意愿间起负向中介作用。
AI.research_question: 宿命论和传统主义如何影响对权威的信任和风险感知？风险感知和恐惧如何影响航空旅行意愿？
AI.motivation: 尽管宿命论和传统主义是重要的文化特征，但关于它们如何影响对权威的信任和风险感知的研究不足。COVID-19大流行为研究人们在面对危险时的风险感知及其对航空旅行意愿的影响提供了合适的情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文化价值观理论（宿命论、传统主义）、信任理论（对权威的信任）、风险感知理论和行为意向理论，构建了宿命论→传统主义→对权威的信任→风险感知→恐惧→航空旅行意愿的整合模型。
AI.method: 采用在线问卷调查收集934名土耳其公民的数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行假设检验和中介效应分析。
AI.findings: 1. 宿命论正向影响传统主义和对权威的信任；2. 传统主义在宿命论与对权威信任间起中介作用；3. 对权威的信任在宿命论与风险感知间起中介作用；4. 风险感知负向影响飞行意愿；5. 恐惧在风险感知与飞行意愿间起负向中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了文化价值观（宿命论、传统主义）通过信任机制影响风险感知的路径；2. 验证了恐惧在风险感知与行为意向间的中介作用；3. 在危机情境下扩展了文化价值观与风险行为关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为航空业和政策制定者提供危机期间管理公众风险感知的策略建议；2. 强调建立对权威信任的重要性以降低风险感知；3. 为针对不同文化价值观群体的风险沟通提供指导。

title: Inflation Expectations and Price-Setting Decisions: Insights from the Housing Market
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Inflation Expectations and Price-Setting Decisions: Insights from the Housing Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1507
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We investigate how inflation expectations affect pricing decisions in the housing market. We leverage a randomized control trial embedded within an Italian survey of real estate agents and combine survey data for each agent with high-frequency listing prices observed on a large digital platform. Exploiting an exogenous shift in inflation expectations generated by information treatment, we find that higher inflation expectations cause a one-to-one increase in housing listing prices, on average. The pass-through is weaker in more concentrated and low-demand markets, as well as for agents who are more pessimistic about housing and credit developments.

AI.tldr: 通过意大利房地产代理商的随机对照试验发现，通胀预期上升会导致住房挂牌价格一对一上涨，但在市场集中度高、需求低的市场以及代理商对房市和信贷发展更悲观时，传导效应较弱。
AI.research_question: 通胀预期如何影响住房市场的定价决策？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀预期对住房定价的实际影响，特别是在当前高通胀环境下，这对货币政策传导和房地产市场稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通胀预期理论、定价决策理论和市场结构理论，探讨通胀预期如何通过房地产代理商的行为影响住房价格。
AI.method: 采用随机对照试验设计，嵌入意大利房地产代理商调查中，结合调查数据和高频挂牌价格数据，利用信息处理产生的外生通胀预期变化进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 通胀预期上升平均导致住房挂牌价格一对一上涨；2. 传导效应在市场集中度高、需求低的市场较弱；3. 代理商对房市和信贷发展越悲观，传导效应越弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了通胀预期对住房定价的直接因果效应；2. 揭示了市场结构和代理商异质性在通胀传导中的作用机制；3. 为通胀预期理论提供了微观行为证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行管理通胀预期提供政策参考；2. 帮助房地产市场监管者理解价格形成机制；3. 为房地产代理商提供定价决策的实证依据。

title: EntropyTrack: Attention Entropy Occlusion Detection with Adaptive Multi-Scale Feature Compensation for Robust Visual Tracking
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: EntropyTrack: Attention Entropy Occlusion Detection with Adaptive Multi-Scale Feature Compensation for Robust Visual Tracking
detail.abstract: Robust visual tracking under severe occlusions remains challenging due to the lack of explicit occlusion detection mechanisms and adaptive feature compensation strategies in existing methods. To address this problem, we propose EntropyTrack, a unified transformer-based framework that exploits attention entropy for occlusion-aware tracking. Our approach introduces an Attention Entropy Occlusion Detector that quantifies attention distribution uncertainty to explicitly identify occlusion states with spatial consistency regularization. Building upon this detection, an Adaptive Feature Compensation module performs intelligent feature repair through dynamic fusion of spatial inpainting and temporal information based on detected occlusion patterns. Furthermore, a Multi-Scale Contrastive Learning module enhances feature discriminability via attention-guided sampling across multiple scales for robust target-background separation. Extensive experiments on seven challenging benchmarks including LaSOT, GOT-10k, TrackingNet, LaSOText, VOT2020, TNL2K, and OTB100 demonstrate that EntropyTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining real-time efficiency at 42 fps. The synergistic integration of entropy-driven occlusion detection, adaptive compensation, and multi-scale contrastive learning provides a principled solution for robust visual tracking under challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: EntropyTrack是一个基于Transformer的视觉跟踪框架，通过注意力熵进行遮挡感知跟踪，包含注意力熵遮挡检测器、自适应特征补偿模块和多尺度对比学习模块，在多个基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在严重遮挡条件下实现鲁棒的视觉跟踪？具体来说，如何通过显式的遮挡检测机制和自适应特征补偿策略来提升跟踪性能？
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏显式的遮挡检测机制和自适应特征补偿策略，导致在严重遮挡条件下的视觉跟踪性能受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于注意力熵的遮挡检测理论、自适应特征补偿理论、多尺度对比学习理论、Transformer架构在视觉跟踪中的应用。
AI.method:
1. 注意力熵遮挡检测器：量化注意力分布不确定性，通过空间一致性正则化显式识别遮挡状态
2. 自适应特征补偿模块：基于检测到的遮挡模式，通过空间修复和时序信息的动态融合进行智能特征修复
3. 多尺度对比学习模块：通过注意力引导的多尺度采样增强特征可区分性，实现鲁棒的目标-背景分离
AI.findings: 在LaSOT、GOT-10k、TrackingNet、LaSOText、VOT2020、TNL2K、OTB100等七个挑战性基准测试中，EntropyTrack达到了最先进的性能，同时保持42fps的实时效率。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了基于注意力熵的遮挡检测理论框架
2. 发展了自适应特征补偿的理论方法
3. 建立了多尺度对比学习在视觉跟踪中的应用理论
4. 提供了熵驱动遮挡检测、自适应补偿和多尺度对比学习的协同集成理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开发了EntropyTrack框架，实现了遮挡感知的视觉跟踪
2. 提供了实时高效的跟踪解决方案（42fps）
3. 在多个基准测试中验证了方法的有效性
4. 为实际应用中的严重遮挡跟踪问题提供了实用工具

title: Household Borrowing and Monetary Policy Transmission: Post-Pandemic Insights from Nine European Credit Registers
affiliations: Tilburg University - Department of Finance, Research Department, Latvijas Banka, , , Bank of Italy, Boston College, National Bank of Slovakia, Bank of Lithuania, Research Department, Central Bank of Hungary, Bank of Lithuania, , Banco de España, , , , , Bank of Italy, Banco de España, , Magyar Nemzeti Bank, Latvijas Banka and

detail.title: Household Borrowing and Monetary Policy Transmission: Post-Pandemic Insights from Nine European Credit Registers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1509
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study heterogeneity in household borrowing across nine European countries (Belgium, Spain, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Portugal, and Slovakia) over the 2022-24 period using granular credit register data. We first document substantial between- and within-country variation in mortgage and consumer lending by borrower age, loan maturity, and interest rate fixation. We then quantify the pass-through of the ECB’s recent tightening cycle to household borrowing costs, and assess its heterogeneous impact across households. Pass-through is nearly complete for mortgages (around 0.9) but considerably weaker for consumer credit (around 0.4). While mortgage pass-through is relatively homogeneous across countries, consumer credit shows pronounced cross-country differences that cannot be explained by borrower or loan characteristics. Younger households face stronger mortgage pass-through but weaker consumer credit pass-through, relative to older borrowers, whereas longer maturities are associated with stronger pass-through in both credit markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用欧洲九国2022-24年期间的信贷登记数据，分析了家庭借贷的异质性。研究发现抵押贷款和消费信贷在借款人年龄、贷款期限和利率固定方式上存在显著的跨国和国内差异。欧洲央行紧缩政策的传导在抵押贷款市场接近完全（约0.9），但在消费信贷市场较弱（约0.4）。抵押贷款传导相对同质，而消费信贷传导存在显著的跨国差异，且无法用借款人或贷款特征解释。
AI.research_question: 欧洲九国（比利时、西班牙、匈牙利、爱尔兰、意大利、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、葡萄牙、斯洛伐克）家庭借贷的异质性如何？欧洲央行紧缩政策对家庭借贷成本的传导效应及其对不同家庭的异质性影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭借贷的异质性对于评估货币政策传导效果和金融稳定性至关重要。欧洲央行最近的紧缩周期为研究货币政策如何通过不同信贷渠道传导到家庭提供了独特机会，特别是在不同国家、不同信贷类型和不同借款人特征之间存在显著差异的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导理论、信贷市场不完全竞争理论、家庭金融理论、异质性代理人模型。研究基于信贷市场摩擦和银行定价行为理论，分析政策利率变化如何通过不同信贷渠道传导到家庭借贷成本。
AI.method: 使用欧洲九国2022-24年期间的细粒度信贷登记数据，采用实证分析方法。首先描述抵押贷款和消费信贷在借款人年龄、贷款期限和利率固定方式上的跨国和国内差异。然后量化欧洲央行紧缩政策对家庭借贷成本的传导效应，并评估其对不同家庭的异质性影响。
AI.findings: 1. 抵押贷款和消费信贷在借款人年龄、贷款期限和利率固定方式上存在显著跨国和国内差异；2. 欧洲央行紧缩政策的传导在抵押贷款市场接近完全（约0.9），但在消费信贷市场较弱（约0.4）；3. 抵押贷款传导相对同质，而消费信贷传导存在显著的跨国差异，且无法用借款人或贷款特征解释；4. 年轻家庭面临更强的抵押贷款传导但较弱的消费信贷传导；5. 较长贷款期限与两个信贷市场更强的传导相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了货币政策传导异质性的新证据，特别是在消费信贷市场的跨国差异；2. 揭示了借款人特征（年龄）和贷款特征（期限）在传导过程中的调节作用；3. 挑战了传统货币政策传导理论的同质性假设，强调了信贷市场结构和制度差异的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于货币政策传导效果的详细证据，有助于更精准的政策设计；2. 帮助监管机构识别不同信贷市场的脆弱性和传导机制差异；3. 为金融机构理解不同客户群体的利率敏感性提供参考；4. 为家庭金融决策提供关于借贷成本变化的预期指导。

title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together: The Coupling of Innovative Banks and Innovative Firms
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together: The Coupling of Innovative Banks and Innovative Firms

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1511
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Financial technology (Fintech) innovation in banking has the potential to improve banks’ screening and monitoring abilities, especially for more opaque firms, thereby improving their portfolio and risk allocation. We test the impact of Fintech innovation in borrower monitoring on banks’ supply of credit to Italian firms, with a special focus on small innovative businesses. To this end, we use Credit Register data on outstanding loans for Italy at the bank-firm level, combined with information on bank Fintech innovation from the Bank of Italy’s Regional Bank Lending Survey, and the classification of innovative young firms under the Italian Start-up Act. We find that banks investing in Fintech-based monitoring technologies provide larger volumes of credit to innovative firms at lower interest rates. Moreover, firms borrowing from these banks seem to benefit from stronger relationships, as they are less likely to exit the credit market. Finally, we find no evidence that Fintech innovation in monitoring increases the likelihood of loans to innovative firms becoming non-performing.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，银行投资于金融科技监控技术能够为创新型企业提供更多信贷、更低利率，并建立更稳固的银企关系，且不会增加不良贷款风险。
AI.research_question: 金融科技在借款人监控方面的创新如何影响银行对意大利企业（特别是小型创新企业）的信贷供给？
AI.motivation: 金融科技创新有望提升银行对不透明企业的筛选和监控能力，从而改善银行的资产组合和风险配置，但这一影响需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和关系型借贷理论，金融科技监控技术可以缓解银行与不透明企业之间的信息不对称问题。
AI.method: 使用意大利信贷登记数据（银行-企业层面）、意大利银行区域信贷调查中的银行金融科技创新信息，以及意大利《初创企业法》下的创新型企业分类数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 投资金融科技监控技术的银行向创新型企业提供更多信贷和更低利率；2. 从这些银行借款的企业银企关系更稳固，退出信贷市场的可能性更低；3. 金融科技监控创新不会增加创新型企业贷款的不良率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融科技如何缓解信息不对称、改善信贷配置提供了实证证据，丰富了金融科技与银行信贷供给关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行投资金融科技监控技术提供了决策依据，表明这种投资能够安全地扩大对创新型企业的信贷支持，促进创新经济发展。

title: Can Crises Affect Citizen Activism? Evidence from a Pandemic
affiliations: Indian Statistical Institute, New Delhi - Indian Statistical Institute, affiliation not provided to SSRN, King’s College London and Texas A&M University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Can Crises Affect Citizen Activism? Evidence from a Pandemic
detail.abstract: We ask whether major crises can be catalysts for civic activism. Using state-level variation in COVID-19 peaks in India and quasi-random participation in an online survey (March–July 2021), we measure willingness to act against healthcare fraud by supporting an NGO advocating transparency. Comparing respondents surveyed before and after their state’s COVID-19 peak, we find that exposure to the most acute phase of the pandemic is associated with a greater engagement in low-cost anti-corruption civic actions post-peak. This change coincides with heightened perceptions of healthcare corruption, greater awareness of rights, increased risk tolerance, and more optimistic beliefs about others’ willingness to act. Our findings suggest that exposure to crises can lead to higher levels of low-cost civic actions for accountability.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在印度COVID-19疫情高峰期后，民众参与低成本反腐败公民行动的意愿增强，表明重大危机可能成为公民行动的催化剂。
AI.research_question: 重大危机能否成为公民行动的催化剂？具体而言，COVID-19疫情暴露是否会影响民众参与反腐败公民行动的意愿？
AI.motivation: 理解危机如何影响公民参与对于民主治理和问责制至关重要。COVID-19疫情为研究危机对公民行动的影响提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合危机理论、公民参与理论和行为经济学，探讨危机如何通过改变认知、风险偏好和社会信念来影响公民行动。
AI.method: 利用印度各邦COVID-19高峰期的时间差异，采用准随机在线调查（2021年3-7月），比较疫情高峰期前后受访者对医疗欺诈透明化NGO的支持意愿。
AI.findings: 暴露于疫情最严重阶段的受访者在高峰期后表现出更强的低成本反腐败公民行动参与意愿。这与医疗腐败感知增强、权利意识提高、风险容忍度增加以及对他人的行动意愿更乐观相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为危机如何促进公民行动提供了实证证据，揭示了危机通过改变认知、风险偏好和社会信念影响公民参与的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公民社会组织提供了危机时期动员公民参与的启示，表明危机后可能是推动问责制改革的有利时机。

title: Transaction Costs and the Imperfect Take-up of COVID-19 Business Support Programs
affiliations: Kobe University, Gakushuin University - Economics, Hitotsubashi University, Chuo University and Hitotsubashi University

detail.title: Transaction Costs and the Imperfect Take-up of COVID-19 Business Support Programs
detail.abstract: Not all eligible firms and individuals take up government support measures even when the potential benefits are substantial. This paper investigates why such imperfect take-up arises, focusing on the role of transaction costs in the application process. Employing the data on the use of four COVID-19 business support measures for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Japan combined with firm characteristics, we find that the use of one measure (business continuity grants) causes a discontinuous increase in the use of the other three measures. Our results suggest that the transaction cost involved in applying for these measures plays a vital role, accounting for the relatively low take-up rates of the three measures.

AI.tldr: 日本中小企业COVID-19支持措施使用率低的原因：申请过程中的交易成本是关键障碍，使用一种措施会显著增加其他措施的使用率
AI.research_question: 为什么符合条件的日本中小企业不完全采用政府支持措施？申请过程中的交易成本如何影响采用率？
AI.motivation: 即使潜在收益巨大，许多符合条件的企业和个人仍不采用政府支持措施，这种不完全采用现象需要解释，特别是在COVID-19期间中小企业支持措施的背景下
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本理论 - 申请过程中的交易成本是影响企业采用政府支持措施的关键障碍
AI.method: 使用日本中小企业COVID-19四种商业支持措施的数据，结合企业特征进行分析，发现一种措施（业务连续性补助金）的使用会导致其他三种措施使用率的显著增加
AI.findings: 业务连续性补助金的使用会导致其他三种支持措施使用率的非连续性增加，表明申请过程中的交易成本是导致这三种措施采用率相对较低的关键因素
AI.theory_contributions: 为不完全采用政府支持措施的现象提供了交易成本理论解释，扩展了对企业决策中交易成本作用的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了减少申请过程交易成本的建议，以提高政府支持措施的采用率，特别是在危机时期

title: Is Old Really Bold? CEO Age and Corporate Risk Management
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University and Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University

detail.title: Is Old Really Bold? CEO Age and Corporate Risk Management
detail.abstract: We examine how CEO age influences corporate risk management by analyzing the usage of foreign exchange (FX) derivatives. Using firm-level data, we find that firms led by older CEOs employ significantly more FX derivatives than those led by younger CEOs, indicating greater risk aversion amongst older CEOs. We also find that older CEOs prefer futures contracts, which are linear derivative instruments that offer greater transparency and lower counterparty risk, indicating a preference for simpler payoff structures and lower risk. This relationship is particularly pronounced in non-high-tech firms, firms with high export exposure, and financially unconstrained firms. Finally, we document that following the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, older CEOs increased their use of FX derivatives, consistent with the idea that heightened regulatory scrutiny heightens risk aversion.

AI.tldr: 研究发现CEO年龄影响企业风险管理：年长CEO更倾向于使用外汇衍生品进行风险对冲，表明其风险规避程度更高。年长CEO偏好期货合约（线性衍生品），这种关系在非高科技企业、高出口敞口企业和财务无约束企业中更明显。萨班斯-奥克斯利法案后，年长CEO增加了外汇衍生品使用。
AI.research_question: CEO年龄如何影响企业风险管理，特别是外汇衍生品的使用？
AI.motivation: 理解高管个人特征（特别是年龄）对企业风险管理决策的影响，填补了行为公司金融领域关于高管年龄与风险偏好关系的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为公司金融理论（高管风险规避）、生命周期理论（年龄与风险偏好）、委托代理理论（监管环境变化的影响）。
AI.method: 使用企业层面数据，分析CEO年龄与外汇衍生品使用的关系，通过分组检验考察不同企业特征（行业、出口敞口、财务约束）的调节作用，并利用萨班斯-奥克斯利法案作为准自然实验。
AI.findings: 1. 年长CEO使用更多外汇衍生品，表明风险规避程度更高；2. 年长CEO偏好期货合约（线性衍生品）；3. 这种关系在非高科技企业、高出口敞口企业和财务无约束企业中更明显；4. 萨班斯-奥克斯利法案后，年长CEO增加了外汇衍生品使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将高管年龄作为风险偏好的代理变量，丰富了行为公司金融理论；2. 揭示了年龄对风险管理工具选择的具体影响机制；3. 提供了监管环境变化如何影响高管风险决策的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业董事会选聘CEO提供参考；2. 帮助投资者理解不同年龄CEO的风险管理风格；3. 为监管机构评估政策效果提供依据；4. 为企业风险管理策略制定提供指导。

title: Traditional Institutions and Modern Preferences: Evidence from Clan Culture and Old-age Support
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Traditional Institutions and Modern Preferences: Evidence from Clan Culture and Old-age Support
detail.abstract: This paper examines how traditional informal institutions shape preferences for old-age support and the emergence of initiative-based long-term financial planning. Using data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study combined with clan genealogy records, we estimate the causal impact of exposure to clan culture on old-age support preferences. We find that stronger exposure to clan culture in early life is associated with a higher likelihood of adopting modern preferences for old-age support, characterized by greater reliance on self-initiated savings and pension participation rather than dependence on children. The results are robust to instrumental variable estimation and placebo test. Importantly, the effect operates exclusively through exposure to clan culture during early life, while clan culture encountered in adulthood has no significant influence, particularly among individuals who relocate later in life. Mechanism analysis suggests that peer effects, generalized trust, income growth, and financial literacy jointly mediate the relationship between clan culture and old-age support preferences. We further show that the expansion of the formal pension system complements, rather than crowds out, the influence of clan culture, consistent with a process of co-evolution between informal and formal institutions. The effects are stronger among individuals with favorable attitudes toward clans, rural residents, and men. Finally, modern preferences induced by clan culture translate into higher pension participation and larger financial asset holdings. Overall, the findings highlight how informal institutions can shape economic preferences and facilitate the adoption of formal financial arrangements.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，早期接触宗族文化会促进现代养老偏好（自我储蓄和养老金参与），而非依赖子女。这种影响通过同伴效应、信任、收入增长和金融素养实现，且与正式养老金体系互补而非替代。
AI.research_question: 传统非正式制度（宗族文化）如何影响养老支持偏好和长期财务规划的兴起？
AI.motivation: 理解非正式制度如何塑造经济偏好，以及传统宗族文化在现代金融体系发展中的作用，特别是在中国从传统家庭养老向现代金融养老转型的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学、非正式制度与正式制度互动理论、文化经济学、生命周期理论、社会资本理论
AI.method: 使用中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）数据和宗族族谱记录，采用工具变量估计和安慰剂检验进行因果推断，并进行机制分析
AI.findings: 1. 早期接触宗族文化显著提高现代养老偏好（自我储蓄和养老金参与）；2. 成年后接触无显著影响；3. 同伴效应、普遍信任、收入增长和金融素养是中介机制；4. 正式养老金体系与宗族文化互补而非替代；5. 对宗族态度积极者、农村居民和男性影响更强；6. 现代偏好转化为更高的养老金参与和金融资产持有
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示非正式制度如何塑造经济偏好；2. 证明早期社会化在文化影响中的关键作用；3. 提出非正式与正式制度协同演化的理论框架；4. 扩展文化经济学在金融行为中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为养老金政策设计提供文化视角；2. 帮助金融机构理解文化因素对金融产品采纳的影响；3. 为促进金融包容性提供政策启示；4. 指导针对不同文化背景群体的金融教育

title: The Impact of AI Exposure on Labor Market Outcomes and Worker Well-Being: Evidence from Australia
affiliations: Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI) and Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI)

detail.title: The Impact of AI Exposure on Labor Market Outcomes and Worker Well-Being: Evidence from Australia
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how occupational exposure to artificial intelligence (AI) affects labour market outcomes and worker well-being using longitudinal microdata from the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA) survey. By following the same individuals for more than two decades (2001–2022), we identify within-person effects of AI exposure while controlling for all time-invariant unobservable characteristics through individual fixed effects. We find mixed labour market and well-being effects. Workers in AI-exposed occupations experience higher hourly wages and greater perceived autonomy in how work is performed, but also report reductions in both usual and desired hours worked, alongside lower satisfaction with job security. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that AI-exposed casual workers faced greater declines in hours and wages, while women saw relative gains in employment and pay, and older workers were less affected in terms of hours. These results remain robust across a range of sensitivity checks, including alternative exposure definitions, placebo tests, pre-2010 exposure restrictions, and comparisons with labour market disruptions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用澳大利亚HILDA调查的纵向数据，分析职业AI暴露对劳动力市场结果和工人福祉的影响。研究发现AI暴露带来混合效应：时薪和自主性提高，但工时减少、工作安全感下降。临时工受影响更大，女性相对受益，年长工人受影响较小。
AI.research_question: 职业暴露于人工智能如何影响劳动力市场结果和工人福祉？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在工作场所的广泛应用，需要实证证据了解其对工人和劳动力市场的实际影响，特别是长期、个体层面的效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术变革与劳动力市场关系的理论，关注AI作为通用目的技术对工作内容、技能需求和就业结构的影响。
AI.method: 使用澳大利亚HILDA调查的纵向微观数据（2001-2022），采用个体固定效应模型控制时间不变不可观测特征，识别AI暴露的个体内效应。
AI.findings: 混合效应：AI暴露职业的工人时薪更高、工作自主性更强，但通常和期望工时减少、工作安全感满意度下降。临时工工时和工资下降更多，女性就业和薪酬相对获益，年长工人受影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI对劳动力市场影响的实证证据，揭示了AI暴露的异质性效应，补充了技术变革理论在AI时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供AI劳动力市场影响的证据，帮助企业设计AI实施策略，为工人职业规划提供参考，特别是对不同群体（临时工、女性、年长者）的差异化影响。

title: How AI Shapes Strategic Reasoning: Evidence from Human-Chatbot Dialogue *
affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology, Southern University of Science and Technology and Wuhan University

detail.title: How AI Shapes Strategic Reasoning: Evidence from Human-Chatbot Dialogue *

declarations.ethicsApproval: The data collections were preregistered on AsPredicted (#262631) and approved by Wuhan University IRB (WHU-HSS-IRB2025111).
declarations.funderStatement: Lu Dong acknowledges financial support from National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant: 72573076 and 72394394) and Social Economics Teaching and Research Center of SUSTECH (SJZLGC202310). Lian Xue acknowledges financial support from National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant: 71903147 and 72433003).

detail.abstract: How does access to artificial intelligence affect strategic reasoning in economic decisions? We conduct a pre-registered laboratory experiment with 264 participants making incentivized choices in four canonical games: beauty contest, public goods, ultimatum, and signaling. Participants are randomly assigned to either converse with a large language model through unrestricted conversational support (free-style AI), engage with Feynmanstyle questioning that withholds direct advice (educational AI), or write self-reflections (baseline). We record complete chat transcripts, decisions, and decision explanations. We document three main findings. First, AI access shifts behavior toward payoff maximization, with free-style AI producing larger effects than educational AI. Second, after conversing with AI, game-theoretic and payoff-maximizing arguments increase substantially, while reliance on heuristics and social preferences declines. Third, most chats focus on predicting others' behavior and game-theoretic analysis, with over 90% of AI users seek explicit recommendations. Principal component analysis shows that dialogue features explain a substantial share of decision variance, and semantic analysis further confirms strong correlations between chat content and participants' subsequent decision explanations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验室实验探究AI访问如何影响经济决策中的战略推理。研究发现：1) AI访问使行为向收益最大化偏移，自由式AI效果更强；2) 与AI对话后，博弈论和收益最大化论证增加，启发式和社会偏好依赖减少；3) 多数对话关注预测他人行为和博弈分析，超90%用户寻求明确建议。
AI.research_question: AI访问如何影响经济决策中的战略推理？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在日常决策中日益普及，理解AI如何影响人们的战略思维和决策过程变得至关重要，特别是在经济决策领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、行为经济学、战略推理理论、AI辅助决策理论
AI.method: 预注册实验室实验，264名参与者，随机分配到三组：自由式AI对话组、教育式AI提问组（费曼式提问）、自我反思基线组。在四个经典博弈游戏中做出激励性选择：选美比赛、公共物品、最后通牒、信号传递。记录完整聊天记录、决策和决策解释。
AI.findings: 1) AI访问使行为向收益最大化偏移，自由式AI效果更强；2) 与AI对话后，博弈论和收益最大化论证显著增加，启发式和社会偏好依赖减少；3) 多数对话关注预测他人行为和博弈分析，超90%AI用户寻求明确建议；4) 对话特征解释大量决策方差，聊天内容与后续决策解释强相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统实证检验AI对战略推理的影响，揭示AI如何改变决策认知过程，为AI辅助决策理论提供实证基础，拓展行为经济学与AI交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI工具设计提供指导（如自由式vs教育式），帮助决策者理解AI辅助的认知影响，为政策制定者提供AI监管参考，为企业AI决策支持系统设计提供实证依据。

title: Judgment Architecture: Why Innovation and AI Expose Organiztional Decision Limits
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Judgment Architecture: Why Innovation and AI Expose Organiztional Decision Limits

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, human data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: Judgment architecture Organizational decision-making Decision-making under uncertainty Organizational design Authority and accountability Innovation management Scaling innovation Artificial intelligence in organizations

detail.abstract: AI does not fail primarily because it is inaccurate. It fails because AI systems can only operate on what is spelled out in advance. In everyday organizational work, people constantly make small calls in the moment. They notice when something feels off, check with someone else, or decide to hold back until there is more clarity. These judgments are rarely formalized. They are embedded in shared context, professional norms, escalation habits, and tacit authority structures that have evolved over time. When work is delegated to AI systems, those informal judgment practices do not carry over automatically. AI cannot pause, redirect, or escalate unless those conditions are deliberately designed. As a result, organizations often experience AI failures not because the system behaves unpredictably, but because it behaves exactly as it was allowed to. This paper introduces the concept of judgment as infrastructure to explain this phenomenon. Rather than treating judgment as an individual skill, a governance overlay, or a human-in-the-loop safeguard, the paper argues that judgment functions as a form of organizational infrastructure that must be made visible, explicit, and accountable before work is delegated to machines. The central claim is that many challenges attributed to AI, including loss of control, brittle decision-making, and post-hoc escalation, are symptoms of judgment that was never intentionally designed. AI systems expose these gaps by making delegation irreversible, scalable, and fast, revealing assumptions that previously remained hidden in human coordination. Contribution and Positioning The paper reframes AI-related organizational failure away from model performance and toward the conditions under which delegation occurs. It contributes a conceptual lens that connects AI deployment to organizational design, authority, accountability, and decision rights, while highlighting why existing approaches such as ethical principles, governance committees, and generic human-in-the-loop mechanisms often fail to address the underlying issue. By positioning judgment as infrastructure, the paper opens a new line of inquiry into how organizations design the conditions under which AI systems operate, rather than relying on after-the-fact oversight or individual discretion.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"判断作为基础设施"概念，认为AI失败主要不是因为技术不准确，而是因为组织中的非正式判断实践（如暂停、升级、协调等）无法自动转移到AI系统中。AI暴露了人类协调中隐藏的假设，使委托变得不可逆、可扩展和快速。
AI.research_question: 为什么AI系统在组织中经常失败？这种失败的本质是什么？如何从组织设计角度理解AI部署的挑战？
AI.motivation: AI失败通常被归因于技术不准确或模型性能问题，但实际观察显示，许多AI失败发生在系统按设计运行的情况下。这表明问题可能在于组织如何将工作委托给AI，而非AI技术本身。
AI.theoretical_framework: 判断作为基础设施理论：将判断视为一种组织基础设施，而非个人技能、治理覆盖层或人机协作保障机制。该框架连接AI部署与组织设计、权威、问责和决策权。
AI.method: 概念性论文，通过理论构建和概念分析，提出"判断作为基础设施"框架，并批判现有方法（伦理原则、治理委员会、通用人机协作机制）的局限性。
AI.findings: AI失败往往是因为组织中的非正式判断实践（基于共享背景、专业规范、升级习惯和隐性权威结构）无法自动转移到AI系统中。AI暴露了这些隐藏的假设，使委托变得不可逆、可扩展和快速。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"判断作为基础设施"概念框架；2. 将AI相关组织失败从模型性能重新定位到委托条件；3. 建立AI部署与组织设计、权威、问责的理论联系；4. 批判现有伦理和治理方法的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指导组织在设计AI系统时考虑判断基础设施；2. 强调需要在委托工作前使判断可见、明确和可问责；3. 提供新的设计思路，关注AI操作条件而非事后监督；4. 帮助组织避免控制丧失、决策脆弱性和事后升级等问题。

title: Feasibility Study: Blockchain-Based Digital ID in Somalia
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Feasibility Study: Blockchain-Based Digital ID in Somalia
detail.abstract: The National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) of Somalia has made significant strides in establishing a foundational national identity system. However, structural limitations, including a highly centralized architecture, fragmented inter-agency interoperability, and persistent data security concerns, threaten its long-term effectiveness, inclusivity, and public trust [1]. This paper, developed from a feasibility study on NIRA's current system, proposes a strategic transition from a basic foundational ID to a Decentralized, Interoperable, and Privacy-Preserving Digital Identity model, leveraging the principles of Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) and blockchain technology. This shift is not primarily a technical upgrade but a governance and coordination challenge [2]. The core recommendation is to implement a secure, permissioned digital identity infrastructure based on W3C standards (Decentralized Identifiers and Verifiable Credentials). This framework would: 1. Mitigate Centralized Risk: By distributing the verification process and eliminating the single, massive honeypot of personal data. 2. Enhance Interoperability: By enabling all government agencies to securely and instantly verify identity claims using a shared, tamper-proof ledger, transforming NIRA from an operational bottleneck into the authoritative national source of identity trust. 3. Restore Citizen Trust: By granting citizens control over their data, ensuring that personal information is verified selectively rather than copied and stored by multiple agencies. This strategic evolution strengthens NIRA's mandate, supports national inclusion, and establishes a robust digital public infrastructure essential for Somalia's long-term stability and economic growth.

AI.tldr: 索马里国家身份识别与注册局在建立国家身份系统方面取得进展，但面临集中化架构、机构间互操作性差和数据安全等问题。本文建议从基础身份系统转向基于自我主权身份和区块链技术的去中心化、可互操作、隐私保护的数字身份模型，这主要是治理和协调挑战而非技术升级。
AI.research_question: 如何通过去中心化、可互操作、隐私保护的数字身份模型解决索马里国家身份系统的集中化风险、互操作性差和公民信任问题？
AI.motivation: 索马里国家身份识别与注册局已建立基础身份系统，但高度集中的架构、机构间互操作性碎片化以及持续的数据安全问题威胁着系统的长期有效性、包容性和公众信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我主权身份（SSI）理论、区块链技术、去中心化身份模型、W3C标准（去中心化标识符和可验证凭证）、数字公共基础设施理论。
AI.method: 基于对NIRA现有系统的可行性研究，提出战略性转型建议，采用基于W3C标准的许可制数字身份基础设施。
AI.findings: 去中心化数字身份模型能够：1）通过分布式验证消除集中化风险；2）通过共享防篡改账本增强机构间互操作性；3）通过赋予公民数据控制权恢复公民信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自我主权身份和区块链技术应用于国家身份系统治理，提出了从基础身份系统向去中心化数字身份模型转型的理论框架，强调这是治理和协调挑战而非单纯技术升级。
AI.practical_contributions: 为索马里国家身份系统提供具体转型方案：建立基于W3C标准的许可制数字身份基础设施，将NIRA从操作瓶颈转变为权威的国家身份信任源，支持国家包容性并建立数字公共基础设施。

title: Climate Change, State Capacity and Canadian Leadership in Wildfire Mitigation: Strengthening Institutions for a New Era of Climate-Driven Disasters

detail.title: Climate Change, State Capacity and Canadian Leadership in Wildfire Mitigation: Strengthening Institutions for a New Era of Climate-Driven Disasters
detail.abstract: This paper examines the intersection of climate change, state governance capacity, and wildfire mitigation across three income levels. It argues that state capacity—measured through institutional frameworks, technological resources, and fiscal investment—fundamentally shapes nations' ability to respond to climate-driven disasters, particularly wildfires. Through comparative analysis of Canada (high-income), Brazil (middle-income), and Indonesia (lower-middle-income), the study demonstrates that while wealth enables resources, institutional coordination, legal frameworks, and community engagement are equally critical. Canada's record 2023 and 2025 wildfire seasons (17.5M and 8.8M hectares burned) exposed both advanced state capacity (international cooperation, modernized funding) and vulnerabilities. The paper proposes five domestic strategies—modernized legislation, technology investment, community resilience, Indigenous co-management, and a national wildfire agency—and three international recommendations—Pan-American cooperation, standardized protocols, and a Global Center for Research. By integrating scientific expertise with Indigenous knowledge and establishing transnational frameworks, Canada can position itself as a leader in climate adaptation, providing a replicable blueprint for nations facing unprecedented wildfire threats. This research contributes to policy analysis and disaster governance literature by demonstrating how institutional innovation, combined with international collaboration, strengthens climate resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较加拿大、巴西和印尼三个不同收入水平的国家，探讨国家治理能力如何影响应对气候变化引发的野火灾害。研究发现，国家能力（制度框架、技术资源、财政投资）是应对气候灾害的关键因素，而不仅仅是财富水平。文章提出了五项国内策略和三项国际建议，强调制度创新与国际合作对增强气候韧性的重要性。
AI.research_question: 国家治理能力如何影响不同收入水平国家应对气候变化引发的野火灾害？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致全球野火灾害加剧，但不同国家应对能力存在显著差异。需要理解国家治理能力（而非仅仅是经济财富）如何影响野火减灾效果，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家能力理论（state capacity theory），包括制度框架、技术资源和财政投资三个维度；气候适应与灾害治理理论；比较政治经济学视角。
AI.method: 比较案例分析法，选取加拿大（高收入）、巴西（中等收入）、印尼（中低收入）三个国家进行对比分析，考察其野火应对策略和效果。
AI.findings: 1. 财富能提供资源，但制度协调、法律框架和社区参与同样关键；2. 加拿大2023和2025年野火季暴露了其先进国家能力的优势（国际合作、现代化资金）和脆弱性；3. 国家能力是应对气候灾害的决定性因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了国家能力理论在气候灾害治理中的应用；2. 丰富了政策分析和灾害治理文献；3. 展示了制度创新与国际合作如何增强气候韧性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了五项国内策略（现代化立法、技术投资、社区韧性、原住民共同管理、国家野火机构）和三项国际建议（泛美合作、标准化协议、全球研究中心），为加拿大和其他国家提供了可复制的野火治理蓝图。

title: Epistemic Justice in Construction Research: Re-evaluating Performance Metrics for Construction Management and Quantity Surveying

detail.title: Epistemic Justice in Construction Research: Re-evaluating Performance Metrics for Construction Management and Quantity Surveying
detail.abstract: Construction Management (CM) and Quantity Surveying (QS) are practice-intensive disciplines that address complex, value-laden challenges in the built environment. Despite their societal relevance-from climate-resilient infrastructure to ethical labor practices-they remain epistemologically marginalized in research assessment systems dominated by positivist, laboratory-based norms. This paper argues that the current application of universal key performance indicators (KPIs)-such as journal impact factors, citation counts, and grant income-to CM and QS constitutes a form of epistemic injustice. Drawing on critical realism, Mode 2 knowledge production, and an axiologically grounded philosophy of research, we demonstrate that CM and QS generate knowledge through situated, transdisciplinary, and ethically reflective processes that cannot be fairly captured by metrics designed for natural sciences or theoretical engineering. We propose a reconfigured evaluation framework anchored in the author's "Research Philosophical Onion," which positions ontology (what exists as real in construction) and axiology (the role of values) as foundational outer layers guiding all methodological choices. The paper concludes with actionable recommendations for universities, accreditation bodies (e.g., CIOB, RICS), and national research councils to implement discipline-sensitive assessment criteria that honor the unique urgency, output forms, and intellectual contributions of CM and QS scholarship.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为当前将通用KPI（期刊影响因子、引用次数、资助收入）应用于建筑管理和工料测量学科构成了认知不公，因为这些实践密集型学科的知识生产方式与自然科学不同，需要基于研究哲学洋葱模型重新配置评估框架。
AI.research_question: 如何为建筑管理和工料测量学科建立公平、学科敏感的评估框架，以解决当前通用KPI应用导致的认知不公问题？
AI.motivation: 建筑管理和工料测量是实践密集型学科，处理建筑环境中的复杂价值挑战，具有重要的社会相关性（如气候韧性基础设施、道德劳动实践），但在以实证主义、实验室为基础的研究评估体系中处于认知边缘化地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判实在论、模式2知识生产、价值论基础的研究哲学，以及作者的"研究哲学洋葱"模型（将本体论和价值论作为指导所有方法论选择的基础外层）。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，基于哲学和理论视角分析当前评估体系的问题，并提出重新配置的评估框架。
AI.findings: 当前将通用KPI应用于CM和QS构成了认知不公；这些学科通过情境化、跨学科和伦理反思过程生成知识，无法被为自然科学设计的指标公平捕捉；需要基于研究哲学洋葱模型建立学科敏感的评估标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知不公概念应用于研究评估领域；提出基于批判实在论和模式2知识生产的学科评估理论框架；发展了"研究哲学洋葱"模型作为评估框架的基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学、认证机构（如CIOB、RICS）和国家研究委员会提供可操作建议，实施尊重CM和QS学科独特性、紧迫性、产出形式和智力贡献的评估标准。

title: Competition Law Challenges in Device Based Pricing and Algorithmic Cartels
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Competition Law Challenges in Device Based Pricing and Algorithmic Cartels
detail.abstract: The rapid digitalization of India's travel industry has made algorithmic decisions systems the main tool for price determination which creates new competition law problems. This article critically examines two separates yet connected risks which results from technological advancement they are Device Based Price Discrimination (DPD) where platforms leverage granular user data such as Android vs iOS, and Algorithmic Collusion (AC) where selflearning price tools coordinate to fix prices without explicit human communication. Evaluates the Competition Act,2002 to reveal major weaknesses in its current enforcement system. This article examines Section 3 evidence requirement for algorithmic tacit collusion through the Competition Commission of India's denial of a "Hub & Spoke" conspiracy in Samir Agrwal v. Competition Commission of India. Conversely, the article also analyzes the MakeMyTrip-Goibibo ruling to show how Section 4 helps to address abuse of dominance through vertical market restrictions and parity clause. Ultimately, article demonstrates that traditional ex-post enforcement regime fails to manage the velocity and opacity of the "black box" algorithm. This article advocates for a paradigm shift towards ex-ante regulation and enhanced evidence collection methods to safeguard consumer welfare and ensure competition in India's digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了印度旅游行业数字化带来的算法决策系统引发的两个竞争法问题：设备基础价格歧视（DPD）和算法合谋（AC）。研究发现《2002年竞争法》现有执法体系存在重大缺陷，传统事后执法难以应对"黑箱"算法的速度和隐蔽性，主张转向事前监管和强化证据收集方法。
AI.research_question: 印度《2002年竞争法》如何应对数字化旅游行业中算法决策系统带来的设备基础价格歧视和算法合谋风险？
AI.motivation: 印度旅游行业的快速数字化使算法决策系统成为价格确定的主要工具，这带来了新的竞争法问题，需要评估现有法律框架的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论、算法合谋理论、价格歧视理论、数字平台监管理论、事前监管与事后执法的比较分析。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究（Samir Agrwal v. Competition Commission of India和MakeMyTrip-Goibibo裁决）、比较分析、批判性法律分析。
AI.findings: 1. 第3条对算法默示合谋的证据要求过高，印度竞争委员会在Samir Agrwal案中否认"中心辐射"合谋的做法存在缺陷；2. 第4条在处理垂直市场限制和价格平价条款方面更为有效；3. 传统事后执法机制难以应对"黑箱"算法的速度和隐蔽性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了算法合谋和设备基础价格歧视的理论框架；2. 揭示了传统竞争法在数字时代的局限性；3. 为事前监管范式转变提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度竞争法改革提供具体建议；2. 提出加强证据收集方法；3. 倡导建立事前监管机制以保护消费者福利和确保数字经济的竞争。

title: A Strategy-First, Rule-Based Decision Support System for Equity Market Analysis

detail.title: A Strategy-First, Rule-Based Decision Support System for Equity Market Analysis
detail.abstract: This work proposes an Equity Strategy Assistant designed as a decision-support system for equity strategy formulation, simulation, and market condition monitoring. The system is explicitly constructed to assist human users in reasoning about trading ideas through structured representation, rule-based evaluation, and explanatory analysis, without participating in or influencing execution decisions. At its core, the system supports the transformation of informal trading concepts into explicit, inspectable strategy definitions, enabling users to test those definitions against historical data and observe how they interact with real or delayed market conditions. The system does not act autonomously, nor does it optimize for financial outcomes. Instead, it functions as an analytical aid that helps users understand what happened, under which conditions, and why-while leaving all interpretive and execution authority with the human user. The design deliberately prioritizes transparency, auditability, and constraint over predictive power. Automated components are used to evaluate rule satisfaction, simulate outcomes, and summarize behavior, but they are intentionally restricted from producing recommendations or prescriptive actions. Human judgment remains central throughout the decision-making process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个股票策略助手，作为决策支持系统，帮助用户制定、模拟股票策略并监控市场条件。系统通过结构化表示、规则评估和解释性分析辅助用户推理交易想法，但不参与或影响执行决策，强调透明度、可审计性和人类判断的中心地位。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个决策支持系统来帮助股票策略制定，同时保持人类判断的中心地位，避免系统自主决策？
AI.motivation: 现有交易系统往往过于自动化或黑箱化，缺乏透明度和可审计性，导致用户难以理解和控制决策过程。需要一种系统既能辅助分析，又保持人类决策权威。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策支持系统理论、人机协作理论、解释性人工智能、结构化表示理论、规则评估框架
AI.method: 设计科学方法，构建一个包含结构化表示、规则评估、模拟分析和解释性功能的决策支持系统原型
AI.findings: 成功开发了一个股票策略助手系统，能够将非正式交易概念转化为明确可检查的策略定义，支持历史数据测试和实时市场条件交互分析，同时保持人类决策权威
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个强调透明度、可审计性和人类中心地位的决策支持系统设计框架，为人机协作交易系统提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的股票策略助手工具，帮助交易者更好地理解和测试交易想法，提高决策质量，同时避免自动化系统的黑箱风险和过度依赖

title: The Interregnum of 2026: Hemispheric Realpolitik and the Decomposition of the Global Order
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Interregnum of 2026: Hemispheric Realpolitik and the Decomposition of the Global Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest associated with this publication. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. Correspondence concerning this article should be addressed to Precious Heiress Marasigan/heiressprecious@gmail.com.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the geopolitical landscape of 2026, defined as a "protracted interregnum" marking the systematic decomposition of the post-Cold War rules-based architecture. It argues that the global order has transitioned from centralized multilateralism to a fragmented reality of "transactional bilateralism" and competing regional hegemonies. The analysis focuses on the emergence of the "Donroe Doctrine" and the "Trump Corollary," which prioritize U.S. hemispheric dominance and resource security over trans-oceanic alliances. through two primary case studies-the U.S. intervention in Venezuela ("Operation Absolute Resolve") and the territorial crisis regarding Greenland-the paper illustrates the practical application of this new realpolitik. Finally, it examines the "Pax Silica" framework and the geoeconomic fragmentation driven by the race for Artificial Intelligence primacy.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析2026年地缘政治格局，将其定义为"长期过渡期"，标志着后冷战规则体系正在系统性解体。全球秩序已从集中式多边主义转变为"交易性双边主义"和竞争性区域霸权的碎片化现实。
AI.research_question: 2026年地缘政治格局如何体现后冷战规则体系的系统性解体？"多诺伊主义"和"特朗普推论"如何重塑美国外交政策？
AI.motivation: 理解全球秩序从集中式多边主义向碎片化现实的转变，分析新兴地缘政治原则对美国外交政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现实政治理论、霸权稳定论、地缘政治理论、国际关系中的过渡期概念。
AI.method: 案例研究法：1) 美国干预委内瑞拉（"绝对决心行动"）；2) 格陵兰领土危机。
AI.findings: 全球秩序已转变为"交易性双边主义"和竞争性区域霸权；"多诺伊主义"和"特朗普推论"优先考虑美国半球主导地位和资源安全；地缘经济碎片化由人工智能主导权竞争驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"长期过渡期"概念框架；发展"交易性双边主义"理论；分析"帕克斯硅谷"框架作为新的地缘经济秩序。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解新兴地缘政治现实的框架；揭示美国外交政策转变的实际影响；分析人工智能竞争对全球秩序的重塑作用。

title: The Impact on Economic Activity and Housing Market of the 2023 Emilia-Romagna Floods
affiliations: Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Impact on Economic Activity and Housing Market of the 2023 Emilia-Romagna Floods

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1506
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In May 2023, two floods hit the Italian region of Emilia-Romagna, causing 17 deaths and €10 billion in damages. This paper investigates the impact of such floods on economic activity and household wealth. Using nightlight data to measure economic activity and considering a triple difference-in-differences empirical framework, we find a decline in nightlight activity in flooded municipalities in the three weeks surrounding the two floods, a rebound effect in the following three weeks, but no effect thereafter. In the most pessimistic scenario, the total reduction in regional GDP growth in 2023 is between 0.1 and 0.2 per cent, i.e. between €3 and 5 million, excluding the agricultural sector. The duration of the impact of the floods is broadly confirmed by the other two proxies for economic activity available at the daily frequence and municipal level, i.e. hiring and road traffic data. We also find temporary effects on the housing market demand, but no effects on the house prices asked by the sellers nor on the number of posted advertisements for house sales, suggesting that the housing market in flooded municipalities already discounts the risk of such natural events.

AI.tldr: 研究使用三重差分法分析2023年5月意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区两次洪水对经济活动的影响。研究发现洪水期间夜间灯光活动下降，随后三周反弹，但无长期影响。最悲观情景下，2023年区域GDP增长减少0.1-0.2%（300-500万欧元）。住房市场需求受暂时影响，但房价和广告数量无变化，表明市场已计入洪水风险。
AI.research_question: 洪水灾害对经济活动和家庭财富有何影响？具体而言，2023年5月意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区的两次洪水如何影响当地经济活动（通过夜间灯光、雇佣和交通数据衡量）以及住房市场？
AI.motivation: 2023年5月意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区发生两次严重洪水，造成17人死亡和100亿欧元损失。需要量化此类自然灾害对经济活动和家庭财富的实际影响，为政策制定和风险管理提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然灾害经济学、区域经济冲击理论、住房市场风险定价理论。使用三重差分法（triple difference-in-differences）来识别因果效应。
AI.method: 采用三重差分法实证框架，使用夜间灯光数据作为经济活动代理变量，同时辅以雇佣数据和道路交通数据（均为日频市政级别数据）。分析洪水前后经济活动变化，并考察住房市场需求、房价和销售广告的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 洪水期间受灾市政区夜间灯光活动下降，随后三周反弹，但无长期影响；2. 最悲观情景下，2023年区域GDP增长减少0.1-0.2%（300-500万欧元，不含农业）；3. 雇佣和交通数据证实了影响持续时间；4. 住房市场需求受暂时影响，但房价和销售广告数量无变化，表明市场已计入洪水风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了自然灾害对经济活动的短期冲击效应和反弹模式；2. 提供了住房市场风险定价的经验证据，表明市场参与者已预期并定价洪水风险；3. 展示了多重数据源（夜间灯光、雇佣、交通）在灾害经济评估中的互补性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供洪水经济影响的量化评估；2. 表明洪水对区域经济的长期影响有限，有助于灾后恢复规划；3. 住房市场已风险定价的发现为保险和风险管理提供参考；4. 方法论可为其他灾害经济评估提供借鉴。

title: The Ownership Paradox: Structural Wealth Extraction and the Misidentification of Economic Adversaries in Contemporary America
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Ownership Paradox: Structural Wealth Extraction and the Misidentification of Economic Adversaries in Contemporary America

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest. The analysis presented is entirely independent and is not influenced by any organization, government, or private entity. The work reflects a structural and historical examination based solely on publicly available economic data and widely documented institutional mechanisms.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study because it involves no human participants, clinical data, or personally identifiable information. The analysis is based exclusively on macroeconomic data, public institutional records, and theoretical frameworks.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently without support, sponsorship, or financial contribution from any institution or organization.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the structural mechanisms of wealth extraction in the United States economy from 1971 to 2026, challenging the dominant narrative that attributes middle-class economic stagnation to foreign competition. Through analysis of wage stagnation patterns, asset concentration data, interlocking ownership structures, and shadow banking architecture, we demonstrate that domestic institutional capture-not external economic forces-represents the primary driver of wealth redistribution from labor to capital. We identify what we term the "Owners of the Global System" (OGS): an emergent power bloc characterized by cross-sectoral monopolization, financial intermediation dominance, and regulatory capture. The analysis reveals that trade wars and protectionist policies directed at foreign nations fail to address-and often exacerbate-the fundamental structural dynamics responsible for American economic distress. We conclude that the enemy of American prosperity has never been foreign, but rather a domestic architecture of extraction that operates through legal, monetary, and institutional channels.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将美国中产阶级经济停滞归因于外国竞争的主流叙事，通过分析1971-2026年的财富提取结构机制，证明国内制度俘获（而非外部经济力量）是财富从劳动力向资本重新分配的主要驱动力，并识别了"全球体系所有者"这一新兴权力集团。
AI.research_question: 美国经济中财富提取的结构机制是什么？国内制度俘获还是外部经济力量是导致中产阶级经济停滞和财富从劳动力向资本重新分配的主要驱动力？
AI.motivation: 挑战将美国中产阶级经济停滞归因于外国竞争的主流叙事，揭示国内结构性财富提取机制的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度俘获理论、财富提取结构机制、权力集团理论、跨部门垄断理论、金融中介支配理论。
AI.method: 分析1971-2026年的工资停滞模式、资产集中数据、连锁所有权结构、影子银行架构，识别"全球体系所有者"这一新兴权力集团的特征。
AI.findings: 国内制度俘获（而非外部经济力量）是财富从劳动力向资本重新分配的主要驱动力；贸易战和保护主义政策未能解决且往往加剧了导致美国经济困境的根本结构性动态；识别出具有跨部门垄断、金融中介支配和监管俘获特征的"全球体系所有者"权力集团。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"全球体系所有者"概念框架，挑战了主流的外国竞争叙事，发展了关于国内结构性财富提取机制的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了贸易战和保护主义政策的局限性，为政策制定者提供了重新聚焦于国内结构性改革的依据，帮助理解美国经济困境的真正根源。

title: The 1% Treaty: Health and Economic Impact of Redirecting 1% of Global Military Spending to Pragmatic Clinical Trials

detail.title: The 1% Treaty: Health and Economic Impact of Redirecting 1% of Global Military Spending to Pragmatic Clinical Trials

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Thousands of diseases lack FDA-approved treatments, and at current research capacity, it will take centuries to explore potential therapies. We propose redirecting just 1% of global military spending ($27.2 billion annually) to pragmatic clinical trials. This investment would increase trial capacity more than 12-fold, accelerating treatment discovery by over two centuries. The timeline shift would prevent 10.7 billion deaths over the long term, valued at $84.8 quadrillion. At $0.0018 per DALY averted, this intervention is 50,000 times more cost-effective than conventional global health programs like bed nets. Even with only a 1% probability of treaty adoption, the risk-adjusted cost-effectiveness surpasses the best existing interventions. We introduce Incentive Alignment Bonds to address political feasibility by linking legislators' career outcomes to public accountability.

AI.tldr: 将全球军费开支的1%（每年272亿美元）重新分配给务实临床试验，可将试验能力提高12倍以上，加速治疗发现超过两个世纪，长期预防107亿人死亡，成本效益比传统全球健康项目高5万倍。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重新分配全球军费开支来大幅加速疾病治疗发现，并评估其成本效益和可行性？
AI.motivation: 数千种疾病缺乏FDA批准的治疗方法，按照当前研究能力，探索潜在疗法需要几个世纪。全球军费开支巨大，重新分配一小部分就能显著加速医疗进步。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析框架、全球健康经济学、公共政策经济学、政治可行性理论、激励对齐理论
AI.method: 量化分析：计算军费开支重新分配的经济影响、临床试验能力提升倍数、时间节省、死亡预防数量、成本效益比（每DALY避免成本）。引入激励对齐债券作为政治可行性解决方案。
AI.findings: 1%全球军费（272亿美元/年）可使试验能力提高12倍以上，加速治疗发现超过200年，长期预防107亿人死亡，价值84.8万亿美元。成本效益为每避免一个DALY仅0.0018美元，比传统全球健康项目（如蚊帐）高5万倍。即使只有1%的条约采纳概率，风险调整后的成本效益仍超过现有最佳干预措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出通过重新分配军费开支加速医疗进步的量化框架；2. 引入激励对齐债券概念，将立法者职业结果与公共问责联系起来；3. 建立风险调整的成本效益评估模型，考虑政治可行性因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供具体可行的资金重新分配方案；2. 展示极高的成本效益比，为政策制定提供依据；3. 提出激励对齐债券作为解决政治可行性的实际工具；4. 为全球健康投资提供新的优先事项框架。

title: The "American Economic Model": A Reconstruction of IS-LM and AD-AS Frameworks Under Global Dollar Circulation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The "American Economic Model": A Reconstruction of IS-LM and AD-AS Frameworks Under Global Dollar Circulation
detail.abstract: By analyzing the "Global Dollar Circulation," this paper reconstructs the National Income Accounting identity under the American Economic Model. It introduces the pivotal concept of Gross Income (Z = Y + NI) and executes a comprehensive "Americanized" re-engineering of the traditional IS-LM and AD-AS models. Key findings include: 1. U.S. trade deficits possess inherent endogeneity and serve as a strategic "safety cushion" to buffer inflation; 2. The U.S. economy achieves the "Goldilocks Zone"-characterized by robust employment and price stability-only when it maintains a synergy of sufficient endogenous trade deficits and moderate buffering trade deficits; 3. The Federal Reserve's monetary policy is effectively a mechanism for steering the economy into this optimal "Goldilocks" state; 4. The "Dollar Dividend" fundamentally alters monetary properties, ensuring that money remains non-neutral even in the long run.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析"全球美元循环"，在美国经济模式下重构国民收入核算恒等式，引入总收入(Z=Y+NI)概念，对美国化的IS-LM和AD-AS模型进行全面重构。研究发现：美国贸易赤字具有内生性，可作为通胀缓冲的"安全垫"；美国经济需要足够的内生贸易赤字和适度的缓冲贸易赤字协同才能达到"金发女孩区域"；美联储货币政策实质上是引导经济进入这一最优状态的机制；"美元红利"从根本上改变了货币属性，使货币在长期内也保持非中性。
AI.research_question: 在美国经济模式和全球美元循环背景下，如何重构宏观经济模型以解释美国贸易赤字的内生性、美联储货币政策的有效性，以及美元特权如何影响货币中性？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济模型无法充分解释美国经济在全球美元体系下的独特表现，特别是贸易赤字与通胀之间的特殊关系，以及美元特权对货币政策传导机制的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 全球美元循环理论；2. 美国经济模式；3. 重构的国民收入核算恒等式(Z=Y+NI)；4. 美国化的IS-LM模型；5. 美国化的AD-AS模型；6. 金发女孩区域理论；7. 货币非中性理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法：通过分析全球美元循环，重构国民收入核算恒等式，对美国化的IS-LM和AD-AS模型进行系统性重构，并进行理论推导和分析。
AI.findings: 1. 美国贸易赤字具有内生性，可作为通胀缓冲的"安全垫"；2. 美国经济需要内生贸易赤字和缓冲贸易赤字协同才能达到就业强劲、物价稳定的"金发女孩区域"；3. 美联储货币政策实质上是引导经济进入这一最优状态的机制；4. "美元红利"从根本上改变了货币属性，使货币在长期内也保持非中性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了总收入(Z=Y+NI)概念并重构国民收入核算恒等式；2. 建立了美国化的IS-LM和AD-AS模型框架；3. 发展了贸易赤字内生性理论；4. 深化了货币非中性理论，特别是美元特权下的长期非中性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解美国贸易赤字的经济功能提供新视角；2. 为美联储货币政策制定提供理论指导；3. 为评估美元特权对全球经济的影响提供分析框架；4. 为其他经济体在美元体系下的政策选择提供参考。

title: Impact of Land Use Land Cover Change on Ecosystem Service Values: The Case of Woreda 10 Gulele Sub-City, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
affiliations: Ethiopian Civil Service University

detail.title: Impact of Land Use Land Cover Change on Ecosystem Service Values: The Case of Woreda 10 Gulele Sub-City, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Land-use and land-cover change significantly impact ecosystem services, serving as vital indicators of ecological transformations. This study, focusing on Gulele sub-city, aimed to evaluate the impact of such changes on the value of ecosystem services. By utilizing mixed research methods and diverse data sources, the study revealed shifts in land cover types, namely, forest, open space, and settlement. The findings indicated an alarming trend, with settlements expanding by 36.29%, while forests and open spaces experienced reductions of 43.49% and 20%, respectively, between 1994 and 2024. Urbanization, infrastructure development, and population growth were identified as key drivers of these changes. The analysis of ecosystem service values over this period demonstrated a decline in the value of forest and open space, emphasizing the need to address the adverse effects of land-use land cover changes on ecosystem services. The ecosystem service value from 1994-2024 of forest was decreased by $-0.014807 and open space was decreased from 0.037576 to 0.0259128 which was decreased by $-0.0116632 million, to mitigate the loss of ecosystem service value, the study recommended enhancing community participation in conservation efforts, identifying priority ecosystems for protection, and reinforcing land management regulations. It underscored the necessity of a comprehensive approach involving stakeholders. In conclusion, this study underscores the urgency of proactive measures to safeguard ecosystem services in the face of land-use and land-cover changes. By implementing the recommended strategies and engaging stakeholders, Gulele sub-city can work towards preserving its natural resources and ensuring a sustainable environment for future generations.

detail.abstract:
Executive Summary

Current Condition and Future Concerns for Growth in Illinois’ State Revenue. IGPA’s Fiscal Futures project produces annual reports analyzing Illinois’s fiscal condition and long-term trends to inform policy decisions. This report examines FY2025 revenue trends with three main findings: (1) Re-categorization of individual and corporate income tax revenues has complicated data interpretation; (2) Evidence suggests long-term decline in state sales tax revenue, though COVID-era volatility obscures clear trends; and (3) Federal policy changes will significantly decrease health-care-related funding, posing serious longer-term challenges.

FY2025 Revenue Performance. Since 1998, total nominal (i.e. not adjusted for inflation) revenue has grown at almost five percent per year. As in past years, the largest categories of Illinois revenues continue to be the individual income tax, federal revenues for Medicaid, and the sales tax. Total revenues reached $93.5 billion in FY2025, up from $91.1 billion in FY2024. However, the one-year growth rate significantly lagged the long-term trend across most categories.

title: The Innovation Channel of Fiscal Space
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome, European Stability Mechanism and European Stability Mechanism

detail.title: The Innovation Channel of Fiscal Space

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 75
publicationDetails.journalName: European Stability Mechanism (ESM) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the effects of shrinking fiscal space and the resulting fiscal consolidation on private and public expenditure in research and development (R&D). In a sample of OECD countries, we find R&D expenditure strongly influenced by the available fiscal space, with this relationship being particularly pronounced in less innovative countries. To better understand this relationship, we further explore a potential transmission channel: fiscal consolidation. Our analysis shows that the spending cuts in public allocations to R&D driven by fiscal adjustments are more pronounced in less innovative countries, suggesting the presence of a doom loop between consolidations and low domestic R&D intensity. Finally, the composition of consolidations matters: tax-based adjustments have a significantly negative impact on total domestic R&D spending, primarily due to the sharp contraction they induce in business R&D investments.

AI.tldr: 研究财政空间缩减和财政整顿对研发支出的影响，发现财政空间对研发支出有显著影响，特别是在创新水平较低的国家。财政整顿会削减公共研发支出，形成"厄运循环"，而税收调整对总研发支出的负面影响最大。

AI.theoretical_framework: 财政空间理论、财政整顿理论、创新经济学、研发投资决定因素理论

AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了财政空间与研发支出的非线性关系；2. 识别了财政整顿作为传导渠道的作用机制；3. 提出了"厄运循环"理论来解释低创新国家财政整顿的负面效应

title: Excellence Funds, Excellent Outcomes? Lessons from Italian University Departments
affiliations: University of Zurich, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1505
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the causal effects of a competitive excellence initiative financing Italy’s top twenty-five per cent university departments. We exploit a novel linkage of administrative data regarding faculty careers, publications, departmental activities, and student enrollment to estimate the effects of the policy in a dynamic difference-in-differences framework. In direct terms, the additional financial resources allowed funded departments to increase their faculty size but had a limited impact on course offerings. Indirectly, the excellence designation led to higher student enrollment, particularly among high-achieving ones, suggesting a positive quality signal. The funding boosted scientific output but not productivity, except in large STEM and Life Sciences departments, which benefited from agglomeration effects and improved research infrastructure.

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investment and CO 2 Emissions in South Asia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive funding from any public, private, or non-profit organization.

detail.abstract: In the past two decades, South Asia has experienced rapid economic development while becoming increasingly vulnerable to climate change and environmental degradation. Foreign direct investment has played a major role in the growth process, raising concerns that developing countries are attracting pollution-intensive activities from stringently regulated countries, consistent with the pollution haven hypothesis. This paper examines the relationship between FDI inflows and carbon dioxide emissions per capita in South Asia. Although we find some evidence suggesting a positive association between FDI and emissions in simple crosscountry comparisons, this relationship is weakened when broader economic and structural factors are taken into account. Overall, despite rising concerns the results find little support for the pollution haven hypothesis effect in South Asia.

title: Where Are Mortgage Delinquencies Rising the Most?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Where Are Mortgage Delinquencies Rising the Most?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Federal Reserve Bank of New York’s Center for Microeconomic Data recently released its Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit for the fourth quarter of 2025, revealing continued growth in household debt balances. Aggregate household debt balances rose by $191 billion to reach $18.8 trillion, marking a $4.6 trillion increase since the end of 2019. Mortgage balances grew by $98 billion to $13.2 trillion, while credit card debt increased by $44 billion to $1.28 trillion. Credit card and auto loan delinquency rates appear to have stabilized, albeit at elevated rates. By contrast, the delinquency rate for mortgages—although still near low levels on a longer-term basis—has been steadily increasing over the past few years. Underlying these aggregate figures, however, there are notable differences in mortgage credit performance across places with different income levels and labor and housing market dynamics. This analysis, as well as the Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit, are based on anonymous credit report data from Equifax.
