AI.tldr: 纽约联储2025年第四季度家庭债务报告显示，美国家庭债务总额增至18.8万亿美元，抵押贷款和信用卡债务持续增长。虽然信用卡和汽车贷款违约率趋于稳定，但抵押贷款违约率在低收入地区和劳动力/住房市场疲软地区上升明显。
AI.research_question: 抵押贷款违约率在不同收入水平和劳动力/住房市场动态的地区之间存在怎样的差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国家庭债务总额持续增长，但抵押贷款违约率呈现上升趋势，特别是在某些地区。需要了解这种违约率上升的地理分布特征及其背后的社会经济因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区域经济差异理论，分析不同收入水平、劳动力市场状况和住房市场动态对抵押贷款违约率的影响。
AI.method: 使用Equifax匿名信用报告数据，分析2025年第四季度家庭债务和信用状况，特别关注抵押贷款违约率在不同地区的分布。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭债务总额增长1910亿美元至18.8万亿美元；2. 抵押贷款余额增长980亿美元至13.2万亿美元；3. 信用卡债务增长440亿美元至1.28万亿美元；4. 信用卡和汽车贷款违约率趋于稳定但处于高位；5. 抵押贷款违约率持续上升，特别是在低收入和劳动力/住房市场疲软地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了区域经济差异对抵押贷款违约率的影响机制，为理解债务违约的地理分布提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别抵押贷款风险高发地区的依据，有助于针对性地制定金融稳定政策和住房支持措施。

title: Time's Up! The End of ESSER Funding and the Future of Illinois School Districts
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: Time's Up! The End of ESSER Funding and the Future of Illinois School Districts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute of Government and Public Affairs Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Illinois Institute of Government & Public Affairs Policy Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Executive Summary

The federal Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief (ESSER) program delivered $200 billion nationally between 2020-2025, including $7.8 billion for Illinois, to stabilize school operations during COVID-19, address learning loss, expand digital access, support student mental health, reduce class sizes, and sustain critical staffing. The expiration of this funding marks a pivotal turning point in K–12 education finance. Districts serving low-income students relied heavily on ESSER to launch and scale tutoring programs, extended learning opportunities, counseling services, and literacy initiatives that helped narrow post-pandemic achievement gaps. These districts now face mounting fiscal pressures that threaten to reverse hard-won gains. This Policy Brief examines ESSER’s sunset impact on the 2025–2026 school year and identifies state policy options to sustain its most effective interventions.

What did Illinois districts spend ESSER funding on, and what progress was made?

ESSER funds in Illinois have primarily been directed toward five focal areas (Illinois State Board of Education, 2025):

  •     Expanding tutoring and intervention programs to address learning loss
  •     Investing in technology and broadband access for remote learning
  •     Enhancing mental health and social-emotional support services
  •     Hiring additional staff and reducing class sizes
  •     Implementing COVID-19 safety protocols in school buildings       

While comprehensive impact evaluation continues, available data show positive relationships between ESSER investment and student outcomes. Illinois districts allocating approximately 45% of ESSER funds to staffing maintained higher math and reading achievement on IAR and SAT assessments during the pandemic, while districts investing only 3% in staffing experienced larger achievement declines and slower recovery (Cashdollar et al., 2024).

Chicago Public Schools exemplifies these patterns. Serving 17% of Illinois students (90% students of color, 71% low-income), CPS experienced larger pandemic-related achievement declines than the state average but demonstrated faster recovery rates in both IAR reading and math (Barragan Torres et al., 2024).

What are the implications?

With ESSER funding expired and Illinois facing budget challenges, districts that expanded tutoring, hired counselors and social workers, and reduced class sizes with federal dollars are now scaling back (ISBE, 2024). In turn, many districts expect larger class sizes, with many anticipating hiring delays or position losses (Smylie, 2025). Education stakeholders are watching how these changes affect student outcomes, especially for populations that benefited most from expanded services (FutureEd, 2024).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国联邦ESSER资金（新冠疫情紧急教育救济金）在伊利诺伊州的支出情况及其影响，探讨资金到期后对K-12教育的挑战，并提出政策建议以维持有效干预措施。
AI.research_question: ESSER资金在伊利诺伊州如何被使用？取得了哪些进展？资金到期后对2025-2026学年有何影响？州政府应采取哪些政策选项来维持最有效的干预措施？
AI.motivation: ESSER资金为学校应对新冠疫情提供了关键支持，特别是对低收入学生学区。随着资金到期，这些学区面临财政压力，可能逆转已取得的成果，需要政策干预来维持教育公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育财政政策分析、教育公平理论、资源分配与学业成就关系、危机应对与教育恢复理论。
AI.method: 政策简报分析，基于伊利诺伊州教育委员会数据、现有研究成果（如Cashdollar等，2024；Barragan Torres等，2024）和机构报告（ISBE，2024；FutureEd，2024）的二次分析。
AI.findings:
1. ESSER资金主要用于五个领域：补习干预、技术宽带、心理健康服务、人员招聘和班级规模缩减、安全协议
2. 将45%资金用于人员配置的学区在数学和阅读成绩上表现更好
3. 芝加哥公立学校虽然初始成绩下降更大，但恢复速度更快
4. 资金到期导致服务缩减、班级规模扩大、职位减少
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了危机时期针对性教育投资对学业恢复的有效性
2. 揭示了资源分配策略（特别是人员投入）与学业成就的直接关系
3. 提出了教育紧急资金退出后的持续影响理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为伊利诺伊州政策制定者提供维持有效干预的具体选项
2. 帮助学区规划后ESSER时代的财政策略
3. 为其他面临类似资金到期挑战的州提供参考
4. 强调对低收入学生学区的持续支持必要性

title: Households' use of Digital Banking
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Households' use of Digital Banking

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper (Topic) No. 976
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper describes the factors affecting households’ use of digital banking. The analysis relies on information from the Regional Bank Lending Survey on the supply of digital services by Italian banks and on data from the Survey on Household Income and Wealth regarding households’ use of remote connections with banks. The use of digital channels is more widespread among households with greater economic resources and where the main income earner has a higher level of education and stronger financial and digital skills; conversely, it is negatively associated with the main income earner’s age. The use of digital banking also increases among households whose relationship with the financial system is more complex (in terms of, e.g. having connections with multiple banks, investing in financial assets, or holding debt). Finally, some characteristics of the banks themselves (e.g. a more developed provision of digital services, or a more limited local branch network) are reflected in a broader recourse to remote interactions between intermediaries and customers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了影响家庭使用数字银行的因素，发现经济资源、教育水平、金融数字技能、年龄、与金融系统的复杂程度以及银行自身特征都会影响数字银行的使用。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响家庭使用数字银行？
AI.motivation: 随着数字银行服务的发展，了解影响家庭采用数字银行的因素对于理解金融包容性和数字鸿沟问题具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字鸿沟理论、金融包容性理论、技术采纳模型
AI.method: 使用意大利地区银行借贷调查（关于银行数字服务供给）和家庭收入与财富调查（关于家庭与银行的远程连接使用）的数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 经济资源越多、主要收入者教育水平越高、金融数字技能越强的家庭更广泛使用数字渠道；2. 主要收入者年龄与数字银行使用呈负相关；3. 与金融系统关系更复杂的家庭（如与多家银行有联系、投资金融资产或持有债务）更倾向于使用数字银行；4. 银行自身特征（如数字服务发展程度更高、本地分行网络更有限）也会影响客户远程互动的广泛程度
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字鸿沟理论在金融领域的应用，深化了对金融科技采纳影响因素的理解，为技术采纳模型提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行制定数字服务策略提供依据，帮助政策制定者设计促进金融包容性的措施，为缩小数字鸿沟提供实践指导

title: Mechanization as Insurance: Evidence from Nepal's Plains

detail.title: Mechanization as Insurance: Evidence from Nepal's Plains
detail.abstract: Mechanization service markets have expanded rapidly across South Asia, allowing even very small farms to rent machinery. Using household data from Nepal, we examine whether mechanization improves farm profitability or primarily mitigates risk. We estimate scale-interacted efficiency and risk models using net farm income outcomes. Mechanization intensity shows no significant association with net farm income per hectare for the smallest landholders but generates strong positive returns for mid-sized farms In contrast, higher mechanization intensity significantly reduces the probability of negative net farm income across all farm sizes. These findings indicate that mechanization functions primarily as an insurance mechanism for smallholders facing labor scarcity rather than as a pathway to income growth. The results highlight the importance of scale in determining returns to service-based mechanization and suggest that access alone is insufficient to generate productivity gains among the smallest farms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，尼泊尔的机械化服务市场主要作为小农户的风险管理工具而非收入增长途径。机械化强度与最小规模农户的单位面积净收入无显著关联，但对中等规模农场有正向回报。机械化显著降低了所有规模农场的负净收入概率，表明其主要功能是应对劳动力短缺的保险机制。
AI.research_question: 机械化服务市场主要改善农场盈利能力还是主要缓解风险？机械化对不同规模农场的回报有何差异？
AI.motivation: 南亚机械化服务市场快速发展，即使是小农场也能租用机械，但机械化对农场盈利能力的影响机制尚不明确，特别是对不同规模农场的差异化影响需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模交互的效率与风险模型，分析机械化强度与净农场收入的关系，区分效率提升效应和风险缓解效应。
AI.method: 使用尼泊尔家庭数据，估计规模交互的效率模型和风险模型，以净农场收入为结果变量，分析机械化强度对不同规模农场的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 机械化强度与最小土地持有者的单位面积净收入无显著关联，但对中等规模农场产生强劲正向回报；2) 更高的机械化强度显著降低了所有农场规模的负净收入概率；3) 机械化主要作为小农户应对劳动力短缺的保险机制而非收入增长途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 阐明了机械化服务市场的双重功能（效率提升与风险缓解）；2) 揭示了规模在决定服务型机械化回报中的关键作用；3) 提出了机械化作为保险机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 政策制定者应认识到单纯提供机械化服务不足以提高最小规模农场的生产率；2) 需要针对不同规模农场设计差异化的机械化支持政策；3) 强调风险管理功能对维持小农户生计的重要性。

title: The Redistributive Effects of in-Kind Transfers in Italy
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Redistributive Effects of in-Kind Transfers in Italy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 977
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In-kind transfers, such as healthcare and education services, represent a substantial portion of public expenditure in most advanced economies, yet they are rarely included in analyses of tax-benefit systems due to the methodological challenges in assessing their monetary value. This paper adds an in-kind transfer module to an otherwise standard microsimulation model of the Italian household sector. Following established methodologies, we evaluate the health, education, childcare, and social housing services enjoyed by each beneficiary. We find that in-kind benefits follow a distinctively U-shaped age profile and are more uniformly distributed across income levels compared to cash benefits. In-kind transfers increase net disposable income by 20 percent, on average, and almost 60 per cent for lower-income households, therefore playing a crucial role in reducing inequality. These results confirm the importance of including in-kind transfers in distributional analyses for a more complete understanding of welfare systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将实物转移模块整合到意大利家庭部门的微观模拟模型中，量化了医疗、教育、托儿和社会住房等实物转移的价值，发现实物转移具有U形年龄分布特征，比现金转移更均匀地分布在各个收入水平，平均增加净可支配收入20%，对低收入家庭增加近60%，显著降低不平等。
AI.research_question: 如何将实物转移（如医疗、教育、托儿和社会住房服务）纳入税收福利系统的分布分析中，以及这些实物转移对意大利家庭收入分配和不平等的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 实物转移在大多数发达经济体的公共支出中占很大比重，但由于评估其货币价值的方法学挑战，很少被纳入税收福利系统分析。这导致对福利系统的理解不完整，需要开发方法将实物转移纳入分布分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于福利经济学和公共财政理论，特别是关于实物转移与现金转移在再分配效果和效率方面的比较理论，以及微观模拟模型在政策评估中的应用框架。
AI.method: 在标准的意大利家庭部门微观模拟模型中增加实物转移模块，采用既定方法评估每个受益人享受的医疗、教育、托儿和社会住房服务的货币价值。
AI.findings: 1) 实物转移呈现明显的U形年龄分布特征；2) 与现金转移相比，实物转移在各收入水平间的分布更均匀；3) 实物转移平均增加净可支配收入20%，对低收入家庭增加近60%；4) 实物转移在减少不平等方面发挥关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了将实物转移纳入微观模拟模型的方法学框架；2) 提供了实物转移在福利系统中再分配效应的实证证据；3) 验证了实物转移在年龄和收入维度上的分布特征理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了更完整的福利系统评估工具；2) 揭示了实物转移在减少不平等方面的实际效果；3) 强调了在分布分析中纳入实物转移的重要性，为福利政策改革提供依据。

title:
Left Behind: The Health Consequences of Failed Retrofit Delivery During the Energy Crisis
A Difference-in-Differences Analysis of Energy Efficiency and Respiratory Health (2015- 2024)
affiliations: The University of Manchester

detail.title:
Left Behind: The Health Consequences of Failed Retrofit Delivery During the Energy Crisis
A Difference-in-Differences Analysis of Energy Efficiency and Respiratory Health (2015- 2024)
detail.abstract: We employ a Difference-in-Differences design to evaluate the health trajectory of deprived areas targeted by the Greater Manchester Warm Homes Plan. Analyzing a balanced panel of 1,510 MSOA-year observations (2015-2024), we find that policy eligibility failed to deliver differential improvements in energy efficiency (βEPC ≈ 0). However, these communities experienced a significant increase in respiratory admissions (β = 5.92, p < 0.01) during the 2021-2022 energy crisis. The results indicate that pre-existing housing vulnerabilities, unmitigated by policy delivery, left deprived populations exposed to the price shock. The findings suggest that retrofit programs require complementary income support to protect vulnerable households during energy price volatility.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用双重差分法评估大曼彻斯特温暖家园计划对贫困地区健康轨迹的影响。研究发现政策资格未能改善能源效率，但在2021-2022年能源危机期间，这些社区的呼吸道疾病住院率显著增加，表明现有住房脆弱性未得到缓解，使贫困人口暴露于价格冲击。
AI.research_question: 大曼彻斯特温暖家园计划对目标贫困地区的能源效率和健康结果（特别是呼吸道疾病住院率）产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 评估针对贫困地区的住房改造计划在能源危机期间的实际效果，了解政策是否有效缓解了住房脆弱性对居民健康的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房脆弱性理论、能源贫困理论、健康社会决定因素理论，以及政策干预在危机时期对弱势群体保护的有效性。
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计，分析2015-2024年期间1,510个MSOA-年份观测值的平衡面板数据。
AI.findings:
1. 政策资格未能带来能源效率的差异化改善（βEPC ≈ 0）
2. 在2021-2022年能源危机期间，这些社区的呼吸道疾病住院率显著增加（β = 5.92, p < 0.01）
3. 现有住房脆弱性未得到政策缓解，使贫困人口暴露于价格冲击
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了住房改造计划在能源危机期间的局限性
2. 强调了住房脆弱性与健康结果之间的动态关系
3. 提出了政策干预需要结合收入支持的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 建议改造计划需要配套的收入支持措施
2. 为政策制定者提供了在能源价格波动期间保护弱势家庭的实证依据
3. 指出了单纯技术性改造不足以应对系统性危机

title: Rental Markets and the Mechanization of Smallholder Agriculture: Evidence from Nepal’s Terai

detail.title: Rental Markets and the Mechanization of Smallholder Agriculture: Evidence from Nepal’s Terai
detail.abstract: Using cross-sectional household survey data from Nepal's Terai, we document that smallholders are associated with larger gains in cropping intensity from rental market use compared to large farms. While conventional wisdom holds that agricultural mechanization favors large farms due to economies of scale, over 80% of smallholders in our sample use tractor services despite ownership rates below 5%. These findings provide suggestive evidence that rental markets may expand technology access for resourceconstrained farmers without capital-intensive ownership.

AI.tldr: 尼泊尔Terai地区的研究发现，小农户通过租赁市场使用拖拉机服务，比大农场获得更高的种植强度提升。尽管机械化通常被认为有利于大农场，但80%以上的小农户使用拖拉机租赁服务，尽管所有权率低于5%。
AI.research_question: 租赁市场如何影响不同规模农户的农业机械化采用和种植强度？小农户是否能够通过租赁市场获得与大农场相似的机械化收益？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为农业机械化因规模经济而有利于大农场，但现实中许多小农户通过租赁市场使用机械化服务。需要研究租赁市场是否能为资源受限的小农户提供技术获取途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业机械化经济学、规模经济理论、租赁市场理论、资源约束下的技术采用理论
AI.method: 使用尼泊尔Terai地区的横截面家庭调查数据，比较不同规模农户通过租赁市场使用拖拉机服务对种植强度的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 小农户通过租赁市场使用拖拉机服务获得的种植强度提升大于大农场；2. 超过80%的小农户使用拖拉机服务，尽管所有权率低于5%；3. 租赁市场可能为资源受限的农户提供无需资本密集型所有权的技术获取途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了机械化必然有利于大农场的传统观点，提出了租赁市场作为小农户技术获取替代途径的理论框架，丰富了资源约束下技术采用的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了支持农业机械租赁市场发展的依据，特别是针对小农户的技术推广策略，有助于提高小农户的生产效率和收入。

title: Designing Audit-Safe LLC Governance: Control, Economic Substance, and Retrospective Oversight Under South Carolina Law
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: Designing Audit-Safe LLC Governance: Control, Economic Substance, and Retrospective Oversight Under South Carolina Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or professional relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research or its conclusions. The views expressed are solely those of the author and are presented for scholarly purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This Article is a doctrinal legal analysis based exclusively on publicly available legal sources, including statutes, judicial opinions, and secondary literature. It does not involve human participants, private data, or experimental methods, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

keywords: and Retrospective Oversight Under South Carolina Law

detail.abstract:
This Article presents a governance framework for limited liability companies that addresses a pervasive structural issue in American LLC law: the disconnect between ex ante transactional drafting and ex post regulatory, audit, and judicial scrutiny. While operating agreements are generally afforded broad deference under modern LLC statutes, courts and regulators frequently reconstruct control, fiduciary compliance, and economic substance retrospectively. This practice exposes the inadequacy of purely contractual solutions in contexts where non-waivable statutory duties impose mandatory governance requirements.

The Article introduces a five-layer audit-safe governance framework—comprising Narrative, Schedule, Exhibit, Appendix, and Interpretive layers—intended to align private ordering with the evidentiary standards applied by courts and federal auditors. The framework is specifically designed to accommodate trust-integrated ownership structures, addressing audit vulnerabilities that emerge when beneficial interests are separated from operational control. Each layer serves a distinct function in countering control-by-conduct arguments, documenting independent economic activity, and establishing contemporaneous business purpose.

By situating the framework within South Carolina's Limited Liability Company Act and recent appellate decisions, the Article demonstrates that cases such as Park Regency, Historic Charleston Holdings v. Mallon, and Boathouse at Breach Inlet exemplify a judicial willingness to reconstruct LLC control based on substantive realities rather than formal documentation. South Carolina's mandatory fiduciary provisions render purely contractual approaches doctrinally vulnerable.

The framework's evidentiary architecture is broadly applicable and not limited to a single jurisdiction. Mandatory duties of good faith and fair dealing persist across Revised Uniform Limited Liability Company Act jurisdictions, and even contractarian regimes such as Delaware increasingly examine whether governance structures reflect economic reality. By treating South Carolina as the highest common denominator, where judicial reconstruction is most rigorous, the Article positions the framework as a national model for audit-resilient LLC governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个五层审计安全治理框架，旨在解决美国有限责任公司法律中普遍存在的结构性问题：事前交易起草与事后监管、审计和司法审查之间的脱节。该框架通过叙事层、附表层、附件层、附录层和解释层，使私人订制安排与法院和联邦审计师应用的证据标准保持一致。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个治理框架来解决美国有限责任公司法律中事前交易起草与事后监管、审计和司法审查之间的脱节问题？
AI.motivation: 现代有限责任公司法规通常对运营协议给予广泛尊重，但法院和监管机构经常追溯性地重构控制权、受托责任合规性和经济实质。这种做法暴露了在不可放弃的法定职责施加强制性治理要求的背景下，纯粹合同解决方案的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于合同理论与强制性治理要求的张力，探讨了私人订制与司法重构之间的冲突。特别关注信托整合所有权结构下的审计漏洞，以及控制权与运营权分离带来的治理挑战。
AI.method: 本文采用法律分析和案例研究方法，以南卡罗来纳州有限责任公司法案和近期上诉法院判决（如Park Regency、Historic Charleston Holdings v. Mallon、Boathouse at Breach Inlet等案例）为基础，构建五层治理框架。
AI.findings: 法院倾向于基于实质现实而非正式文件来重构有限责任公司控制权。南卡罗来纳州的强制性受托条款使纯粹合同方法在理论上存在漏洞。五层框架能有效应对控制权行为论证、记录独立经济活动并建立同时期商业目的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统的五层审计安全治理框架理论，弥合了合同自由与强制性治理要求之间的鸿沟。该理论强调证据架构在有限责任公司治理中的核心作用，为理解司法重构现象提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的治理框架，帮助有限责任公司设计审计弹性治理结构。该框架特别适用于信托整合所有权结构，能有效应对法院和监管机构的追溯性审查，具有全国适用性。

title: The Blown Head Gasket Effect: Rise and struggles of The Drivers Cooperative in New York City
affiliations: Scuola Normale Superiore

detail.title: The Blown Head Gasket Effect: Rise and struggles of The Drivers Cooperative in New York City
detail.abstract: This paper presents an in-depth case study of The Drivers Cooperative (TDC), a driver-owned ride-hailing platform based in New York City, to examine the challenges faced by multistakeholder platform cooperatives. Drawing on 16 semi-structured interviews, six months of participant observation, and extensive desk research, the study traces how TDC’s growth efforts ultimately led to a fracture between its cooperative membership and its platform infrastructure. This dynamic – conceptualised as the Blown Head Gasket Effect – illustrates how diverging stakeholders can fracture during the development of democratic platform alternatives. Factors such as limited access to capital, political divergence among stakeholders, and temporal pressures are identified as key drivers of this effect. The paper concludes by discussing TDC’s legislative achievements and offering practical recommendations for cooperative practitioners and policy interventions. By situating TDC within broader debates on platform cooperativism and the digital solidarity economy, the study underscores the importance of learning from defeats to enhance cooperative business resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文通过纽约司机合作社的案例研究，揭示了多利益相关者平台合作社面临的挑战，特别是"爆缸效应"如何导致合作社成员与平台基础设施之间的裂痕。
AI.research_question: 多利益相关者平台合作社在发展过程中面临哪些挑战？特别是，为什么司机合作社的增长努力最终导致其合作社会员与平台基础设施之间的裂痕？
AI.motivation: 随着平台经济的发展，平台合作社作为民主替代方案受到关注，但对其实际运作中的挑战了解有限。通过研究司机合作社的案例，可以深入了解多利益相关者平台合作社面临的具体困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台合作主义、数字团结经济、多利益相关者治理理论、民主平台替代方案理论
AI.method: 深度案例研究，采用16个半结构化访谈、6个月的参与式观察和广泛的案头研究
AI.findings: 司机合作社的增长努力导致了"爆缸效应"，即合作社会员与平台基础设施之间的裂痕。关键驱动因素包括：资本获取有限、利益相关者之间的政治分歧、时间压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"爆缸效应"概念，解释了多利益相关者平台合作社在发展过程中如何因利益分歧而破裂；丰富了平台合作主义和数字团结经济的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合作社实践者提供了实用建议；提出了政策干预建议；强调了从失败中学习以增强合作社业务韧性的重要性；记录了司机合作社的立法成就。

title: Geometric Phase Transitions in Wealth Distribution: A Structural Accretion Model within the EMIS Framework

detail.title: Geometric Phase Transitions in Wealth Distribution: A Structural Accretion Model within the EMIS Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Empirical studies in econophysics, notably by Yakovenko (2000), have identified a robust "tworegime" structure in income and wealth distributions: an exponential Boltzmann-Gibbs bulk encompassing the majority of the population, followed by a Pareto power-law tail. While stochastic models successfully reproduce these statistical patterns through additive and multiplicative dynamics, they offer limited insight into the structural mechanism underlying the transition between the two regimes. This paper proposes a geometric and thermodynamic interpretation within the EMIS (Energy-Matter-Information-Spacetime) framework. Adopting an analytical analogy rather than asserting a literal physical equivalence, we model money as a conserved flow variable and capital as a form of accumulated structural constraint. Within this representation, the lower-income regime corresponds to a thermal phase governed by maximum-entropy dynamics, whereas the upper tail emerges as an accretion-dominated regime driven by structural amplification. We show that the transition from the exponential to the power-law distribution can be interpreted as a geometric phase transition, in which sufficient structural accumulation alters the effective economic metric and enables self-reinforcing growth. Under this view, persistent poverty arises as a maximum-entropy equilibrium of unstructured exchange, while wealth concentration appears as a symmetry-breaking outcome associated with structural curvature. By reframing wealth distribution through a unified geometric lens, this work provides a generative mechanism linking statistical regularities, inequality persistence, and capital accumulation, and serves as a methodological foundation for subsequent domain-specific analyses within the EMIS framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用EMIS框架的几何热力学视角解释收入财富分布的"双区制"现象：低收入群体遵循最大熵的热相分布，高收入尾端则是由结构放大驱动的吸积主导机制，两者间的转换可视为几何相变。
AI.research_question: 如何从几何热力学角度解释收入财富分布中指数分布（玻尔兹曼-吉布斯）与幂律分布（帕累托）之间的转换机制？
AI.motivation: 现有随机模型虽能重现收入财富的统计模式，但无法解释两种分布之间的结构性转换机制，需要从更基础的物理类比角度提供生成性解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: EMIS（能量-物质-信息-时空）框架，将货币视为守恒流动变量，资本视为积累的结构约束，采用分析类比而非字面物理等价的方法。
AI.method: 几何热力学解释方法，通过建立经济系统的几何表示，将收入分布映射到热相（最大熵）和吸积主导相（结构放大）两个区域。
AI.findings: 低收入区对应最大熵动态的热相，高收入尾端是结构放大驱动的吸积主导机制，两者转换是几何相变，结构积累改变经济度量并实现自我强化增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供收入财富分布双区制现象的生成机制解释；2. 将分布转换概念化为几何相变；3. 建立连接统计规律、不平等持续性和资本积累的统一框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后续领域特定分析提供方法论基础，有助于理解贫困持续（无结构交换的最大熵平衡）和财富集中（结构曲率相关的对称破缺结果）的深层机制。

title: Global Modeling of The Role of Microplastics in Riverine Pathogen Transport, Exposure, And Risks
affiliations: , Wageningen University, Wageningen University, Wageningen University and Research (WUR), Wageningen University and Wageningen University

detail.title: Global Modeling of The Role of Microplastics in Riverine Pathogen Transport, Exposure, And Risks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors would like to thank the Aquatic Ecology and Water Quality Management Group of Wageningen University & Research and the China Scholarship Council (CSC) for financial support.

publicationDetails.detailsText: We submitted this manuscript to Water Research, and it is under review now.

detail.abstract: Concern persists that pathogens attaching to microplastics (MPs) may spread farther in rivers and elevate public health risks. Yet whether pathogen flux carried on riverine MP substantially augments transport via river water is unknown. We quantified, under global river conditions, the fraction of pathogen transport attributable to MP attachment. Riverine MP concentrations were simulated with the MARINA-Plastics model and pathogen concentrations with the GloWPa model at a global sub-basin resolution. We assessed Cryptosporidium worldwide and Escherichia coli (E. coli) for China at the same sub-basin resolution. For the first time, outputs from MP and pathogen models were integrated to estimate MP-pathogen binding probabilistically across rivers. Attachment was represented with an empirical Freundlich sorption formulation parameterized from literature data. Predicted MP-bound E. coli concentrations exceeded those of Cryptosporidium, reflecting stronger sorption and higher bacterial abundances. Despite this, MP-associated pathogens constituted only a negligible share of riverine pathogen transport fluxes, implying that MP contributes little to pathogen-related public health impacts at the scales considered. The framework can be extended to evaluate risks from hazardous particles and co-transported contaminants, including other pathogens, metals, and organic chemicals, to inform evidence-based policy and monitoring priorities.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次整合微塑料和病原体模型，量化了河流中病原体通过微塑料传播的比例，发现尽管微塑料能吸附病原体，但其对河流病原体总运输通量的贡献微乎其微。
AI.research_question: 河流中附着在微塑料上的病原体运输通量是否显著增加了通过河水运输的病原体总量？
AI.motivation: 公众持续担忧病原体附着在微塑料上可能在河流中传播更远并增加公共卫生风险，但尚不清楚微塑料携带的病原体通量是否显著增加了河流运输的病原体总量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Freundlich吸附等温线理论，使用经验性吸附公式参数化文献数据来模拟病原体在微塑料上的附着过程。
AI.method: 整合MARINA-Plastics模型（模拟河流微塑料浓度）和GloWPa模型（模拟病原体浓度），在全球子流域分辨率下进行概率性估计微塑料-病原体结合；评估全球隐孢子虫和中国大肠杆菌。
AI.findings: 预测的微塑料结合大肠杆菌浓度高于隐孢子虫，反映了更强的吸附能力和更高的细菌丰度；但微塑料相关病原体仅占河流病原体运输通量的极小部分，表明微塑料在考虑的尺度上对病原体相关的公共卫生影响贡献很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将微塑料和病原体模型输出整合，建立了评估河流中微塑料-病原体结合概率的框架；为评估有害颗粒物和共运输污染物风险提供了理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明微塑料对病原体传播的贡献有限，有助于制定基于证据的政策和监测优先级；框架可扩展用于评估其他病原体、金属和有机化学品的风险。

title: Mathematical Foundations of Organizational Thermodynamics: Non-smooth Dynamics, Differential Inclusions, and the Bifurcation of Survival
affiliations: Otaru University of Commerce - Department of Economics

detail.title: Mathematical Foundations of Organizational Thermodynamics: Non-smooth Dynamics, Differential Inclusions, and the Bifurcation of Survival
detail.abstract: This paper establishes the rigorous mathematical foundations for the "Grand Unified Equation" of Organizational Thermodynamics proposed in the author's preceding pentalogy. While previous models described the organization as a dissipative structure governed by the Schrödinger Condition, the governing equation contains a discontinuous signum function, sgn(ΔL), representing the discrete nature of structural transformation costs. Consequently, standard theories of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) fail to guarantee the existence of solutions at the switching surface ΔL = 0. By reformatting the system as a Differential Inclusion and applying the concept of convex sets to the discontinuity, we prove the existence of solutions even at singular points. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the lack of uniqueness at the origin provides the mathematical basis for "Strategic Bifurcation," proving that organizational survival is not deterministic but a stochastic choice between "Stagnation (Heat Death)" and "Innovation (Negentropy Intake)".

AI.tldr: 本文为组织热力学的"大一统方程"建立了严格的数学基础，解决了原方程中符号函数不连续性导致的解存在性问题，证明了在奇异点解的存在性，并揭示了战略分岔的数学基础。
AI.research_question: 如何为包含不连续符号函数的组织热力学大一统方程建立严格的数学基础，保证解的存在性，并解释组织战略分岔的数学机制？
AI.motivation: 先前提出的组织热力学模型包含不连续的符号函数sgn(ΔL)，代表结构转型成本的离散性，这导致标准ODE理论无法保证在切换面ΔL=0处解的存在性，需要建立严格的数学基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织热力学、耗散结构理论、薛定谔条件、微分包含理论、凸集理论、动力系统理论
AI.method: 将系统重新表述为微分包含，应用凸集概念处理不连续性，通过数学证明方法验证解的存在性
AI.findings: 1. 通过微分包含方法证明了即使在奇异点ΔL=0处解也存在；2. 原点处解的非唯一性为"战略分岔"提供了数学基础；3. 组织生存不是确定性的，而是在"停滞（热寂）"和"创新（负熵摄入）"之间的随机选择
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为组织热力学的大一统方程建立了严格的数学基础；2. 将微分包含理论应用于组织动力学研究；3. 揭示了战略分岔的数学机制；4. 扩展了耗散结构理论在组织研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织转型决策提供了数学支持；2. 帮助管理者理解组织变革中的不确定性；3. 为组织战略选择提供了理论框架；4. 增强了组织热力学模型的实际应用价值

title: Deriving the Fisher Equation from First Principles: The Economy as a 2D Fluid Manifold

detail.title: Deriving the Fisher Equation from First Principles: The Economy as a 2D Fluid Manifold

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The Equation of Exchange, M V = P Y , proposed by Irving Fisher, is foundational to monetary economics. However, it is typically treated as an accounting identity rather than a derived law. A dimensional puzzle exists: if monetary flow is analogous to energy transport, why is the equation linear in velocity (V) rather than quadratic (V 2), as in kinetic energy? We resolve this puzzle by positing that economic activity occurs on a 2-dimensional topological manifold (a transaction network) rather than in 3D Euclidean space. On such a manifold, the governing conservation law is the Continuity Equation for mass flux, which is linear in velocity. We derive the Fisher Equation as the integrated form of this conservation law, providing a first-principles physical foundation for a central result in macroeconomics.

AI.tldr: 该论文从物理学角度重新审视费雪方程式MV=PY，解决了为什么货币流通速度是线性而非二次方的维度谜题，提出经济活动发生在二维拓扑流形上，将费雪方程式推导为质量通量连续性方程的积分形式。
AI.research_question: 为什么费雪方程式(MV=PY)中的货币流通速度(V)是线性的而不是二次方的？如何从第一性原理为这一宏观经济学核心方程提供物理基础？
AI.motivation: 费雪方程式通常被视为会计恒等式而非推导出的定律，存在维度谜题：如果货币流动类似于能量传输，为什么方程中的速度是线性的(V)而不是二次方的(V²)？
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 费雪方程式(MV=PY)作为货币经济学基础；2. 物理学中的能量传输类比；3. 拓扑流形理论；4. 质量通量连续性方程。
AI.method: 通过物理学类比和数学推导，将经济活动建模为二维拓扑流形上的过程，应用质量通量连续性方程，推导出费雪方程式的积分形式。
AI.findings: 经济活动发生在二维拓扑流形(交易网络)上，而非三维欧几里得空间。在这种流形上，控制守恒定律是质量通量的连续性方程，该方程中的速度是线性的。费雪方程式是该守恒定律的积分形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为费雪方程式提供了第一性原理的物理基础；2. 解决了速度线性而非二次方的维度谜题；3. 将经济活动建模为二维拓扑流形上的过程；4. 建立了货币经济学与物理学守恒定律的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策的物理基础提供新视角；2. 有助于更准确地建模货币流动；3. 为宏观经济模型的物理类比提供框架；4. 促进跨学科(经济学与物理学)研究。

title: The Unified Theory of Organizational Thermodynamics: A Synthesis of the Seven-Paper Series (The Heptalogy)
affiliations: Otaru University of Commerce - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Unified Theory of Organizational Thermodynamics: A Synthesis of the Seven-Paper Series (The Heptalogy)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive synthesis of the "Organizational Thermodynamics" framework developed by the author across a series of seven scholarly papers (The Heptalogy). Moving beyond the neoclassical abstraction of the firm as a production function, this series redefines the economic organization as a "Dissipative Structure" that internalizes market disequilibrium. The theoretical arc begins with a reinterpretation of Walras' Law, incorporates the physical function of financial capital (The Battery Theory), applies the Second Law of Thermodynamics (Entropy and Negentropy), and culminates in a rigorous mathematical proof using Differential Inclusions. This synthesis demonstrates that organizational survival is not a deterministic outcome of resource accumulation but a stochastic bifurcation governed by the "Schrödinger Condition."

AI.tldr: 本文综合了作者在七篇论文中发展的"组织热力学"框架，将经济组织重新定义为内化市场非均衡的"耗散结构"，证明组织生存不是资源积累的确定性结果，而是由"薛定谔条件"支配的随机分岔过程。
AI.research_question: 经济组织如何作为耗散结构在非均衡市场中生存和演化？组织生存的决定性因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 超越新古典经济学将企业简化为生产函数的抽象模型，需要更真实地理解组织在动态、非均衡市场环境中的运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织热力学框架，包括：瓦尔拉斯定律重新解释、金融资本的物理功能（电池理论）、热力学第二定律（熵与负熵）、耗散结构理论、微分包含数学证明、薛定谔条件。
AI.method: 理论综合与数学建模，包括七篇论文（七部曲）的系统整合，运用微分包含等数学工具进行严格证明。
AI.findings: 组织生存不是资源积累的确定性结果，而是由薛定谔条件支配的随机分岔过程；经济组织是内化市场非均衡的耗散结构；金融资本具有物理功能（储存和释放能量）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了组织热力学理论框架；2) 重新定义了经济组织作为耗散结构；3) 提供了组织生存的随机分岔理论；4) 将热力学原理应用于组织分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了理解组织动态的新视角，强调组织适应性和能量管理的重要性，而非单纯资源积累。

title: Bailouts and Financial Fragility Revisited
affiliations: University of Vienna

detail.title: Bailouts and Financial Fragility Revisited
detail.abstract: When should governments limit their ability to bail out financial institutions? Conventional wisdom holds that bailouts (and public backstops in general) improve welfare when they are the least-bad option during crises and when moral hazard is minimal or contained by ex ante regulation. We revisit this question in a Diamond-Dybvig model with limited commitment, fiscal policy, and endogenous run risk. We show that even when bailouts are ex post efficient and moral hazard is fully eliminated, allowing them can raise the likelihood of bank runs and reduce ex ante welfare, especially when fiscal space is tight.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文挑战了传统观点，认为即使救助在事后是有效的且道德风险被完全消除，允许救助仍可能增加银行挤兑风险并降低事前福利，特别是在财政空间紧张时。
AI.research_question: 政府应该在什么时候限制其救助金融机构的能力？即使救助是事后有效的且道德风险被完全消除，允许救助是否仍可能降低事前福利？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，当救助是危机中最不坏的选择且道德风险被最小化或被事前监管控制时，救助（及公共担保）能提高福利。本文重新审视这一观点，探讨在有限承诺、财政政策和内生挤兑风险的Diamond-Dybvig模型中，救助可能产生的意外后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Diamond-Dybvig银行挤兑模型，扩展了有限承诺、财政政策和内生挤兑风险的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含有限承诺、财政政策和内生挤兑风险的Diamond-Dybvig模型，进行均衡分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现，即使救助是事后有效的且道德风险被完全消除，允许救助仍可能增加银行挤兑的可能性并降低事前福利，特别是在财政空间紧张的情况下。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统关于救助福利效应的观点，提出了救助可能通过改变均衡行为而产生意外负面后果的新理论机制，特别是在财政约束条件下。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的视角：即使在道德风险被控制的情况下，救助政策也需要谨慎设计，特别是在财政空间有限时，限制救助能力可能反而提高福利。

title: Bank CEO Compensation, Systemic Risk, and Bonus Caps
affiliations: Asia School of Business in collaboration with MIT Sloan

detail.title: Bank CEO Compensation, Systemic Risk, and Bonus Caps
detail.abstract: Using a new dataset on U.S. bank CEO compensation, I document that pre-crisis cash bonus incentives are associated with worse performance and greater bankruptcy risk during the Global Financial Crisis, whereas option incentives are weaker. To interpret these patterns and evaluate policy, I estimate a dynamic banking model with a multi-component CEO contract in which bonuses are small relative to equity but tied to short-term revenue. In the model, revenue-linked bonuses increase correlated risk-taking, and capping bonuses at base salary with deferral reduces crisis-period failures by about 10%, at the cost of 1% lower lending and 2% lower bank value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，金融危机前银行CEO的现金奖金激励与危机期间更差的业绩表现和更高的破产风险相关，而期权激励的影响较弱。通过建立动态银行模型分析，发现与短期收入挂钩的奖金会增加银行间的风险趋同行为，而将奖金上限设定为基础工资并进行延期支付可以减少约10%的危机期银行破产，但会带来1%的贷款减少和2%的银行价值下降。
AI.research_question: 银行CEO的现金奖金激励和期权激励如何影响银行在金融危机期间的业绩表现和破产风险？限制现金奖金政策对银行稳定性和价值有何影响？
AI.motivation: 全球金融危机后，监管机构对银行高管薪酬进行了改革，特别是对现金奖金的限制。然而，这些政策的效果和理论基础尚不明确，需要实证证据和理论模型来评估不同薪酬结构对银行风险承担和稳定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和银行风险承担理论，构建包含多组件CEO薪酬契约的动态银行模型，特别关注现金奖金与短期收入挂钩对银行风险决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 1) 使用美国银行CEO薪酬新数据进行实证分析；2) 建立动态银行模型，包含多组件CEO契约，其中奖金相对于股权较小但与短期收入挂钩；3) 通过模型模拟评估不同薪酬政策的效果。
AI.findings: 1) 危机前现金奖金激励与危机期间更差的业绩和更高的破产风险相关；2) 期权激励的影响较弱；3) 与收入挂钩的奖金会增加银行间的风险趋同行为；4) 将奖金上限设定为基础工资并进行延期支付可减少约10%的危机期银行破产，但会带来1%的贷款减少和2%的银行价值下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了银行CEO薪酬结构与金融危机表现之间的因果证据；2) 建立了分析多组件薪酬契约对银行风险承担影响的理论框架；3) 揭示了现金奖金与短期收入挂钩如何导致银行间的风险趋同行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构限制银行高管现金奖金的政策提供了实证支持；2) 量化了奖金限制政策在减少银行破产风险与降低银行价值之间的权衡；3) 为银行薪酬委员会设计更稳健的薪酬结构提供了指导。

title: Heat Stress and Gendered Time Allocation: Evidence from India

detail.title: Heat Stress and Gendered Time Allocation: Evidence from India

declarations.ethicsApproval: All Secondary Data used in this research and available in public domain.
declarations.funderStatement: NO Funding involved.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how short-term heat stress, measured by deviations in wetbulb temperature (WBT), affects daily time allocation in India, with a focus on gender, caregiving responsibilities, and the spatial context of work. We combine the nationally representative India Time Use Survey (TUS) - 2019 with high-resolution ERA5 climate reanalysis data to construct district-day WBT anomalies relative to a 2008–2018 baseline. Our empirical strategy exploits within-district, within-month variation in WBT and clusters standard errors at the district level to isolate behavioral responses to acute thermal stress. We find consistent gender asymmetries in responses to rising heat. In the baseline specification, a one-unit (1◦C) increase in WBT leads women to spend 3.03 additional minutes per day on unpaid work and 5.87 fewer minutes on paid work relative to men. Among the already employed subgroup, the reallocation is sharper: women shift 4.08 minutes into unpaid work and 5.72 minutes out of paid work per 1◦C. Parenthood further amplifies these disparities in unpaid labor: at zero children, the same increase in wet bulb raises women’s unpaid work by 6.55 minutes more than men’s, with the additional burden growing by 4.63 minutes for each child. In contrast, the paid work penalty diminishes with parenthood: women without children reduce paid work by 8.95 minutes more than men, but this gap narrows by 3.22 minutes per child. We document heterogeneity by the location of activity and conducted Placebo tests to supporting the validity of our identification strategy. Rising WBT increases women’s time within household premises and reduces time in non-fixed outdoor work, consistent with heat-avoidance behavior. We also examine heterogeneity by social group and find no statistically significant differences in temperature responsiveness across caste categories. The findings indicate that heat stress reduces women’s market participation while raising their domestic labor burden, reinforcing pre-existing gender inequalities in time allocation. These results underscore the need for gender-responsive climate adaptation policies that address the hidden time costs of environmental stress, including investments in care infrastructure and labor protections for vulnerable groups.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度短期热应激（通过湿球温度偏差测量）如何影响日常时间分配，重点关注性别、育儿责任和工作空间背景。研究发现热应激加剧了性别不平等：女性减少有偿工作时间，增加无偿家务劳动，育儿责任进一步放大这种差异。
AI.research_question: 短期热应激（湿球温度偏差）如何影响印度日常时间分配，特别是性别、育儿责任和工作空间背景的差异？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致极端高温事件增加，但热应激对时间分配的影响，特别是性别差异，研究不足。了解热应激如何影响不同群体的时间分配对制定公平的气候适应政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间分配理论和性别劳动分工理论，结合热应激对行为影响的经济学分析框架。
AI.method: 结合印度时间使用调查（2019）和高分辨率ERA5气候再分析数据，构建地区-日湿球温度异常值。采用地区内、月内变异识别策略，标准误聚类在地区层面。
AI.findings: 1. 湿球温度每升高1°C，女性比男性每天多花3.03分钟无偿工作，减少5.87分钟有偿工作；2. 已就业群体中差异更显著；3. 育儿责任放大无偿劳动性别差异；4. 热应激增加女性在家庭场所时间，减少户外工作时间；5. 种姓类别间无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将热应激纳入时间分配理论框架；2. 揭示热应激如何强化性别劳动分工；3. 提供育儿责任作为调节变量的实证证据；4. 拓展环境压力对劳动力市场参与的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制定性别敏感的气候适应政策提供依据；2. 强调投资照护基础设施的重要性；3. 建议加强对弱势群体的劳动保护；4. 揭示环境压力的隐性时间成本。

title: Finding Needles in Code Haystacks: An Empirical Study of Long-Horizon LLM Coding Tasks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Finding Needles in Code Haystacks: An Empirical Study of Long-Horizon LLM Coding Tasks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. Ethics approval and consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: LLMs achieve strong results on local code completion and small bug fixes, yet production engineering work frequently requires repository scale reasoning where the root cause is far from the symptom. We frame these settings as a needle in a haystack problem: the haystack is a large repository, and the needle is the minimal critical information, often an invariant, configuration gate, or cross module dependency required for a correct fix. We conduct an empirical study of long horizon coding tasks on real codebases, evaluating tool using LLM agents that search, inspect files, propose patches, and run tests under fixed interaction budgets. Across models, failures are dominated by missed needles and hypothesis lock in, while implementation errors are less common once the relevant evidence is found. These results motivate process aware evaluation metrics and agent designs that prioritize structured exploration, belief revision, and verification driven iteration.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM在代码仓库规模推理任务中的表现，发现主要失败原因是"大海捞针"问题（难以找到关键信息）和假设锁定，而非实现错误。研究提出需要过程感知的评估指标和优先结构化探索、信念修正、验证驱动迭代的智能体设计。
AI.research_question: LLM在代码仓库规模的长周期编码任务中面临哪些主要挑战？如何设计更好的评估指标和智能体架构来解决这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM在局部代码补全和小型bug修复上表现良好，但实际工程工作经常需要仓库规模的推理，其中根本原因可能远离症状表现。这种"大海捞针"问题限制了LLM在实际生产环境中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: "大海捞针"问题框架：将大型代码仓库视为干草堆，将修复所需的最小关键信息（如不变式、配置门、跨模块依赖）视为针。智能体决策过程中的假设锁定和探索策略理论。
AI.method: 在真实代码库上进行长周期编码任务的实证研究，评估使用LLM智能体（具备搜索、检查文件、提出补丁、运行测试功能）在固定交互预算下的表现。分析失败模式分布。
AI.findings: 1. 跨模型失败主要由"错过关键信息"和"假设锁定"主导；2. 一旦找到相关证据，实现错误相对较少；3. 当前评估指标无法充分反映智能体的探索和推理过程质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"大海捞针"问题作为理解仓库规模代码推理的核心框架；2. 识别LLM智能体在长周期任务中的主要失败模式；3. 理论化过程感知评估的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出需要过程感知的评估指标；2. 设计优先结构化探索、信念修正和验证驱动迭代的智能体架构；3. 为实际工程中LLM应用提供改进方向。

title: Closed-Loop Valuation Systems: From Permissive Estimation to Structural Economic Proof
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Closed-Loop Valuation Systems: From Permissive Estimation to Structural Economic Proof
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a closed-loop valuation system that reframes valuation from a permissive estimation exercise into a structurally governed economic process. Unlike traditional valuation frameworks-where assumptions may compensate for one another and valuation outcomes are almost always produced-the proposed system enforces capital preservation, performance precedence, cash-flow sufficiency, temporal discipline, and multi-path convergence as mandatory conditions for value recognition. By embedding structural refusal as a valid outcome, the framework restores economic legitimacy to valuation practice and aligns valuation with institutional, fiduciary, and credit-sensitive decision-making. This manuscript is presented as a conceptual and structural research work. It does not aim to produce firm-specific valuation outputs, but to redefine valuation as a governed economic system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种闭环估值系统，将估值从一种允许性估算活动重构为结构性治理的经济过程，通过强制条件约束恢复估值实践的经济合法性。
AI.research_question: 如何将传统估值框架重构为具有结构性治理的经济系统，使其更符合机构、信托和信贷敏感决策的需求？
AI.motivation: 传统估值框架存在假设相互补偿、估值结果几乎总是产生的问题，缺乏经济合法性，无法有效支持机构决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭环估值理论、结构性治理经济学、资本保全原则、现金流充分性理论、多路径收敛框架。
AI.method: 概念性和结构性研究方法，构建理论框架而非实证分析，通过逻辑推导和系统设计提出新的估值范式。
AI.findings: 提出的闭环估值系统通过强制条件（资本保全、绩效优先、现金流充分性、时间纪律、多路径收敛）约束估值过程，允许"结构性拒绝"作为有效结果，从而恢复估值实践的经济合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将估值重构为结构性治理的经济系统；2) 引入"结构性拒绝"作为有效估值结果；3) 建立强制条件框架替代传统补偿性假设；4) 连接估值实践与机构决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为机构投资者提供更可靠的估值工具；2) 支持信托责任决策；3) 增强信贷风险评估；4) 减少估值偏差对投资决策的影响。

title: Case Studies of EU and Member States’ Engagement with Global Strategic Partner Countries
affiliations: KU Leuven - Leuven Centre for Global Governance Studies, KU Leuven - Leuven Centre for Global Governance Studies, KU Leuven - Institute for International Law, College of Europe (Natolin campus), European Neighbourhood Policy Chair, University of Edinburgh, University of Edinburgh, Sabanci University - Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, Sabanci University, Sabanci University and EsadeGeo Center for Global Economy and Geopolitics

detail.title: Case Studies of EU and Member States’ Engagement with Global Strategic Partner Countries

declarations.funderStatement: EUROPEAN COMMISSION - Horizon 2020

detail.abstract:
This working paper delivers a comprehensive examination of the European Union's (EU’s) strategic partnerships with Brazil, the United Kingdom, the United States, Russia,Turkey and China.

For each case study, it explores the historical origins and current state of these partnerships, the different forms they can take, and the objectives and challenges they seek to address.

By zooming in on critical policy areas of each relationship and the role of EU Member States therein, the paper sheds light on the horizontal and vertical coherence of the EU’s external action.

The case studies show the importance of recognising each strategic partnership's unique regional and global context, which is indissociable from the EU’s bilateral relationship with the third country.

The successes, failures or stagnations of these relationships cannot be attributed solely to the EU’s policies or lack thereof, as external factors and the partners' own actions and policies can significantly influence the outcomes.

It is argued that strategic partnerships have the potential to establish lasting frameworks for joint action, create momentum for further cooperation, and sustain important relationships amidst potential crises and unforeseen events.

However, the partnerships must demonstrate adaptability to geopolitical and geoeconomic changes while maintaining their alignment with the EU’s external action objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文对欧盟与巴西、英国、美国、俄罗斯、土耳其和中国的战略伙伴关系进行了全面分析，探讨了这些关系的起源、现状、形式、目标与挑战，并评估了欧盟对外行动的一致性和战略伙伴关系的有效性。
AI.research_question: 欧盟与主要国家（巴西、英国、美国、俄罗斯、土耳其、中国）的战略伙伴关系如何运作？这些关系在实现欧盟对外行动目标方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 需要理解欧盟战略伙伴关系的实际运作机制，评估这些关系在应对全球挑战、维护欧盟利益方面的有效性，以及分析欧盟对外行动的一致性和协调性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的战略伙伴关系理论、欧盟对外行动一致性理论、双边关系与多边主义互动理论、地缘政治与地缘经济分析框架。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，对欧盟与六个国家（巴西、英国、美国、俄罗斯、土耳其、中国）的战略伙伴关系进行深入比较分析，考察历史起源、现状、政策领域和成员国角色。
AI.findings: 1. 每个战略伙伴关系都有独特的区域和全球背景；2. 关系成败不能仅归因于欧盟政策，外部因素和伙伴国行动同样重要；3. 战略伙伴关系可为联合行动建立持久框架，创造合作动力；4. 欧盟对外行动存在水平和垂直一致性问题；5. 伙伴关系需要适应地缘政治经济变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了战略伙伴关系理论，强调双边关系与全球背景的不可分割性；2. 深化了欧盟对外行动一致性理论；3. 提出了战略伙伴关系适应性与目标对齐的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟政策制定者提供战略伙伴关系管理的实用指导；2. 帮助识别和应对对外行动中的一致性问题；3. 为处理危机和突发事件提供框架建议；4. 为其他国家和组织建立类似伙伴关系提供参考。

title: Challenges to Break the Glass Ceiling in 21st Century
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Challenges to Break the Glass Ceiling in 21st Century
detail.abstract: The concept of glass ceiling is a much discussed idea and accepted by every human being, yet it had prevailed. and even today continues to dominate the mind-set of both man and woman irrespective of the fact who he or she is, and what is the status. We .usually relate the glass ceiling with the work- place, ignoring the fact that if the. glass ceiling is none else than mental framework then family structure, social spectrum and peer groups witness the barriers in decision making particularly by women and hesitation to step out and take a bold lead at home and outside in the society and the work-place ..The article attempts to place a mirror before a person who hesitates to make a strong move, takea bold decision because of the mental barrier which constantly act a an impediment in the behaviour of the individual Women predominates in the discussion because the ration of men to women facing the Glass Ceiling is 1to 4 This is no doubt a descriptive paper but effort is made to introspect and describe comprehensively the challenges women experience in shattering this mental blockade called the “glass ceiling” It is a pointer to the challenges present in the society and confronted by people mainly women in the family, peer-group, neighbourhood, and the work-place .Undoubtedly there has been endless effort to bring more and more women in the work force but their roles as mother and wife prevent them from making big strides to success in their profession. In this regard feminists argue that traditional gender roles create many obstacles for working women both in the home and in the workplace. They say that the female gender role was constructed as an opposite to an ideal male role, and helps to perpetuate patriarchy. This creates gender bias which result in the feeling of inequality in the minds of both men and women. For decades women have been fighting for equality. The feminist movement has to a great extent changed the traditionally accepted feminine gender role, yet it is strongly believed that much still needs to be done to bring total gender equality and change the perception of both the sexes. This idea of glass ceiling prevails in the mind set of working women because of this sense of inequality.

AI.tldr: 这篇描述性论文探讨了"玻璃天花板"不仅是职场现象，更是根植于社会、家庭和个体心理层面的精神框架，阻碍女性在家庭、社会和工作场所的决策与领导力发展。
AI.research_question: 玻璃天花板如何作为心理框架影响女性在家庭、社会和工作场所的决策与领导力发展？
AI.motivation: 尽管玻璃天花板概念已被广泛讨论，但它仍然普遍存在。人们通常将其局限于职场，忽略了它作为心理框架在家庭结构、社会光谱和同辈群体中同样发挥作用，阻碍女性做出决策和展现领导力。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 玻璃天花板理论（作为心理框架而非仅职场现象）
2. 女权主义理论（传统性别角色如何创造障碍）
3. 父权制理论（女性角色被构建为理想男性角色的对立面）
4. 性别偏见与不平等感知理论
AI.method: 描述性研究方法，通过内省和综合分析来探讨女性在打破"玻璃天花板"这一心理障碍时所面临的挑战。
AI.findings:

4. 女权运动已部分改变传统女性角色，但完全性别平等仍需努力

AI.theory_contributions:

2. 强调玻璃天花板作为心理障碍在家庭和社会层面的表现
3. 连接传统性别角色、父权制与玻璃天花板现象的因果关系
4. 提出不平等感知是维持玻璃天花板心理框架的关键机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为犹豫不决的个人提供反思镜鉴
2. 指出社会各层面（家庭、同辈、邻里、职场）存在的挑战
3. 强调需要超越职场范畴，全面解决性别平等问题
4. 为政策制定者和组织提供更全面的性别平等干预视角

title: India's Health Financing Crisis and the Ayushman Bharat Scheme as a PPP Response

detail.title: India's Health Financing Crisis and the Ayushman Bharat Scheme as a PPP Response

declarations.funderStatement: The paper was completely self-funded and no funding or grant was accessed by the author.

detail.abstract: India's rapid economic growth is challenged by a health financing crisis that has been marked by a typically high out-of-pocket expenditure (OOPE), causing limited financial protection, inequality and access to health services among the poorer populations. While the flagship Ayushman Bharat scheme intends to bridge the gap, there still exist a lot of institutional barriers that have blocked the scheme from fulfilling its objectives and outcomes. The OOPE remains high, while the missing middle is a problem within the section of society who are not poor enough to qualify for subsidized healthcare and are unable to access quality healthcare. This paper aims to assess the effectiveness of the Ayushman Bharat scheme through a comparative policy analysis. The paper compares the Ayushman Bharat schemes with the policy structures in 4 other countries, namely Indonesia, the United Kingdom, Brazil, and Mexico. The paper finds its theoretical foundation in evolutionary theory while its methodological framework depends on the idea of critical multiplism. The paper deploys the use of quantitative comparative analysis as well as index-based comparison along with Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) difference-indifferences with multiple time periods to understand the efficacy of a PPP model on the longer run.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过比较政策分析评估印度Ayushman Bharat医疗计划的成效，发现尽管该计划旨在解决医疗融资危机，但制度障碍限制了其效果，导致自付费用仍然很高，且"缺失的中产阶级"无法获得优质医疗服务。
AI.research_question: Ayushman Bharat计划在解决印度医疗融资危机方面的效果如何？该计划在减少自付费用、提供财务保护和改善医疗服务可及性方面的成效如何？
AI.motivation: 印度快速经济增长面临医疗融资危机，表现为高自付费用，导致财务保护有限、不平等和贫困人口医疗服务可及性差。虽然Ayushman Bharat计划旨在弥补这一差距，但制度障碍阻碍了其实现目标和成果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化理论（evolutionary theory）
AI.method: 比较政策分析，包括定量比较分析、基于指数的比较，以及Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021)的多时期双重差分法，以理解PPP模型的长期效果。方法框架基于批判多重性（critical multiplism）理念。
AI.findings: 论文将Ayushman Bharat计划与印度尼西亚、英国、巴西和墨西哥的政策结构进行比较，分析PPP模型在长期的有效性。具体发现需阅读完整论文。
AI.theory_contributions: 将进化理论应用于医疗政策分析，为理解医疗融资政策的演变和适应性提供理论框架。批判多重性方法框架为医疗政策评估提供了多维度的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别Ayushman Bharat计划的制度障碍，为政策改进提供建议。通过国际比较为印度医疗融资改革提供借鉴。为"缺失的中产阶级"医疗可及性问题提供解决方案。

title:
Follow the Cheese:
Pastoralism and Rural Change in Contemporary Turkey

detail.title:
Follow the Cheese:
Pastoralism and Rural Change in Contemporary Turkey

publicationDetails.detailsText: This doctoral thesis was written in the Political Science Doctoral Program at Hacettepe University between 2020 and 2024. The data used is based on fieldwork and archival research.

detail.abstract: This study aims to examine the relationship between pastoralism and rural change in contemporary Turkey with a particular attention to the production and marketing of two famous kinds of cheese, namely tulum and kaşar identified mostly with the pastoralist tribes. There are many challenges to studying pastoralism, an area that has been largely overlooked by both policy makers and social scientists. In order to overcome these, I used both archival research and fieldwork. I limited my multi-sited fieldwork to Erzincan and Kars, and with the new connections I made, I extended it to Tunceli and Ardahan. In these areas, I interviewed members of the Şavaks and Karapapaks. The common characteristic of these pastoralist tribes is that they are also the main producers of two well-known cheese in Turkey. Since my research is shaped by the discussion of how to understand rural change through pastoralism, I first go into how pastoralism has been analyzed conceptually and historically in the existing literature. Then, I shed light on the social, economic, and ecological characteristics of the region and cities I study. Through an innovative conceptual approach to the data obtained from the interviews I analyze it as complaint transcript and assessed how pastoralists position themselves as subjects and how they conceive the state. Subsequently, the constitution of highlands is examined in their conceptual and legal development; highlands are a prerequisite for the existence of pastoralists. Applying findings from both fieldwork and local periodicals, I address the discrepancy between legal and normative perspectives, specifically the question of what constitutes the reality on the ground. Another original contribution of this thesis is the conceptualization of the cities of Kars and Erzincan as cheese lands, with special attention to the role of these tribes in the urban contexts, using the concept of terroir.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨土耳其当代游牧与乡村变迁的关系，特别关注与游牧部落相关的两种著名奶酪（tulum和kaşar）的生产与营销。通过档案研究和多地点田野调查，分析游牧部落如何定位自身、理解国家，并将Kars和Erzincan城市概念化为"奶酪土地"。
AI.research_question: 如何通过游牧主义理解土耳其的乡村变迁？特别是与游牧部落相关的奶酪生产与营销如何反映这种变迁？
AI.motivation: 游牧主义研究长期被政策制定者和社会科学家忽视，存在许多研究挑战。作者希望通过研究游牧部落及其奶酪生产，填补这一研究空白，理解当代土耳其的乡村变迁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 游牧主义的概念与历史分析框架；2. 高地构成的概念与法律发展；3. 奶酪土地（cheese lands）和风土（terroir）概念；4. 游牧主体性与国家关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1. 档案研究；2. 多地点田野调查（Erzincan、Kars、Tunceli、Ardahan）；3. 对Şavak和Karapapak部落成员的访谈；4. 将访谈数据作为"抱怨记录"进行创新性概念分析；5. 地方期刊资料分析。
AI.findings: 1. 揭示了游牧部落如何通过奶酪生产定位自身主体性；2. 分析了游牧者对国家的认知与态度；3. 发现了法律规范与现实情况之间的差异；4. 将Kars和Erzincan概念化为"奶酪土地"，展示了这些部落在城市背景中的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 创新性地将访谈数据作为"抱怨记录"分析；2. 提出了"奶酪土地"的概念框架；3. 运用"风土"概念分析游牧部落与城市的关系；4. 丰富了游牧主义与乡村变迁的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了游牧主义研究的实证基础；2. 揭示了奶酪生产与营销中的实际问题；3. 指出了法律与现实之间的差距；4. 为理解土耳其乡村变迁提供了具体案例。

title: Efficiency Dynamics of Indian Public Sector Banks postliberalisation: A DEA and Tobit Analysis (1991-2024)
affiliations: Aligarh Muslim University Aligarh, Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) - Department of Commerce and Aligarh Muslim University Aligarh

detail.title: Efficiency Dynamics of Indian Public Sector Banks postliberalisation: A DEA and Tobit Analysis (1991-2024)
detail.abstract: This study examines the operational efficiency and reform-induced performance dynamics of Indian public sector banks in the post-liberalisation era. We use Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) under Constant and Variable Returns to Scale to evaluate the trends in technical, pure technical, and scale efficiency over the period 1991-2024, with particular emphasis on the impact of large-scale bank mergers. A second-stage Tobit regression model is employed to identify the financial determinants influencing efficiency scores during 1996-2024. The results reveal persistent input-oriented inefficiencies in the pre-merger period, followed by a marked improvement in efficiency and convergence among banks after consolidation. Capital adequacy emerges as the most significant positive determinant of efficiency, highlighting the role of strong capitalisation in enhancing operational performance. In contrast, return on assets exhibits a statistically significant and negative association with efficiency, while bank size shows a negative but statistically insignificant relationship. The findings provide empirical evidence on the effectiveness of banking reforms and consolidation policies in improving the efficiency of public sector banks in India, and offer policy-relevant insights for strengthening resilience, resource allocation, and long-term stability in the public banking system.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用DEA和Tobit回归分析印度公营银行在1991-2024年间的运营效率，发现合并后效率显著提升，资本充足率是效率的关键正向决定因素。
AI.research_question: 印度公营银行在后自由化时期的运营效率如何？银行合并改革对效率动态有何影响？哪些财务因素决定银行效率？
AI.motivation: 评估印度银行业改革和合并政策的有效性，为公营银行系统的韧性、资源配置和长期稳定提供政策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行效率理论、规模经济理论和金融改革理论，分析公营银行在自由化背景下的效率动态。
AI.method: 1. 使用数据包络分析（DEA）在固定和可变规模报酬下评估1991-2024年的技术效率、纯技术效率和规模效率；2. 采用第二阶段Tobit回归模型识别1996-2024年影响效率得分的财务决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 合并前存在持续的投入导向型低效率；2. 合并后银行效率显著改善并趋于收敛；3. 资本充足率是效率最重要的正向决定因素；4. 资产回报率与效率呈显著负相关；5. 银行规模与效率呈负相关但不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为银行效率理论提供印度公营银行的实证证据，深化对银行合并与效率动态关系的理解，丰富金融改革效果评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度银行业改革和合并政策提供实证支持，强调资本充足率对运营效率的重要性，为政策制定者提供加强公营银行系统韧性、资源配置和长期稳定的具体建议。

title: Global South Says No to Dollars
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Global South Says No to Dollars

declarations.ethicsApproval: Author’s Note – this article was written as an exercise of starkly portraying one ideology’s opinions and may or may not reflect the opinion of the writer / publisher

detail.abstract: NATO vs Russia/BRICS, US led vs China led AI semiconductor markets, the Green Energy Race, decades long Oil disputes and competing global system-layered under these larger overarching battles is a more foundational economic shift is underway: Dedollarisation. Driven by decades of (perceived?) exploitation, the "Global South" is carving a path away from the dollar, which allowed US to threaten economic sovereignty, impose unfair sanctions, fabricate geopolitical uncertainties, curtail strategic autonomy and influence 84 regime in the previous century 1. It would be folly to think that the spirit of mercantilism has died away 2 , as nations still seek to maximise their reserve through an export oriented focus 3. These reserves in the age of fiat were mostly filled by dollar leading to "imported inflation", where printing of currency in US led to inflation globally, shifting most of the burden from US consumers to global consumers. 4 These factors has provoked the de-dollarisation ambitions significantly in an era of frequent regime changes. Thus protectionists also align with currency independence, to shield local markets from international shocks in a rapidly destabilising economic West. Additionally, the Global South's industry is highly labour intensive as explained by their natural endowments under HO Model. The international markets for such products are highly price sensitive and are adversely affected by high transaction costs and foreign exchange shortages 5. The global South generally focuses on their absolute advantages in natural resources and mass manufacturing, resulting in a natural tendency for core sectors to be less dependent on imports, which are often dollar based. On the other hand, increasing protectionism and global conflicts has distorted comparative advantage based trade globally, while regional free trade agreements boost intra-regional trade 6. The overall trade, even if slightly, shifts from western and dollar centric to regional trade based on regional finance networks. US is losing Africa, with no renegotiation in sight for AGOA (African Growth and Opportunities Act) 7 , whilst periphery led alternates like AfCFTA 8 & SAFTA (South Asian Free Trade Area) gains credibility. Meanwhile, the remainder of the periphery states rally around BRICS. The most decisive movement is led by India, followed by Sri Lanka and Nepal, where Non Alignment and pro-multilateralism states advocate for a dedollarized system that boosts strategic autonomy. However, the Global South faces countless challenges ranging from underdeveloped infrastructure, to currency convertibility and legacy systems entrenched with the dollar, which has a deep stable and liquid US capital market base as well as a credible US treasury market driving demand. The most significant of all challenges, for decades, has been the war and genocide enforced petro-dollar-the reality of de-dollarisation hidden outside recent discourse. The Russia India China led energy resilience against the Western energy monopoly, allows for diversification of energy sources in supplier and in forms, specially the Global south led green energy 9. Increasingly aggressive US sanctions have forced increasingly sovereign states to create the foundations to a competitive global system that the US feared, partly leading to the rise of regional financial systems, which were boosted by digitisation of financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了去美元化趋势，分析了全球南方国家为减少对美元依赖、寻求货币独立和战略自主而推动的经济转型，以及面临的挑战和机遇。
AI.research_question: 全球南方国家推动去美元化的动因、机制、挑战及其对全球金融体系的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 美元霸权导致的经济主权威胁、不公平制裁、地缘政治操纵、进口通胀等问题，促使全球南方国家寻求减少对美元的依赖，建立更公平的金融体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重商主义理论、赫克歇尔-俄林模型（要素禀赋理论）、比较优势理论、区域一体化理论、战略自主理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架结合地缘政治经济案例研究，分析去美元化的结构性动因和区域金融网络发展。
AI.findings: 1. 去美元化由经济主权、制裁规避、通胀转移等多重因素驱动；2. 全球南方国家基于要素禀赋发展劳动密集型产业，天然倾向区域贸易；3. 区域贸易协定（如AfCFTA、SAFTA）和BRICS机制推动区域金融网络发展；4. 面临基础设施不足、货币可兑换性、石油美元体系等挑战；5. 数字化金融和绿色能源转型提供新机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了重商主义在数字货币时代的适用性；2. 将要素禀赋理论与货币自主性联系起来；3. 发展了区域金融网络替代美元体系的理论框架；4. 提出"战略自主货币"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供去美元化路径参考；2. 揭示区域贸易协定对货币独立的重要性；3. 指出数字化金融基础设施建设的紧迫性；4. 强调绿色能源转型对能源-货币脱钩的战略意义；5. 为国际组织改革提供依据。

title: Three Drivers of High-Risk Speculation Among Younger Adults: Moral Stigma, Insufficient Financial Curriculum, and Social Media Influence
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Three Drivers of High-Risk Speculation Among Younger Adults: Moral Stigma, Insufficient Financial Curriculum, and Social Media Influence
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a conceptual framework for why younger adults (20–39) increasingly enter financial markets through relatively high-risk, speculative channels in the post-2015 period. It begins with a sustained gap between asset-price growth and wage growth, which can make capital income more salient for life-cycle accumulation. The core issue is not participation itself but whether entrants have sufficiently developed financial literacy and decision-making frameworks. The framework integrates three forces: (i) moral stigma toward capital income that can undermine the perceived legitimacy of learning about investing and returns, (ii) weak or misaligned financial curricula that constrain financial literacy formation, and (iii) social media dynamics that amplify risk-taking incentives through attention-driven content, investment spectrum narrowing, and flex culture. The argument is interpretive rather than causal and draws on visual time-series evidence. It outlines plausible mechanisms and offers brief cross-country illustrations centered on the United States and South Korea. It concludes with testable propositions and discusses policy implications for public communication, curriculum reform, and investor education in attention-ranked platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个概念框架，解释2015年后20-39岁年轻人为何越来越多通过高风险投机渠道进入金融市场。核心不是参与本身，而是参与者是否具备足够的金融素养和决策框架。
AI.research_question: 为什么年轻成年人（20-39岁）在2015年后越来越多地通过高风险投机渠道进入金融市场？
AI.motivation: 资产价格增长与工资增长之间的持续差距，使得资本收入在生命周期积累中变得更加显著，但年轻投资者可能缺乏足够的金融素养和决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合三个力量：1) 对资本收入的道德污名化，削弱学习投资和回报的合法性认知；2) 薄弱或错位的金融课程，限制金融素养形成；3) 社交媒体动态，通过注意力驱动内容、投资范围缩小和炫耀文化放大风险承担激励。
AI.method: 解释性而非因果性论证，基于视觉时间序列证据，提出合理机制，并提供以美国和韩国为中心的跨国例证。
AI.findings: 年轻投资者通过高风险渠道进入金融市场的趋势受多重社会、教育和媒体因素驱动，而不仅仅是经济激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合道德、教育和社交媒体因素的概念框架，解释年轻投资者高风险行为的社会建构过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共沟通、课程改革和注意力排名平台上的投资者教育提供政策启示，并提出可检验的命题。

title: How to Prevent a Year of Death and Suffering for 84 Cents

detail.title: How to Prevent a Year of Death and Suffering for 84 Cents

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: At current testing rates, finding treatments for all 6.65k diseases would take 443 years. Pragmatic trials integrated into healthcare increase testing 12.3x, saving 10.7B deaths and eliminating 1931T hours of suffering at $0.841 per year of healthy life saved.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过将务实性临床试验整合到医疗保健系统中，可将治疗测试效率提高12.3倍，显著加速疾病治疗发现，以极低成本（每健康生命年0.841美元）拯救大量生命并减少痛苦。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合务实性临床试验到医疗保健系统来加速疾病治疗发现，减少因测试效率低下导致的死亡和痛苦？
AI.motivation: 当前疾病治疗测试效率极低，按现有测试速度，为6650种疾病找到治疗方法需要443年，导致大量可避免的死亡和痛苦。
AI.theoretical_framework: 务实性临床试验理论、医疗系统整合理论、成本效益分析框架、公共卫生干预评估理论。
AI.method: 采用定量建模方法，比较传统临床试验与整合到医疗保健系统中的务实性试验的效率差异，进行成本效益分析和生命年计算。
AI.findings: 务实性试验整合可将测试效率提高12.3倍，拯救107亿死亡，消除1931万亿小时的痛苦，每健康生命年成本仅0.841美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了医疗系统整合的临床试验理论框架，提出了加速疾病治疗发现的系统性解决方案，丰富了公共卫生干预的效率评估理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗系统和政策制定者提供了可实施的务实性试验整合方案，展示了通过系统优化可大幅加速治疗发现并拯救大量生命，具有极高的成本效益。

title: Uncertainty, Data Dependence and Interest Rate Volatility
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Uncertainty, Data Dependence and Interest Rate Volatility

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1513
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how central bank communication about the uncertainty surrounding its assessment of macroeconomic developments shapes financial market reactions to economic news. Using euro-area evidence, we show that when markets perceive the central bank to be operating in a “high-learning” regime – marked by high uncertainty and repeated forecast errors – the pass-through of inflation surprises to interest rates is amplified, resulting in greater volatility. To interpret these findings, we develop a model of imperfect information in which the private sector updates its beliefs about the persistent component of inflation using both realized inflation and the central bank’s projections. In this setting, the central bank’s projections are viewed act as noisy signals, and their perceived precision determines how much weight the private sector places on the central bank’s macroeconomic assessment relative to incoming data. The model predicts that when projections are viewed as more precise, expectations become more anchored and interest rates respond less to news. Overall, the empirical and theoretical results highlight that communicating the confidence surrounding central bank projections is not a neutral act of transparency but an active policy instrument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了央行关于宏观经济评估不确定性的沟通如何影响金融市场对经济新闻的反应。研究发现，当市场认为央行处于"高学习"状态（高不确定性和重复预测错误）时，通胀意外对利率的传导会放大，导致更大波动。理论模型表明，央行预测的感知精度决定了私人部门在形成预期时给予央行评估相对于实际数据的权重。
AI.research_question: 央行关于其宏观经济评估不确定性的沟通如何影响金融市场对经济新闻的反应？
AI.motivation: 央行沟通已成为重要的货币政策工具，但现有研究主要关注沟通内容本身，较少关注沟通中关于不确定性的信息如何影响市场反应。理解这种影响对于央行有效管理市场预期至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息模型，其中私人部门使用实际通胀数据和央行的预测来更新对通胀持久性成分的信念。央行的预测被视为有噪声的信号，其感知精度决定了私人部门在形成预期时给予央行评估相对于实际数据的权重。
AI.method: 实证分析：使用欧元区数据，研究在市场认为央行处于"高学习"状态时，通胀意外对利率的传导效应。理论建模：构建不完全信息模型来解释实证发现。
AI.findings: 当市场认为央行处于"高学习"状态（高不确定性和重复预测错误）时，通胀意外对利率的传导会放大，导致利率对新闻的反应更强烈，市场波动性增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了包含央行预测不确定性的不完全信息模型；2) 解释了央行预测的感知精度如何影响市场预期锚定程度；3) 理论预测当央行预测被视为更精确时，预期更锚定，利率对新闻的反应更小。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 表明央行沟通关于预测的置信度不是中立的透明度行为，而是积极的政策工具；2) 为央行如何通过沟通管理市场预期提供指导；3) 强调在高不确定性时期，央行需要特别谨慎地沟通其评估的置信度。

title: Growing Awareness: Evaluating the Impact of Environmental Education on Attitudes, Knowledge, and Behavior
affiliations: Oregon State University - Department of Applied Economics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Energy and Environmental Policy Research (CEEPR)

detail.title: Growing Awareness: Evaluating the Impact of Environmental Education on Attitudes, Knowledge, and Behavior
detail.abstract: Mangroves provide vital ecosystem services like storm surge protection and carbon sequestration, but their coverage is rapidly declining. This study evaluates an environmental education program in the Dominican Republic, targeting children’s attitudes, knowledge, behaviors, and willingness to pay for conservation. The program boosted attitudes, especially in girls, with modest, non-significant behavioral changes. There were also positive spillover effects on peers and parents, with non-treated peers in clubs showing increased mangrove preference and positive attitude shifts in parents.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多米尼加共和国的红树林环境教育项目，发现项目改善了儿童（尤其是女孩）的态度，但对行为改变影响有限，并产生了对同伴和父母的积极溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 环境教育项目如何影响儿童对红树林保护的态度、知识、行为和支付意愿？项目是否会产生对同伴和父母的溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 红树林提供重要的生态系统服务（如风暴潮防护和碳封存），但其覆盖率正在迅速下降。需要评估环境教育作为保护策略的有效性，特别是在儿童中培养保护意识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境教育理论、态度-行为关系理论、社会学习理论（同伴影响）、家庭间社会化理论（父母影响）
AI.method: 在多米尼加共和国实施环境教育项目，评估儿童的态度、知识、行为和支付意愿变化，同时测量对同伴和父母的溢出效应。
AI.findings: 1. 项目改善了儿童的态度，特别是女孩；2. 行为变化有限且不显著；3. 产生积极溢出效应：未参与项目的俱乐部同伴表现出更高的红树林偏好，父母态度也发生积极转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了环境教育效果的理论理解，特别是性别差异；2. 验证了环境教育的社会溢出效应机制；3. 丰富了态度-行为关系在环境教育背景下的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为红树林保护提供基于证据的环境教育方案；2. 识别女孩作为环境教育的重点群体；3. 展示环境教育的乘数效应（通过同伴和父母）；4. 为政策制定者提供设计有效保护项目的指导。

title: Bounding Age-Period-Cohort Effects in Travel Behavior: Addressing the Identification Problem Using Theoretically and Empirically Grounded Constraints
affiliations: Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences and Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences - ReLUT - Research Lab for Urban Transport

detail.title: Bounding Age-Period-Cohort Effects in Travel Behavior: Addressing the Identification Problem Using Theoretically and Empirically Grounded Constraints
detail.abstract: Age-period-cohort (APC) analyses are increasingly used in transportation research to study travel behavior and how it changes over time. Yet conventional APC approaches rely on strong identifying assumptions that are often not made explicit by the researchers and may be difficult to justify. This paper introduces the APC bounding approach proposed by Fosse and Winship (2019b) to transportation research and assesses its suitability through an empirical application to car-use outcomes. Using repeated cross-sectional data from the German travel survey Mobilität in Deutschland (MiD), including the post-pandemic wave 2023, we derived theory- and/or evidence-based bounding assumptions on the age, period, and cohort slopes and combined them with identified nonlinearities to obtain bounded overall effects. We further adapted the approach to a Two-part model to distinguish between participation in car use on the reference day, car-use intensity (kilometers travelled), and total expected kilometers (including zeros). Results for total expected car kilometers (including zeros) show that the post-pandemic decrease is driven by declining participation, despite ambiguous period effects on car use intensity. The bounded cohort effects remain relatively wide for the most recent cohorts but indicate increasing car use intensity while participation remains stable or slightly decreases. Overall, APC bounding improves transparency by making the identifying assumptions explicit and by supporting sensitivity analyses. However, its suitability for transportation research is limited by the method’s requirements to construct equally spaced age-period-cohort bins, the presence of theoretically and/or empirically grounded constraints, and by the fact that the current implementation is tied to linear regression models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了年龄-时期-队列（APC）边界分析方法到交通研究领域，使用德国出行调查数据评估其适用性，发现后疫情时代汽车使用减少主要由参与率下降驱动，而非使用强度变化。
AI.research_question: APC边界分析方法在交通研究中是否适用？如何应用该方法分析汽车使用的年龄、时期和队列效应？
AI.motivation: 传统APC分析方法依赖于未明确说明且难以验证的强识别假设，缺乏透明度。需要引入更透明的方法来研究出行行为随时间的变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 年龄-时期-队列（APC）分析框架，Fosse和Winship（2019b）提出的APC边界方法，Two-part模型（区分参与和使用强度）。
AI.method: 使用德国出行调查（MiD）的重复横截面数据，包括2023年后疫情波次。应用APC边界方法，基于理论和证据构建年龄、时期和队列斜率的边界假设，结合已识别的非线性效应。采用Two-part模型区分汽车使用参与率、使用强度（行驶公里数）和总预期公里数。
AI.findings: 后疫情时期汽车使用总预期公里数下降主要由参与率降低驱动，而使用强度的时期效应不明确。队列效应边界相对较宽，但显示近期队列使用强度增加而参与率保持稳定或轻微下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将APC边界方法引入交通研究领域，提高了分析透明度，使识别假设明确化，支持敏感性分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通研究者提供了更透明的APC分析工具，但方法适用性受限于等距APC分组要求、理论/经验约束的存在，以及当前实现仅限于线性回归模型。

title: The Great Recalibration: The 2026 Pivot from Generalist Wrappers to Sovereign Application Layers and Industrialized Services

detail.title: The Great Recalibration: The 2026 Pivot from Generalist Wrappers to Sovereign Application Layers and Industrialized Services
detail.abstract: The global artificial intelligence ecosystem stands at the precipice of a fundamental structural realignment, a transition so profound that it differentiates the era of experimentation (2022-2025) from the era of industrialization (2026-2030). Our comprehensive analysis of venture capital flows, technical adoption curves, and enterprise implementation data confirms the hypothesis: Q4 2026 will mark the definitive inflection point where the "thin wrapper" economy collapses under the weight of diminishing returns, while the "sovereign application layer" and "AI service" sectors ascend to dominance. This report serves as an exhaustive dissection of this market correction, validating the projection that 2027 will witness an extinction event for GenAI-first product companies that lack deep technical ownership.

AI.tldr: 该报告预测AI生态系统将在2026-2027年发生结构性调整：实验时代（2022-2025）将转向工业化时代（2026-2030），"薄包装"经济将崩溃，而"主权应用层"和"AI服务"部门将占据主导地位。
AI.research_question: 全球人工智能生态系统何时以及如何从实验时代过渡到工业化时代？哪些AI商业模式将在这一转型中生存或消亡？
AI.motivation: 当前AI投资和创业活动存在泡沫风险，许多"薄包装"AI产品缺乏核心技术所有权，需要识别哪些商业模式将在AI工业化阶段具有可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采用曲线理论、风险资本流动分析、市场结构转型理论、商业模式可持续性框架。
AI.method: 综合分析方法：分析风险资本流向数据、技术采用曲线、企业实施数据，进行市场趋势预测和验证。
AI.findings: 1. 2026年第四季度将是明确的转折点；2. "薄包装"经济将因收益递减而崩溃；3. "主权应用层"和"AI服务"部门将占据主导；4. 2027年将见证缺乏深度技术所有权的GenAI产品公司的灭绝事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI生态系统从实验时代到工业化时代的转型理论框架，识别了市场结构转型的关键时间点和驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、创业者和企业提供战略指导：1. 避免投资"薄包装"AI产品；2. 关注具有深度技术所有权的公司；3. 投资"主权应用层"和"AI服务"领域；4. 为2026-2027年的市场调整做好准备。

title: From Digital Policy to Execution Sovereignty Europe's Strategic Foresight in an Era of Machine-Speed Governance Author
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Digital Policy to Execution Sovereignty Europe's Strategic Foresight in an Era of Machine-Speed Governance Author
detail.abstract: European digital regulation has developed into one of the most comprehensive legal frameworks in the world, covering data protection, artificial intelligence, platform governance, financial integrity, and cybersecurity. However, enforcement mechanisms remain predominantly ex-post, policy-based, and institutionally slow, while the systems they govern increasingly operate at machine speed and across borders. This paper argues that Europe's next strategic inflection point is not further regulatory expansion, but execution sovereignty: the capacity to ensure that legally constrained digital actions cannot execute unless legality, purpose, and jurisdiction are satisfied at the moment of execution. The paper proposes a strategic foresight shift from data localisation and retrospective accountability toward execution-time enforcement, enabling democratic resilience, SME competitiveness, and digital sovereignty without censorship, surveillance, or fragmentation of the global digital ecosystem. The analysis draws on European policy processes, implementation failures, and emerging risks in AI-driven, automated systems. It outlines a coherent foresight framework for the period 2026-2035 and positions execution-time enforcement as Europe's distinctive contribution to global digital governance.

AI.tldr: 欧洲数字监管虽然全面但执行滞后，本文提出从数据本地化和事后追责转向"执行时执法"的战略转变，确保数字行动在执行时即满足合法性要求，以增强民主韧性、中小企业竞争力和数字主权。
AI.research_question: 欧洲数字监管如何从当前的事后追责、政策导向的执法机制转向执行时执法，以应对机器速度和跨境运作的数字系统？
AI.motivation: 欧洲数字监管框架虽然全面，但执行机制滞后于数字系统的实际运作速度，存在执行缺口，需要新的执法范式来确保监管有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字主权理论、执行时执法理论、监管有效性理论、数字治理理论
AI.method: 基于欧洲政策过程分析、实施失败案例研究和新兴风险分析的战略前瞻性分析
AI.findings: 欧洲数字监管需要从数据本地化和事后追责转向执行时执法，这能增强民主韧性、中小企业竞争力，实现数字主权而不导致审查、监控或全球数字生态系统碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"执行主权"概念，建立执行时执法的理论框架，为数字治理提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲2026-2035年数字治理提供前瞻性框架，提出具体的执行时执法实施路径，为全球数字治理提供欧洲方案。

title: The Hidden Forces Shaping Human Decisions: Cognitive Biases, Nudges and Choice Architecture
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai India

detail.title: The Hidden Forces Shaping Human Decisions: Cognitive Biases, Nudges and Choice Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own conclusions and do not represent the views of any institution

detail.abstract:
While traditional economics assumes that individuals make rational decisions, behavioural economics challenges
this by demonstrating that human judgement is influenced by cognitive biases, heuristics, and various contextual
factors. This paper explores key deviations from the typical ‘rationality’ and examines the key behavioural
tendencies that shape everyday decisions, drawing on foundational works by Kahneman, Thaler and Ariely, among
others. Through a merge of literature and real-world examples, the paper highlights the impact of these biases. It
concludes with strategies to reduce irrational decision-making through structured thinking and awareness.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨行为经济学如何挑战传统经济学理性假设，分析认知偏差和启发式如何影响日常决策，并提出减少非理性决策的策略。
AI.research_question: 行为经济学中的认知偏差和启发式如何影响个体的日常决策，以及如何减少这些非理性决策？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学假设个体做出理性决策，但现实中的决策往往受到各种认知偏差和情境因素的影响，需要从行为经济学角度重新审视决策过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论框架，包括Kahneman、Thaler和Ariely等学者的基础工作，重点关注认知偏差、启发式决策和情境因素对决策的影响。
AI.method: 文献综述与真实案例相结合的分析方法，整合行为经济学领域的经典文献和现实世界中的决策实例。
AI.findings: 人类判断受到多种认知偏差和启发式的影响，这些行为倾向显著偏离传统经济学的理性假设，在日常决策中产生系统性偏差。
