Inflation is defined as the logarithmic time derivative I r (t) of a normalized cost function, with the associated discounting function D(t) encoding the structural dynamics of valuation. Using daily data from the TGE BASE index (December 2025), we analyze the effects of linear and cubic spline interpolation on the inferred inflation dynamics and discounting structure. We introduce two original stability measures-the Amplitude Stability Index (BSI) and the Temporal Stability Coefficient (T SC)-which characterize the balance and temporal symmetry of inflationary and deflationary regimes. The results reveal a high degree of structural invariance of the discounting function with respect to shifts in the valuation baseline, indicating that the energy market operates as a quasi-stable oscillatory system. This framework provides a geometric alternative to average-based inflation measures and offers a continuous-time perspective on market stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了能源市场的连续时间通胀定义，将通胀视为价格过程的局部几何特性而非价格水平的加权平均。通过分析TGE BASE指数数据，引入两个稳定性指标，发现能源市场作为准稳定振荡系统运行。
AI.research_question: 如何从几何角度定义能源市场的连续时间通胀？不同插值方法对推断的通胀动态和贴现结构有何影响？能源市场是否表现出结构性不变性和稳定性特征？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀衡量方法基于价格水平的加权平均，缺乏对市场动态连续时间特性的捕捉。能源市场需要更精细的通胀定义来理解其结构性动态和稳定性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间金融理论、几何金融、局部几何特性分析、振荡系统理论、结构性动态估值理论
AI.method: 1. 提出连续时间通胀定义：I_r(t)作为归一化成本函数的对数时间导数；2. 使用TGE BASE指数（2025年12月）的日度数据；3. 分析线性和三次样条插值对通胀动态和贴现结构的影响；4. 引入两个稳定性指标：振幅稳定性指数(BSI)和时间稳定性系数(TSC)
AI.findings: 1. 贴现函数相对于估值基线的变化具有高度的结构性不变性；2. 能源市场作为准稳定振荡系统运行；3. 不同插值方法对推断的通胀动态有显著影响；4. 通胀和通缩机制表现出平衡和时间对称性特征
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出能源市场的连续时间通胀几何定义；2. 建立基于局部几何特性的通胀分析框架；3. 引入结构性动态估值理论；4. 提供传统平均通胀衡量方法的几何替代方案
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为能源市场提供连续时间稳定性分析工具；2. 帮助市场参与者理解通胀动态的结构性特征；3. 为政策制定者提供更精细的市场稳定性评估框架；4. 两个稳定性指标可用于市场风险管理和监控

title: How To Teach ADR Courses Effectively? (Presentation Slides)
affiliations: O. P. Jindal Global University - Jindal Global Law School (JGLS)

detail.title: How To Teach ADR Courses Effectively? (Presentation Slides)
detail.abstract: This presentation on “How to Teach ADR Course Effectively?”provides a practical roadmap for teaching ADR that goes laws, case laws and rote learning. Th presentation covers: course design, learning outcomes, and the balance between doctrinal teaching and ADR practice, while addressing how students can develop core ADR skills. The slides also covers tools for engagement, assessment strategies, the role of feedback, and ways to connect classroom learning with the real ADR ecosystem, concluding with reflections on effective ADR pedagogy.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个关于如何有效教授替代性争议解决（ADR）课程的实用路线图，超越了单纯的法律条文、判例法和死记硬背的教学方法。
AI.research_question: 如何有效地教授替代性争议解决（ADR）课程？
AI.motivation: 传统的ADR教学过于依赖法律条文、判例法和死记硬背，缺乏实践技能培养，需要探索更有效的教学方法来帮助学生发展核心ADR技能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效教学法理论、体验式学习理论、技能发展理论、课程设计理论
AI.method: 基于实践经验的课程设计方法，包括课程设计、学习成果设定、教学工具开发、评估策略制定等
AI.findings: 提出了一个全面的ADR教学路线图，包括课程设计原则、教学工具、评估策略、反馈机制，以及课堂学习与真实ADR生态系统的连接方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了ADR教学法的理论框架，提出了平衡理论教学与实践技能培养的教学模式，丰富了法律教育方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ADR教师提供了具体的教学工具、课程设计模板、评估策略和课堂活动建议，可直接应用于教学实践。

title: "Reciprocal Tariffs" as a Geoeconomic Policy Tool: Insights from Southeast Asia

detail.title: "Reciprocal Tariffs" as a Geoeconomic Policy Tool: Insights from Southeast Asia
detail.abstract: This article provides novel insights into the political economy of President Trump's use of "reciprocal tariffs" with empirical evidence from Southeast Asia-a region at the centre of the U.S.-China power rivalry. For the first time, all Southeast Asian countries face simultaneous threats of unprecedentedly high tariff rates, offering a unique case for analysis. The article contributes to the growing literature on geoeconomic policy instruments by examining five aspects: (i) the nature and the deployment of tariffs in the contemporary era of U.S. protectionism; (ii) domestic political determinants of the origin-based tariff rate decision; (iii) how asymmetries in bargaining power limit the tariff negotiating capacity of smaller states visà-vis hegemons; (iv) the implications of divergent national interests, regional disputes and conflicts, and international competition for Southeast Asian regional cohesion; and (v) the hedging strategy or bamboo diplomacy of Southeast Asian countries as an instructive model for other small states navigating geoeconomic pressures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过东南亚案例研究特朗普"互惠关税"的政治经济学，首次分析所有东南亚国家同时面临前所未有的高关税威胁，探讨关税部署、国内政治决定因素、小国谈判能力限制、区域凝聚力影响及"竹子外交"策略。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府的"互惠关税"政策在东南亚地区产生了怎样的政治经济影响？小国如何在中美霸权竞争中应对关税威胁并制定外交策略？
AI.motivation: 首次所有东南亚国家同时面临前所未有的高关税威胁，这为研究当代美国保护主义下的关税政策提供了独特案例。东南亚处于中美权力竞争中心，其应对策略对其他小国具有借鉴意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘经济政策工具理论、霸权-小国不对称权力关系理论、区域凝聚力理论、对冲策略（竹子外交）理论、国内政治决定关税理论。
AI.method: 实证研究，基于东南亚地区的案例分析和经验证据，采用多维度分析框架。
AI.findings: 1) 当代美国保护主义关税具有特定部署模式；2) 国内政治因素影响基于原产地的关税决策；3) 权力不对称限制小国与霸权国家的关税谈判能力；4) 国家利益分歧、区域争端和国际竞争影响东南亚区域凝聚力；5) 东南亚国家的对冲策略为其他小国提供应对地缘经济压力的模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了地缘经济政策工具理论，深化了霸权-小国不对称权力关系研究，发展了小国对冲策略理论框架，丰富了关税决策的国内政治经济学分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东南亚国家制定关税应对策略提供参考，为其他小国应对大国经济压力提供"竹子外交"模型，为政策制定者理解当代保护主义关税的影响提供实证依据。

title: Calibration of Rough Path Regularity Structures in High-Beta Tech Options Volatility: A 2026 Case Study
affiliations: School of Mathematics and Statistics, The University of Sydney

detail.title: Calibration of Rough Path Regularity Structures in High-Beta Tech Options Volatility: A 2026 Case Study
detail.abstract: This note examines the pricing eciency of rough volatility options models against the Black-Scholes benchmark in high-beta technology equities (NVDA, TSLA) during the 20252026 volatility regime. Using Hairer's regularity structures to calibrate a rough Hurst exponent (H < 0.15), the study nds that rough path "lifting" signicantly outperforms Ito-semimartingale models. Empirical results demonstrate a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) improvement of over 95% for Out-of-the-Money options. These ndings suggest that "roughness" is a structural feature of modern tech liquidity clusters, rendering standard diusion-based models inadequate for tail-risk management.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了粗糙波动率模型与Black-Scholes模型在高贝塔科技股（NVDA、TSLA）期权定价中的表现，发现粗糙路径模型在2025-2026波动率制度下显著优于传统模型，特别是对价外期权的RMSE改善超过95%。
AI.research_question: 粗糙波动率期权定价模型相对于Black-Scholes基准模型在高贝塔科技股（如NVDA、TSLA）的2025-2026波动率制度下定价效率如何？
AI.motivation: 现代科技股的流动性集群表现出"粗糙性"结构特征，传统的基于扩散的模型在尾部风险管理方面存在不足，需要验证粗糙波动率模型在实际市场中的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粗糙波动率理论，基于Hairer的规则性结构，使用粗糙Hurst指数（H < 0.15），粗糙路径"提升"方法，与Ito半鞅模型形成对比。
AI.method: 使用Hairer的规则性结构校准粗糙Hurst指数，比较粗糙路径模型与Black-Scholes基准模型在高贝塔科技股（NVDA、TSLA）期权定价中的表现，采用RMSE作为评估指标。
AI.findings: 粗糙路径"提升"显著优于Ito半鞅模型，对价外期权的RMSE改善超过95%，表明"粗糙性"是现代科技流动性集群的结构特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了粗糙波动率模型在高贝塔科技股期权定价中的优越性，为粗糙性作为市场结构特征提供了实证支持，挑战了传统扩散模型的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了更准确的科技股期权定价工具，特别是在尾部风险管理方面，有助于改善对冲策略和风险管理实践。

title: The African Central Bank

detail.title: The African Central Bank

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that this research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. This work is an independent production of Africa’s Sovereign Development Trust® (ASDT) and has not been influenced by any external corporate, governmental, or non-governmental stakeholders.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is an institutional and technical architectural framework based on secondary data analysis, economic modelling, and jurisprudential synthesis. It did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or clinical trials; therefore, formal ethical committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was entirely self-funded by the author and supported by the internal resources of The Ndege Group. No external grants, public funding, or private institutional sponsorships were received for the development of this treatise.

detail.abstract:
This technical treatise serves as the operative financial blueprint for the African Central Bank (ACB), functioning as a primary institutional supplement to 'The African Federation Treaty Framework© (AFTF)'. While the AFTF provides the jurisprudential mandate, this document details the engineering of a "Central Bank of Central Banks" designed to eliminate the systemic "Institutional Deficit" that currently drains $88.6 billion annually from the African economy via illicit financial flows.

The paper proposes a radical inversion of monetary integration: the attainment of sovereignty through immutable digital infrastructure (OmniGaza®) rather than political consensus. By anchoring the continental financial system in the African Rare Earth Mineral Fund©, the framework transitions Africa from debt-based fiat dependencies to a stable, asset-backed monetary union. Key modules detailed include the OmniGaza® Clearing Substrate, providing 2-second settlement finality for the AfCFTA, and a tripartite governance model reporting exclusively to the Pan-African Court to ensure judicial accountability over political interference.

AI.tldr: 本文为非洲中央银行（ACB）提供技术蓝图，通过数字基础设施OmniGaza®实现货币一体化，以非洲稀土矿产基金为锚点，建立资产支持的货币联盟，解决每年886亿美元非法资金流动造成的制度赤字。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数字基础设施而非政治共识实现非洲货币一体化，建立资产支持的中央银行体系来解决制度赤字和非法资金流动问题？
AI.motivation: 非洲目前存在严重的"制度赤字"，导致每年886亿美元通过非法资金流动流失，需要建立有效的中央银行体系来支撑非洲经济一体化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 制度赤字理论；2) 数字主权理论；3) 资产支持货币理论；4) 中央银行体系设计理论；5) 司法独立治理模型
AI.method: 技术蓝图设计方法，包括：1) OmniGaza®数字基础设施设计；2) 非洲稀土矿产基金锚定机制；3) 三方治理模型设计；4) 清算结算系统工程
AI.findings: 提出可行的非洲中央银行技术框架，包括：OmniGaza®清算底层（2秒结算最终性）、资产支持货币体系、司法独立治理结构，能够有效解决制度赤字问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出通过数字基础设施而非政治共识实现货币一体化的新范式；2) 发展资产支持中央银行理论；3) 建立司法独立的三方治理模型理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为非洲中央银行提供具体技术蓝图；2) 设计解决886亿美元非法资金流动的机制；3) 为AfCFTA提供2秒结算系统；4) 建立可操作的治理结构

title: Transmission of MBS Credit Risk to Mortgage Rate Disparity

detail.title: Transmission of MBS Credit Risk to Mortgage Rate Disparity
detail.abstract: This paper shows that MBS market credit risk introduces fluctuation in mortgage rate disparity between high-and low-income applicants in the U.S. The MBS credit risk drop incentivizes MBS investors to provide credit liquidity to mortgage market, resulting in a distorted disparity in mortgage rate across applicants' income spectrum. Mortgage market liquidity originating outside the MBS credit risk dynamics cannot account for this disparity. Quantitative easings are employed as policy shocks to strengthen the causal identification. This disparity emerges through the demand channel, where high-income applicants respond to improved MBS liquidity by expanding their borrowing activity.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现MBS市场信用风险会影响美国高收入和低收入申请人之间的抵押贷款利率差异。MBS信用风险下降促使投资者向抵押贷款市场提供信贷流动性，导致不同收入申请人之间的利率差异扭曲。量化宽松政策被用作政策冲击来加强因果识别，这种差异通过需求渠道产生，高收入申请人通过扩大借贷活动来应对改善的MBS流动性。
AI.research_question: MBS市场信用风险如何影响美国高收入和低收入申请人之间的抵押贷款利率差异？
AI.motivation: 理解抵押贷款利率在不同收入群体间的差异机制，特别是MBS市场信用风险在其中扮演的角色，对于评估住房金融市场的公平性和效率具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于MBS市场信用风险理论、信贷流动性理论和抵押贷款市场结构理论，探讨信用风险变化如何通过投资者行为影响不同收入群体的融资成本。
AI.method: 使用量化宽松政策作为外生政策冲击来加强因果识别，分析MBS信用风险变化对抵押贷款利率差异的影响机制。
AI.findings: MBS信用风险下降促使投资者提供更多信贷流动性，但这种流动性主要流向高收入申请人，导致抵押贷款利率在不同收入群体间的差异扭曲。这种效应通过需求渠道产生，高收入申请人通过扩大借贷活动来应对改善的MBS流动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了MBS信用风险与抵押贷款利率差异之间的理论联系；2) 揭示了信贷流动性在不同收入群体间的不均衡分配机制；3) 提出了需求渠道在解释这种差异中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了理解抵押贷款市场不平等的新视角；2) 揭示了量化宽松政策可能加剧收入群体间融资成本差异的机制；3) 为金融机构的风险管理和信贷分配决策提供了参考。

title: The Implications of Using Aggregate Price Index Data When Testing Purchasing Power Parity for Flexible-Price Monetary Approach Exchange Rate Models
affiliations: Kingston University

detail.title: The Implications of Using Aggregate Price Index Data When Testing Purchasing Power Parity for Flexible-Price Monetary Approach Exchange Rate Models

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was required for this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Crownover et al. (1996) suggested that the literature applying unit root, stationarity and cointegration tests of long-run purchasing power parity (PPP) with price index data test relative PPP and not absolute PPP. Regarding this contention we argue the following. First, the traditional relative PPP specification, that implies a relationship between the logarithms of the exchange rate and (relative) prices in difference form, is not being tested. Rather the form of relative PPP being tested is a relationship between the levels of these variables. Second, because exchange rate indices are rarely used in empirical PPP tests this implies that the base period of the exchange rate is restricted to unity in the levels relative PPP specification that is typically tested in the literature. Third, this restricted levels relative PPP specification is observationally equivalent to the strong form of absolute PPP that allows for constant transportation costs and other constant barriers to trade. We further show that support for this restricted levels relative PPP specification (unlike traditional relative PPP in differences) remains useful in terms of establishing a modified long-run flexible-price monetary approach (FLMA) exchange rate model in levels. We also demonstrate that even when the proportionality and/or symmetry conditions do not hold in a log-levels PPP specification, provided there is an equilibrium relation they still usefully imply modified versions of the long-run FLMA exchange rate model in levels.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了文献中常用的单位根、平稳性和协整检验实际上测试的是限制性水平相对购买力平价（PPP），而非传统差分形式的相对PPP，且这种限制性水平相对PPP与允许恒定运输成本的强形式绝对PPP在观测上是等价的。
AI.research_question: 文献中应用单位根、平稳性和协整检验来测试长期购买力平价（PPP）时，究竟是在检验哪种形式的PPP？这些检验与相对PPP和绝对PPP的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: Crownover等人（1996）认为文献中使用价格指数数据进行的PPP检验实际上测试的是相对PPP而非绝对PPP。本文旨在澄清这一争议，并探讨PPP检验的实际含义及其对汇率模型的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 购买力平价理论（绝对PPP和相对PPP）、单位根检验、协整分析、长期灵活价格货币模型（FLMA）。
AI.method: 理论分析和逻辑论证，通过数学推导展示不同PPP形式之间的关系，并探讨其对汇率模型的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 文献中测试的不是传统差分形式的相对PPP，而是水平形式的相对PPP；2. 由于很少使用汇率指数，汇率基期被限制为1，这种限制性水平相对PPP与允许恒定运输成本的强形式绝对PPP在观测上是等价的；3. 支持这种限制性水平相对PPP对建立修改后的长期FLMA汇率模型仍然有用。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了PPP检验文献中的误解，明确了实际测试的是限制性水平相对PPP，建立了其与绝对PPP的观测等价性，并展示了其对修改长期FLMA汇率模型的理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了对PPP检验结果的正确解释框架，表明即使比例性和/或对称性条件不成立，只要存在均衡关系，仍然可以推导出有用的修改版长期FLMA汇率模型。

title: Digital Marketing Strategies for Food Cafés and Student Startups in Japan: Opportunities, Challenges, and Growth Models

detail.title: Digital Marketing Strategies for Food Cafés and Student Startups in Japan: Opportunities, Challenges, and Growth Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper. The research was conducted independently and without any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on qualitative case analysis, industry observation, and secondary data sources. No experiments or human subject testing were conducted. The research does not involve sensitive personal data, and all business cases discussed are based on publicly available information and direct professional observation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Japan has traditionally relied on offline business relationships and reputation-based growth models. However, rapid digital transformation has reshaped consumer behavior and business operations, particularly in the food and café industry. This paper examines how food cafés and student startups in Japan adopt digital marketing strategies to build brand visibility, attract customers, and drive sustainable growth. Using qualitative case analysis of studentfounded businesses including Beebs, Khan's Adda, and Oboba, the study explores platform usage, branding models, and customer engagement strategies. The findings highlight the growing importance of social media, search platforms, and digital branding while identifying key challenges related to digital literacy, cultural inertia, and resource limitations. The paper concludes with future trends and strategic recommendations for effective digital marketing implementation in Japan's evolving business landscape.

AI.tldr: 日本传统依赖线下商业关系和声誉增长模式，但数字化转型重塑了食品咖啡馆和学生初创企业的营销策略。本研究通过案例分析了数字营销如何帮助日本食品咖啡馆和学生初创企业建立品牌知名度、吸引客户并实现可持续增长。
AI.research_question: 日本食品咖啡馆和学生初创企业如何采用数字营销策略来建立品牌知名度、吸引客户并推动可持续增长？
AI.motivation: 日本传统上依赖线下商业关系和声誉增长模式，但快速数字化转型重塑了消费者行为和商业运营，特别是在食品和咖啡馆行业。需要研究数字营销策略如何帮助这些企业适应变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、数字营销理论、品牌建设理论、初创企业成长理论
AI.method: 使用定性案例分析方法，研究学生创办的企业包括Beebs、Khan's Adda和Oboba，探讨平台使用、品牌模式和客户参与策略
AI.findings: 研究发现社交媒体、搜索平台和数字品牌建设的重要性日益增长，同时识别出与数字素养、文化惯性和资源限制相关的关键挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 为日本特定文化背景下的数字营销理论提供实证支持，丰富了数字化转型在传统行业中的应用研究，拓展了初创企业成长理论在数字环境下的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本食品咖啡馆和学生初创企业提供具体的数字营销实施建议，识别关键挑战并提供解决方案，为企业在日本不断变化的商业环境中有效实施数字营销提供战略指导

title: Reducing Frictions while Shopping In-Store - The Effect of using a Mobile App Scan & Go Technology on Consumer Purchasing Behavior
affiliations: Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management, Universidade do Porto and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Reducing Frictions while Shopping In-Store - The Effect of using a Mobile App Scan & Go Technology on Consumer Purchasing Behavior

declarations.funderStatement: This study has been partially supported by the Dutch Research Council (NWO) via grant 406.21.EB.010.

detail.abstract: Self-service technologies (SSTs) that replace regular checkout are widely deployed in grocery retailing to reduce customer frictions and labor needs, yet their impact on consumer purchasing behavior remains unclear. We study a specific type of these SSTs: mobile app 'scan & go' technologies. Mobile app scan & go technologies may lower customer time and effort spent during a shopping trip by eliminating queuing and double handling. However, they also shift scanning effort to customers, which may change attention and shopping patterns. We explore how customers adopt mobile app scan & go technologies in practice, and study the causal effect of adoption on their purchasing behavior. We partner with a European grocery retailer that introduced a mobile app scan & go technology in their physical stores and analyze a large transactional dataset spanning more than 7 million purchases from nearly 60,000 customers. Leveraging the staggered adoption timing and matched non-adopters, we estimate the effect of adoption using difference-in-differences designs with customer and time fixed effects and modern staggered-DiD estimators. We find that adoption increases customers' monthly purchase frequency and total monthly spending, with little change in average basket value. We also find that adoption is not 'all-or-nothing': most adopters use the scan & go technology selectively for particular shopping trips, and about one-third try it once and then discontinue using it. The observed spending and frequency gains are concentrated among customers who use the technology repeatedly. These findings suggest that mobile app scan & go technologies can strengthen customer retention, but only when they reliably reduce customer friction. Retailers should promote mobile app scan & go usage for 'major' grocery trips and design onboarding and in-store support to reduce first-use learning costs - because repeated usage, not mere adoption, is what drives performance benefits.

AI.tldr: 研究移动应用"扫描即走"技术在实体零售店中的采用对消费者购买行为的影响，发现采用该技术能增加顾客的月购买频率和总支出，但效果主要来自重复使用者而非一次性尝试者。
AI.research_question: 顾客如何采用移动应用扫描即走技术？采用该技术对消费者的购买行为有什么因果影响？
AI.motivation: 自助服务技术(SSTs)在零售业广泛部署以降低顾客摩擦和人力需求，但其对消费者购买行为的影响尚不明确。移动应用扫描即走技术可能通过消除排队和重复操作来减少购物时间和精力，但也将扫描工作转移给顾客，可能改变注意力和购物模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自助服务技术(SSTs)采用理论、顾客摩擦理论、行为经济学中的注意力分配理论
AI.method: 与一家欧洲杂货零售商合作，分析超过700万笔交易、近6万名顾客的大型交易数据集。利用交错采用时间和匹配的非采用者，使用包含顾客和时间固定效应的双重差分设计以及现代交错DiD估计器来估计采用效果。
AI.findings:
1. 采用扫描即走技术增加了顾客的月购买频率和月总支出，但平均购物篮价值变化不大
2. 采用不是"全有或全无"：大多数采用者选择性地在某些购物行程中使用该技术，约三分之一尝试一次后停止使用
3. 观察到的支出和频率增长主要集中在重复使用该技术的顾客中
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了自助服务技术对消费者行为因果效应的实证证据
2. 揭示了技术采用模式的异质性（选择性使用、一次性尝试）
3. 强调了重复使用而非单纯采用才是驱动绩效收益的关键机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 零售商应针对"主要"杂货购物行程推广扫描即走技术使用
2. 需要设计更好的入门指导和店内支持以减少首次使用学习成本
3. 移动应用扫描即走技术可以增强顾客保留，但前提是能可靠地减少顾客摩擦

title: How Responsive Design Can Foster Responsible Innovation
affiliations: Center for Creative Foresight and Wolf Stake Consulting LLC

detail.title: How Responsive Design Can Foster Responsible Innovation
detail.abstract: This article explores how businesses can draw inspiration from responsive behaviors of living systems, such as self-assembly, self-cleaning, self-healing, thermoregulation, responsive motion, active coloration, and plasticity, to design products and solutions that exemplify responsible innovation. In a business environment where both customer focus and social demands are paramount concerns for companies, responsible innovation requires the creation of products and solutions that balance the incentives and interests of various internal and external stakeholders. The article highlights how living organisms provide valuable insights into fostering responsible innovation, as they are adept at maintaining a delicate equilibrium between their well-being and their impact on the environment. This equilibrium is achieved through various responsive behaviors that form the basis of "responsive design," involving emulating nature to create products with similar responsive characteristics.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨企业如何从生物系统的响应行为（如自组装、自清洁、自愈、温度调节、响应运动、主动着色和可塑性）中汲取灵感，设计体现负责任创新的产品与解决方案。
AI.research_question: 企业如何借鉴生物系统的响应行为来设计体现负责任创新的产品与解决方案？
AI.motivation: 在客户关注和社会需求都至关重要的商业环境中，负责任创新需要平衡各方利益相关者的激励与利益。生物系统擅长在自身福祉与环境影响之间保持微妙平衡，这为企业提供了有价值的启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 响应设计理论：通过模仿自然创造具有类似响应特征的产品；负责任创新理论：平衡内部和外部利益相关者的激励与利益；生物启发设计理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架：通过类比生物系统的响应行为（自组装、自清洁、自愈、温度调节、响应运动、主动着色、可塑性）来构建企业创新设计原则。
AI.findings: 生物系统通过响应行为在自身福祉与环境影响之间保持平衡，这些行为可以转化为企业创新设计原则，帮助企业实现负责任创新，平衡各方利益相关者的需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"响应设计"的概念框架，将生物系统的响应行为与负责任创新理论相结合，扩展了生物启发设计在商业创新中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了具体的生物响应行为（自组装、自清洁等）作为创新设计灵感，帮助企业在产品开发中实现负责任创新，平衡客户需求、社会期望和商业利益。

title: How Robot Adoption Impacts Stock Market Outcomes
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: How Robot Adoption Impacts Stock Market Outcomes
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of robotics, accelerated by advances in artificial intelligence, is reshaping economic activity and financial markets. This paper examines how robot adoption influences stock market outcomes, focusing on returns and volatility. We assemble a novel crosscountry dataset from the International Federation of Robotics (IFR) that disaggregates robot revenues into industrial and service components. We document a robust positive relationship between industrial robot revenue and stock market returns, consistent with automation-driven productivity gains being capitalized into equity prices. To address endogeneity concerns, we employ an instrumental-variable approach based on a Bartik-style exposure framework. Our central mechanism hypothesis posits that robots raise labor productivity, measured as output per worker, which in turn enhances market performance. In contrast, service robot revenue is associated with higher stock market volatility, reflecting increased uncertainty surrounding service-sector automation. A comprehensive set of robustness tests, including alternative panel specifications and controls for country political institutions, confirms the stability of our results. Overall, the findings highlight the heterogeneous and economically meaningful effects of robotics on global financial markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现工业机器人收入与股市回报呈正相关，而服务机器人收入则与股市波动性增加相关，表明不同类型机器人对金融市场有异质性影响。
AI.research_question: 机器人采用如何影响股票市场结果（回报和波动性）？
AI.motivation: 人工智能推动的机器人技术快速扩张正在重塑经济活动和金融市场，但机器人采用对股票市场的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化驱动的生产力提升理论；机器人通过提高劳动生产率影响市场表现的机制假设。
AI.method: 使用国际机器人联合会（IFR）的跨国数据集，将机器人收入分解为工业和服务两部分；采用基于Bartik式暴露框架的工具变量方法解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 工业机器人收入与股市回报呈稳健正相关关系，而服务机器人收入则与股市波动性增加相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了机器人对金融市场的异质性影响机制，区分了工业和服务机器人的不同经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了机器人技术对金融市场影响的实证证据，有助于理解自动化对股票市场的差异化影响。

title: Gaps and opportunities in climate adaptation planning across South American cities: a systematic analysis of local plans
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, UFZ Centre for Environmental Research and UFZ Centre for Environmental Research

detail.title: Gaps and opportunities in climate adaptation planning across South American cities: a systematic analysis of local plans
detail.abstract: Urban areas in the Global South are highly vulnerable to natural hazards, yet they are underrepresented in research monitoring climate adaptation efforts. To address this gap, we analyse 64 local adaptation plans from 37 cities with over one million inhabitants to assess how adaptation is being planned in South America and the role of nature-based solutions (NbS). Results show that plans tend to emphasise educational, informational, and behavioural measures, whereas engineering and technological approaches are least prioritised. The types of measures vary by hazard: NbS are the preferred options for adapting to floods and heatwaves, whereas engineering and technological approaches are preferred for droughts. National adaptation plans were found to play a key role in shaping local priorities, either enabling or constraining the adoption of NbS. The findings reveal key gaps in adaptation planning, particularly in relation to public health and risk-transfer measures, which are hardly considered. As such, our findings provide policymakers, planners, donors, and researchers with valuable insights for improving urban climate resilience in South America.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了南美洲37个百万人口以上城市的64个地方适应计划，发现这些计划主要强调教育、信息和行为措施，而工程和技术方法最不受重视。自然解决方案（NbS）是应对洪水和热浪的首选，而工程方法更适用于干旱。国家适应计划对地方优先事项有重要影响，研究还揭示了公共卫生和风险转移措施方面的关键差距。
AI.research_question: 南美洲城市如何规划气候适应措施？自然解决方案（NbS）在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 全球南方城市在自然危害面前高度脆弱，但在气候适应研究监测中代表性不足，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候适应规划理论、自然解决方案（NbS）理论、多层次治理理论（国家与地方适应计划的互动关系）
AI.method: 内容分析法，分析南美洲37个百万人口以上城市的64个地方适应计划文件
AI.findings: 1. 计划主要强调教育、信息和行为措施，工程和技术方法最不受重视；2. 适应措施类型因危害而异：NbS是应对洪水和热浪的首选，工程方法更适用于干旱；3. 国家适应计划对地方优先事项有重要影响，可能促进或限制NbS的采用；4. 公共卫生和风险转移措施存在显著差距
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补了全球南方城市气候适应规划的研究空白；2. 揭示了不同危害类型下适应措施的差异化选择模式；3. 阐明了国家与地方适应计划之间的多层次治理关系；4. 深化了对NbS在城市气候适应中作用的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者、规划者、捐助者和研究人员提供改进南美洲城市气候韧性的见解；2. 识别了适应规划中的关键差距，特别是公共卫生和风险转移措施；3. 提供了NbS在不同危害情境下的应用指导；4. 强调了国家计划对地方适应策略的影响机制

title: Peer Reviews and Within-Category Consumer Response
affiliations: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business, BEM Bordeaux Management School, KEDGE Business School, Cornell University - Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management and Cornell University

detail.title: Peer Reviews and Within-Category Consumer Response

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All research activities were reviewed by Cornell University Institutional Review Board for Human Participants (IRB) and have been approved and granted exemption.
declarations.funderStatement: The project was supported, in part, through USDA Hatch project NYC-121864. Any opinions, findings, conclusions, or recommendations expressed in this publication are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the view of the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This research examines the role of peer reviews on consumer demand for a set of competing products within a well-defined category. We developed and distributed a survey to collect data on consumers' willingness to pay (WTP) for sparkling wines from France, Spain, and the United States under different information treatments. Our results suggest that there is a strong negativity bias associated with peer reviews-that is, a relatively weak peer review consistently leads to lower WTP for the wine receiving the score and higher WTP for the other wines. We do find evidence that consumers increase WTP for a relatively strong peer review for the domestic wine only; this finding is linked to more engaged consumers rather than to consumers that are geographically close to where the wine is produced.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨同行评论对消费者需求的负面影响偏见：较差的同行评分会降低该产品的支付意愿，同时提高其他产品的支付意愿；只有国内产品的正面评分能提升支付意愿，且与消费者参与度而非地理距离相关。
AI.research_question: 同行评论如何影响消费者对竞争产品的支付意愿？是否存在负面偏见？正面评论是否对国内产品有特殊影响？
AI.motivation: 理解同行评论在消费者决策中的作用，特别是在竞争产品类别中，同行评分如何影响消费者对不同国家产品的偏好和支付意愿。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负面偏见理论（negativity bias）、消费者行为理论、国内产品偏好理论、同行评论影响力理论
AI.method: 通过问卷调查收集数据，测量消费者对法国、西班牙和美国起泡酒在不同信息处理下的支付意愿（WTP），采用实验设计比较不同同行评分的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 存在强烈的负面偏见：较差的同行评分会显著降低该产品的支付意愿，同时提高其他产品的支付意愿；2. 正面评论仅对国内产品（美国酒）有效提升支付意愿；3. 这种国内产品效应与消费者参与度相关，而非地理距离。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了同行评论中的负面偏见效应；2. 揭示了国内产品正面评论的特殊作用机制；3. 区分了消费者参与度和地理距离在影响效应中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为营销人员提供同行评论管理策略；2. 帮助国际品牌理解消费者对国内产品的特殊偏好；3. 为产品定位和定价策略提供实证依据。

title: Meteorait for Teens: An Operational Framework for Cognitive Sovereignty in the Age of Generative AI
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Meteorait for Teens: An Operational Framework for Cognitive Sovereignty in the Age of Generative AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research is an independent initiative, developed as part of the 'Cognitive Divergence Theory' corpus, and is not affiliated with, commissioned by, or funded by any artificial intelligence laboratory, corporate entity, or governmental institution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper presents a theoretical framework and educational methodology. It did not involve experimental research on human subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of sensitive personal data requiring Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval. The protocols described are guidelines intended for voluntary application by parents and educators.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was entirely self-funded by the author as a contribution to the public discourse on cognitive safety and AI governance (MEG Initiative).

detail.abstract:
This document represents the applied methodology of the "Cognitive Divergence Theory" (CDT) corpus, specifically targeted at Generation Z and Alpha demographics. Building upon the theoretical foundations established in "The Age of Cognitive Divergence" and "The Psychological Ceiling of AI Adoption", this work provides a practical protocol for mitigating False Cognitive Power Transfer (FCPT) in educational and developmental environments.

The paper functions as a "Field Manual" for cognitive resilience, translating complex systemic risks—such as cognitive atrophy and the L1 (Passenger) vs. L3 (Architect) stratification—into actionable behavioral protocols. It introduces specific mechanisms like "Controlled Latency," "The 5-Minute Wall," and "Reverse Engineering" designed to preserve human executive function amidst increasing automation.

While presented in an accessible format for younger audiences, the underlying structure serves as a blueprint for "Minimal Ethical Governance" (MEG) applied at the individual level. It challenges the prevailing "AI Literacy" narrative (which focuses on tool proficiency) and proposes "Cognitive Sovereignty" (maintaining the chain of custody over decision-making) as the primary educational objective for the post-2025 era.

Note to readers: This is the operational handbook intended for direct application. For the theoretical and mathematical proofs supporting these protocols, please refer to the author's previous papers in the CDT series.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了针对Z世代和Alpha世代的"认知分歧理论"应用方法论，提供减轻教育和发展环境中虚假认知权力转移的实用协议，作为认知韧性的"实地手册"。
AI.research_question: 如何在实际教育和发展环境中减轻虚假认知权力转移，并维护人类执行功能？
AI.motivation: 随着自动化程度提高，存在认知萎缩和L1（乘客）与L3（架构师）分层等系统性风险，需要保护年轻一代的认知主权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知分歧理论（CDT）、虚假认知权力转移（FCPT）、最小伦理治理（MEG）、认知主权概念。
AI.method: 提供实用协议和行为指南，包括"受控延迟"、"5分钟墙"和"逆向工程"等具体机制，作为可直接应用的实地手册。
AI.findings: 开发了可操作的认知韧性协议，挑战了以工具熟练度为中心的"AI素养"叙事，提出"认知主权"作为后2025时代的主要教育目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知分歧理论转化为实用框架，提出认知主权概念，建立最小伦理治理在个人层面的应用蓝图。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者和年轻一代提供可直接应用的认知韧性工具，帮助维护决策过程的控制权，防止认知萎缩。

title: Working from Home and Labour Productivity: Firm-Level Evidence
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Working from Home and Labour Productivity: Firm-Level Evidence

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Temi di Discussione (Working Paper) No. 1508
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of working from home (WFH) on firm-level outcomes. It uses detailed survey, balance sheet and matched employer-employee data on Italian firms from before the pandemic and up to 2023. Estimates using a novel instrumental variable suggest that, on average, the effects on labour productivity, employment dynamics and composition, wages and other costs are negligible. However, the analysis shows that results are heterogeneous across firms. For some firms, whose labour productivity did not decline, the pandemic-induced shift to WFH was maintained after the emergency ended.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用意大利企业疫情前后的详细数据，分析了远程办公对企业层面结果的影响。研究发现，平均而言，远程办公对劳动生产率、就业动态、工资和其他成本的影响微乎其微，但不同企业之间存在显著异质性。一些劳动生产率未下降的企业在疫情结束后仍维持了远程办公模式。
AI.research_question: 远程办公对企业层面结果（包括劳动生产率、就业动态、工资和其他成本）有何影响？这种影响在不同企业之间是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情导致远程办公大规模普及，但关于远程办公对企业层面经济结果的影响缺乏系统性实证证据。了解远程办公对企业生产率、就业和成本的实际影响，对于制定后疫情时代的工作安排政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动经济学和生产理论，研究远程办公对企业效率的影响机制。考虑远程办公可能通过减少通勤时间、提高工作灵活性来提升生产率，但也可能因监督困难和协作问题而降低效率。
AI.method: 使用意大利企业疫情前后的详细调查数据、资产负债表数据和匹配的雇主-雇员数据。采用新颖的工具变量方法进行估计，以解决内生性问题。数据时间跨度从疫情前到2023年。
AI.findings: 平均而言，远程办公对劳动生产率、就业动态、工资和其他成本的影响可以忽略不计。但结果存在显著异质性：一些劳动生产率未下降的企业在疫情结束后仍维持远程办公模式，而其他企业则可能因生产率下降而放弃远程办公。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了远程办公对企业层面结果影响的系统性实证证据，揭示了平均效应与异质性效应之间的差异。为理解远程办公在不同企业环境下的适应性提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了决策依据：远程办公并非对所有企业都适用，需要根据企业特定情况评估其影响。为政策制定者提供了关于远程办公政策差异化的实证支持。

title:
A Machine Learning Framework to Explain Variance and Forecast Performance in Google Search Ads 
Driver Attribution for Wins and Cost Per Win (CPW) Using Random Forest (R²) and Gradient Boosting (MAPE)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
A Machine Learning Framework to Explain Variance and Forecast Performance in Google Search Ads 
Driver Attribution for Wins and Cost Per Win (CPW) Using Random Forest (R²) and Gradient Boosting (MAPE)
detail.abstract: DAT Freight & Analytics operates one of the largest freight marketplaces in North America, connecting carriers with available loads through its load board subscription SaaS platform. Carriers typically purchase access through a self-serve, self-sign-up process on the DAT website, making Google Search Ads a primary demand-capture channel. Within this measurement framework, a completed carrier subscription checkout is recorded as a Win, and the advertising cost required to generate one completed checkout is defined as Cost Per Win (CPW). This acquisition motion resembles an eCommerce-style funnel: prospects discover DAT through high-intent search queries, evaluate the offering quickly, and convert through an online checkout or subscription workflow with minimal sales involvement. Google Search Ads performance in this environment is influenced by demand shifts in freight markets, auction competition, keyword intent mix, ad relevance, and bidding constraints. While dashboards describe what happened, they often fail to quantify why performance moved and how reliably the next period can be predicted. This paper introduces a practical two-stage machine learning framework designed specifically for Google Search Ads reporting data supporting DAT's carrier subscription growth. The framework combines: 1. Variance explanation using Random Forest feature importance with interpretability measured by R² 2. Strategic forecasting using Gradient Boosting time-series regression with accuracy measured by MAPE Using daily campaign performance metrics aggregated into monthly outcomes, this approach explains the key drivers of Wins and Cost Per Win (CPW) and produces a forward-looking forecast for quarterly planning. Outcomes from the attached results indicate strong explanatory power for Wins (R² = 0.94) and CPW (R² = 0.87), alongside strong forecasting accuracy validated on unseen test periods (Test MAPE ≈ 9.6% for Wins and ≈ 10.7% for CPW). The methodology demonstrates how Search teams can convert historical auction signals into actionable, repeatable optimization guidance that improves both volume predictability and cost efficiency for subscription acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文针对DAT货运分析公司的谷歌搜索广告效果分析问题，提出了一个两阶段机器学习框架，结合随机森林特征重要性解释方差和梯度提升时间序列回归进行战略预测，有效解释了订阅赢单和成本驱动因素，并实现了高精度的季度预测。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习框架解释谷歌搜索广告中订阅赢单（Wins）和每赢单成本（CPW）的关键驱动因素，并实现可靠的季度预测？
AI.motivation: DAT货运分析公司通过谷歌搜索广告获取货运承运商订阅，但传统仪表板只能描述发生了什么，无法量化性能变化的原因和预测未来表现。需要一种系统方法来解释广告效果波动并提供可靠的预测指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习的时间序列分析和特征重要性理论，结合随机森林和梯度提升算法，构建广告效果解释和预测框架。
AI.method: 两阶段机器学习框架：1) 使用随机森林特征重要性解释方差，以R²衡量解释力；2) 使用梯度提升时间序列回归进行战略预测，以MAPE衡量准确性。基于每日广告活动性能指标聚合为月度结果。
AI.findings: 框架对订阅赢单（Wins）的解释力R²=0.94，对每赢单成本（CPW）的解释力R²=0.87。在未见测试集上，赢单预测MAPE≈9.6%，CPW预测MAPE≈10.7%，显示出强大的解释和预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专门针对谷歌搜索广告报告数据的机器学习分析框架，将历史拍卖信号转化为可操作的优化指导，为订阅获取的广告效果分析提供了系统方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DAT的搜索团队提供了可重复的优化指导，改善了订阅获取的预测性和成本效率。框架可帮助团队理解广告效果驱动因素，进行更准确的季度规划，提升广告投资回报率。

title: How Small Businesses are Growing Online?

detail.title: How Small Businesses are Growing Online?
detail.abstract: In the past, small businesses struggled because few people were aware of them. Most shops got customers only when people talked about them or visited them in person. Life was not digital then. There was no social media, no online search, and no easy way to show products. People had to visit stores for everything they needed. But today, things have changed. Almost everything happens online now. This significant change has opened new doors for small businesses, enabling them to reach a wider audience than ever before. With the rise of online platforms, even the smallest business can reach people far beyond its local area. This is where real small business online growth started to take shape. Social media, websites, digital payments, and simple online tools now enable small businesses to reach their target audience with less money. Today, most customers prefer to check options online before visiting any place. This shift has pushed many brands to enter a new phase of digital transformation for small businesses. Owners who use technology, content, and basic online strategies are growing faster. Key Factors Helping Small Businesses Growth Today, small businesses have more opportunities than ever to expand their online presence. Technology and digital tools have made it easier to reach customers, manage operations, and build a brand. Let's take a closer look at the key factors that are helping small businesses succeed in the online world:

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了数字化转型如何帮助小企业克服传统的地理限制，通过社交媒体、网站、数字支付等在线工具实现更广泛的客户触达和业务增长。

AI.motivation: 传统小企业面临地理限制和客户触达困难，而数字技术的普及为小企业提供了前所未有的增长机会，需要研究如何有效利用这些数字工具。

AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，可能包括案例研究或实证分析
AI.findings: 数字技术（社交媒体、网站、数字支付等）显著降低了小企业的市场进入壁垒，使它们能够以较低成本接触更广泛的客户群体，实现业务增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了小企业数字化转型的理论框架，明确了数字技术在小企业成长中的关键作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小企业主提供了具体的数字工具使用策略，帮助他们有效利用在线平台实现业务增长和客户拓展。

detail.title: How Designing with Disability in Mind Sparks Innovation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Govindarajan, V., Seto, K., Eapen, T. T., & Moorman, C. (2026). How Designing with Disability in Mind Sparks Innovation. Harvard Business Review. https://hbr.org/2026/02/how-designing-with-disability-in-mind-sparks-innovation

detail.abstract: Design amplification is a process whereby innovations originally created for users with disabilities are expanded to unlock universal market value. Drawing on an in-depth study of LIXIL and over 150 archival examples, this Harvard Business Review article identifies four levels of amplification: marginalized users, other marginalized groups, situational users, and mainstream consumers. The authors present a five-step Design Amplification Playbook: (1) selecting a focal disability, (2) mapping the user journey, (3) identifying cross-segment benefits, (4) designing for scalability, and (5) validating across all segments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"设计放大"的概念，即最初为残障用户设计的创新产品可以扩展到主流市场创造普遍价值。通过LIXIL案例研究和150多个档案案例，识别了四个放大层级，并提出了五步设计放大操作手册。
AI.research_question: 企业如何将最初为残障用户设计的创新产品扩展到主流市场，创造普遍商业价值？
AI.motivation: 许多为残障用户设计的创新产品具有更广泛的市场潜力，但企业往往未能有效识别和利用这些机会。研究旨在帮助企业系统性地将包容性设计转化为商业成功。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计放大理论、包容性设计、市场扩展理论、用户旅程映射、跨细分市场价值识别
AI.method: 深度案例研究（LIXIL公司）+ 150多个档案案例分析
AI.findings: 识别了设计放大的四个层级：1)边缘化用户（残障人士），2)其他边缘化群体，3)情境用户（暂时受限者），4)主流消费者。提出了五步设计放大操作手册。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"设计放大"的系统理论框架，明确了从残障设计到主流市场的扩展路径和机制，丰富了包容性设计和市场扩展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的五步设计放大操作手册：1)选择焦点残障类型，2)映射用户旅程，3)识别跨细分市场利益，4)设计可扩展性，5)验证所有细分市场。

detail.abstract: Over the past two decades, marketing automation has evolved from simple tools for campaign management into a sophisticated ecosystem powered by AI, big data, and predictive analytics. This transformation enables firms to manage omnichannel campaigns, personalize content at scale, and optimize decision-making in real time, shifting marketing from intuition-based practices to data-driven strategies. Beyond operational efficiency, marketing automation acts as a strategic resource that reshapes customer relationships, competitive dynamics, and organizational performance. Its implementation requires significant organizational changes, including crossfunctional collaboration, new capabilities in data literacy and algorithmic thinking, and the emergence of hybrid roles that integrate marketing and technology expertise. Human implications are equally profound, as routine tasks become automated and marketers assume roles emphasizing creativity, strategy, and ethical judgment, raising concerns about skill displacement and workforce polarization. Additionally, marketing automation introduces ethical, social, and governance challenges, including data privacy, algorithmic bias, and accountability. Firms must balance innovation with transparency, trust, and responsible use of AI to maintain customer confidence. This study highlights the multidimensional impact of marketing automation, emphasizing the need for integrated research that considers strategic, organizational, human, and ethical perspectives in shaping its future trajectory.

title: LLM Adoption and Legacy Translators in Korea: Evidence on Engagement, Exploration, and Reallocation
affiliations: Korea Information Society Development Institute (KISDI) and

detail.title: LLM Adoption and Legacy Translators in Korea: Evidence on Engagement, Exploration, and Reallocation
detail.abstract: This study examines how adoption of a large language model (LLM) reshapes usage of incumbent online translation services in an Asian market. Using weekly app and web usage logs from Korea, this study quantifies how the adoption of ChatGPT changes legacy-translator engagement, brand exploration, and within-portfolio reallocation. First, legacy engagement increases after adoption and remains statistically detectable for roughly 15 to 17 weeks, then attenuates and is at times indistinguishable from zero thereafter. Second, brand diversity widens only at onboarding, consistent with short-run exploration rather than durable multihoming. Third, reallocation is brand specific: prior Google users shift time away from Google, prior Bing users diversify into Papago while maintaining Bing, and prior Papago users further concentrate on Papago. Heterogeneity analyses show larger adjustments for earlier adopters and for users with lower pre-adoption intensity. The contribution is to distinguish ecosystem level effects within legacy translators from total translation time effects, to map the short-lived exploration window, and to document brand specific redistribution rather than broad expansion. The findings inform platform strategy and policy by clarifying how LLM adoption rewires incumbent digital utilities in a leading Asian market.

AI.tldr: 研究韩国市场大型语言模型（ChatGPT）采用如何重塑现有在线翻译服务使用模式，发现采用后传统翻译服务使用量短暂增加，品牌探索期短暂，且存在品牌特定的用户重新分配模式。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLM）的采用如何重塑现有在线翻译服务的使用模式？具体如何影响传统翻译服务的参与度、品牌探索和用户组合内重新分配？
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）的普及，需要理解这些新技术如何影响现有数字工具（如在线翻译服务）的使用模式，特别是在亚洲市场，这对平台战略和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、数字生态系统演化理论、用户行为模式理论（包括探索行为、品牌忠诚度、多归属行为等）
AI.method: 使用韩国市场的每周应用和网页使用日志数据，量化分析ChatGPT采用对传统翻译服务使用的影响，包括统计检测、异质性分析等方法。
AI.findings: 1. 传统翻译服务使用量在采用ChatGPT后增加，持续约15-17周后减弱；2. 品牌多样性仅在初始采用期扩大，表明短期探索而非长期多归属；3. 重新分配具有品牌特异性：谷歌用户减少谷歌使用，必应用户增加Papago使用但保留必应，Papago用户更集中于Papago；4. 早期采用者和低使用强度用户调整更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了生态系统层面效应与总翻译时间效应；2. 描绘了短暂探索窗口期；3. 记录了品牌特异性重新分配而非广泛扩张模式；4. 为技术采纳如何重塑现有数字工具使用提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台战略提供参考：理解LLM采纳如何重新连接现有数字工具；2. 为政策制定提供依据：在亚洲领先市场中数字生态系统演化规律；3. 帮助翻译服务提供商制定应对策略；4. 为技术采纳影响研究提供市场特定洞察。

title: Intent vs. Practice: A Comparative Study of Sustainable Electronics Perception and Behavior Using Survey and Online Review Data
affiliations: Purdue University, Purdue University, Purdue University and Purdue University

detail.title: Intent vs. Practice: A Comparative Study of Sustainable Electronics Perception and Behavior Using Survey and Online Review Data
detail.abstract: The intention–behavior gap in sustainable consumption is especially visible in the electronics sector, where consumers frequently express strong environmental values that do not translate into purchasing decisions. This study examined that gap by combining survey-based perceptions (n=64) with large-scale analysis of 138,488 Amazon reviews containing sustainability-related content. Survey participants prioritized convenient return options, recyclability, and the use of sustainable materials, and reported a willingness to adopt eco-friendly practices when these options were easy to access. By contrast, online reviews focused primarily on affordability, convenience, and product functionality; sustainability was mentioned only when it affected quality or usability. Welch’s t-test and Mann–Whitney U-test confirmed significant differences between self-reported survey responses and consumer-generated reviews, and topic modeling showed that trust and transparency concerns were salient in surveys but largely absent from reviews. Together, these findings indicated that physical, informational, and psychological frictions prevent sustainable intentions from becoming routine behavior. Closing this gap requires embedding sustainability into core decision factors — affordability, reliability, and usability — so that eco-friendly choices become the default rather than an extra effort.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过结合问卷调查和大规模亚马逊评论分析，揭示了可持续消费中的意图-行为差距。调查显示消费者重视可持续性，但实际购买决策中更关注价格、便利性和功能性，表明物理、信息和心理摩擦阻碍了可持续意图转化为日常行为。
AI.research_question: 为什么消费者在电子产品领域的可持续消费意图与实际购买行为之间存在差距？
AI.motivation: 电子产品领域存在明显的可持续消费意图-行为差距，消费者经常表达强烈的环境价值观，但这些价值观并未转化为实际的购买决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意图-行为差距理论，可持续消费理论，消费者决策理论
AI.method: 混合方法：1）基于64名参与者的问卷调查；2）对138,488条包含可持续性相关内容的亚马逊评论进行大规模分析；3）使用Welch's t检验和Mann-Whitney U检验比较调查结果与评论数据；4）主题建模分析
AI.findings: 1）调查参与者优先考虑便捷退货选项、可回收性和可持续材料使用，并表示愿意采用环保实践；2）在线评论主要关注价格、便利性和产品功能，可持续性仅在影响质量或可用性时才被提及；3）统计检验证实调查响应与消费者生成评论存在显著差异；4）主题建模显示信任和透明度问题在调查中突出，但在评论中基本缺失
AI.theory_contributions: 1）实证验证了电子产品领域的可持续消费意图-行为差距；2）识别了物理、信息和心理摩擦作为阻碍因素；3）揭示了消费者自我报告与实际行为之间的系统性差异
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业和政策制定者提供了缩小意图-行为差距的策略；2）建议将可持续性嵌入核心决策因素（价格、可靠性、可用性）；3）使环保选择成为默认选项而非额外努力

detail.title:
The Case Study of Digitalcfo : Digital Transformation Crucially Needing Adaptation by Accurately Combining Change Management and Technology :

detail.abstract:
In the contemporary technological advent , the digital eco system is well included thereby endorsing the crucial role of digitization plays in the Indian MSME sector specifically on the digitization of financial documents. Digitization in the MSME sector is further enhanced by the advent of the ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce) that has increased the number of transactions in the Indian e-Commerce sector multi-fold thereby massively increasing the amount of transactional data/ financial data thus requiring efficient systems of digital knowledge management that uses the principle of knowledge management i.e. to provide the right information to the right person at the right time which in this case is the financial information of the concerned MSME sector to the financial professionals when required. This is further enhanced by Industry 4.0 and IoT and enhanced technology access, the MSME sector in India has practically evolved into a new “realm of digitization and technology with practically everything becoming digital. All information from physical form is being transformed to digital for through the process of digitization thereby making all documents containing information present in the digital form only. Information Systems form the backbone of delivery for digitization, IoT and Industry 4.0  need to be adapted accurately. This adaptation requires integration of KMS (Knowledge Management Systems) included in the optimum strategy for Information Systems adaptation that is formulated by accurately combining change management and technology.

Analysis
This internal adaptation of Information Systems is for the external sustainability of
the digitization platform in this case the SaaS platform of DigitalCFO for which
Information Systems form the backbone of delivery. This is to be done using the new
method of Information Systems adaptation the CPA i.e. the Co-efficient of
Progressive Adaptation that has demonstrated significant results in the adaptation of
this mentioned SaaS platform of DigitalCFO as endorsed by results of adapting the
information Systems using robotics and automation resulting in significant efficiency
of the SaaS platform in in the processes of accounts, finance management , reporting,
analytics and book keeping with maximum efficiency , sustainability together leading
to the competitive advantage.
Learning objectives: For Sustainability management , the importance of accurately
combining change management and technology to formulate the optimum adaptation
strategy.
Functional area: Sustainability Management in terms of the digitization of
financial MSME documents in this digital ecosystem part of the contemporary
technological advent by adaptation of Information Technology.

AI.theoretical_framework: 知识管理理论（在正确时间向正确人员提供正确信息）、变革管理理论、信息系统适应理论、CPA（渐进适应系数）方法、可持续发展管理理论。

AI.findings: CPA方法在DigitalCFO SaaS平台的信息系统适应中显示出显著效果，通过机器人和自动化实现了平台在会计、财务管理、报告、分析和簿记等流程中的高效运行，提升了平台的效率、可持续性和竞争优势。

title: Psychological Self-Regulation and Consistency in Instagram Entrepreneurial Branding
affiliations: Independent Researcher and

detail.title: Psychological Self-Regulation and Consistency in Instagram Entrepreneurial Branding
detail.abstract: In the context of digital entrepreneurship, Instagram has become a primary platform through which entrepreneurs construct and maintain personal brands. Sustaining consistent branding over time, however, requires more than strategic planning; it demands psychological self-regulation in the face of cognitive, emotional, and social pressures. This paper examines the role of psychological self-regulation in shaping consistency within Instagram-based entrepreneurial branding. Drawing on self-regulation theory, self-determination theory, and digital self-presentation research, the study conceptualizes branding consistency as an outcome of entrepreneurs' ability to manage motivation, emotions, and identity alignment. The analysis explores how self-regulatory capacities influence content coherence, engagement patterns, and long-term brand credibility. By integrating psychological perspectives with digital branding literature, this paper advances understanding of the internal mechanisms that enable entrepreneurs to sustain authentic and consistent brand identities on Instagram, despite platform volatility and performance pressure.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了数字创业者在Instagram平台上如何通过心理自我调节来维持品牌一致性，整合了自我调节理论、自我决定理论和数字自我呈现研究，揭示了创业者管理动机、情绪和身份对齐的内在机制。
AI.research_question: 心理自我调节如何影响Instagram创业者的品牌一致性？
AI.motivation: Instagram已成为创业者构建个人品牌的主要平台，但维持长期品牌一致性不仅需要战略规划，还需要面对认知、情感和社会压力时的心理自我调节能力。

AI.practical_contributions: 为数字创业者提供了在平台波动和绩效压力下维持品牌一致性的心理调节策略，帮助他们在Instagram上建立更可信的品牌身份

title: CATBridge: Enhancing CVE-ATT&CK Alignment Capability in Low-Resource Environments using Professional Knowledge from LLMs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: CATBridge: Enhancing CVE-ATT&CK Alignment Capability in Low-Resource Environments using Professional Knowledge from LLMs

keywords: and Common Knowledge (ATT&CK)Knowledge-DrivenLarge Language Model(LLM)Knowledge Distillation

detail.abstract: Aligning Common Vulnerability Exposures(CVE) with ATT&CK is a crucial step in achieving active defense. Existing machine learning and deep learning-based methods have received attention due to their high detection accuracy and strong generalization capabilities, but they struggle to effectively capture the deep semantic associations between CVE and ATT&CK. Large language models(LLMs), with their ability to understand complex contexts, are poised to become the mainstream approach for CVE-ATT&CK alignment. However, in low-resource environments with limited computational resources and scarce labeled samples, although prompt-based methods can enable large-scale LLMs (such as GPT) to exhibit excellent performance, their high computational costs and low inference efficiency severely limit their practical application potential in CVE-ATT&CK alignment tasks. In contrast, under the same constrained conditions, small-scale LLMs (such as Qwen-2.5-7B), although they can adapt to specific tasks through fine-tuning and offer better practicality, are limited by insufficient understanding of professional knowledge, making it difficult to comprehensively grasp complex attack behavior patterns. To address this, this paper proposes a multi-stage knowledge enhancement framework called CATBridge, whose core lies in constructing a "teacher-student" large-small model collaboration mechanism, through three progressive stages of targeted data enhancement, domain knowledge enhancement, and reasoning knowledge enhancement, to gradually guide lightweight LLMs to complete CVE-ATT&CK alignment tasks. Experimental results show that the framework performs well in low-resource environments, with the deployed lightweight LLM (7B) achieving an accuracy of 83.55%, a 33.29% improvement over SOTA, and an average improvement of 46.24% compared to large-scale general-purpose LLMs such as GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1 (671B), and Qwen3 (235B).

AI.tldr: 本文提出CATBridge框架，通过"师生"大-小模型协作机制，在低资源环境下实现CVE与ATT&CK的高效对齐，使轻量级LLM(7B)准确率达到83.55%，相比SOTA提升33.29%
AI.research_question: 如何在低资源环境下（有限计算资源和标注样本）有效对齐CVE与ATT&CK，克服现有方法在语义关联捕捉和实际应用方面的局限性？
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法难以捕捉CVE与ATT&CK的深层语义关联，而大语言模型在低资源环境下存在计算成本高或专业理解不足的问题，需要一种实用高效的解决方案
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"师生"大-小模型协作机制的多阶段知识增强框架，包含针对性数据增强、领域知识增强和推理知识增强三个渐进阶段
AI.method: 提出CATBridge框架，通过构建教师-学生模型协作机制，分三个阶段逐步引导轻量级LLM完成CVE-ATT&CK对齐任务，并在低资源环境下进行实验验证
AI.findings: 部署的轻量级LLM(7B)准确率达到83.55%，相比SOTA提升33.29%，相比GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1(671B)、Qwen3(235B)等大规模通用LLM平均提升46.24%
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多阶段知识增强的理论框架，建立了"师生"大-小模型协作机制，为低资源环境下的专业领域任务提供了新的理论指导
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的CATBridge框架，在低资源环境下实现了高效准确的CVE-ATT&CK对齐，为网络安全主动防御提供了可行的技术方案

title: Structural Power Index: Quantifying Innovation Velocity and Engineering Stability as Leading Indicators of Alpha and Drawdown Resilience
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Structural Power Index: Quantifying Innovation Velocity and Engineering Stability as Leading Indicators of Alpha and Drawdown Resilience
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Structural Power Index (Ps) as a novel framework for analysing enterprise technology companies to identify leading indicators of hidden alpha and proactively mitigate drawdown risk. The Ps framework seeks to offer a structural corrective to lagging financial data that is typically used in traditional equity valuation models. We will demonstrate how the Ps Index offers a robust alternative method to identify hidden value and proactively mitigate drawdown risk. 

The proprietary Ps methodology synthesises three primary metrics: Innovation Velocity (V), the speed of engineering output; Engineering Stability, the ratio of potential revenue-generating work to maintenance work; and Entropy Gap (1-H), the measure of the strategic focus of the engineering efforts. By weighting the velocity of innovative output against the management of technical entropy, we identify a predictive metric for stock performance that consistently precedes financial reporting cycles. 

Through a longitudinal study of 10 enterprise technology firms spanning 2018-2025, we demonstrate that Ps successfully functions as a high-conviction signal which translates into real-world returns. Over the eight-year duration of the study, a portfolio weighted by the Ps Index delivered a cumulative outperformance of 1,405 basis points compared to the benchmark. We also detail how a Ps-tilted portfolio achieves a 51 basis point Sharpe Ratio efficiency gain compared to the benchmark. 

In addition to identifying hidden alpha earlier than traditional equity valuation models, the Structural Power Index also acts an effective risk-mitigation tool. This is evidenced during critical downturn years where the Ps-tilted portfolio experienced a lower drawdown than the benchmark. 

Our findings suggest that technical entropy is a terminal leading indicator of impending valuation decay, while Structural Power is a prerequisite for sustainable alpha. By shifting the analytical lens to underlying engineering metrics, investors can consistently identify fragile value traps and capture resilient growth before it is fully priced by the market.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构权力指数(Ps)作为分析企业技术公司的新框架，用于识别隐藏阿尔法的领先指标并主动降低回撤风险。该框架通过创新速度、工程稳定性和熵差三个指标，提供比传统财务数据更早的预测信号，实证显示Ps加权组合在8年间跑赢基准1405个基点，夏普比率提升51个基点。
AI.research_question: 如何通过工程和技术指标（而非传统财务数据）来识别企业技术公司的隐藏阿尔法并主动管理回撤风险？
AI.motivation: 传统股权估值模型依赖滞后的财务数据，无法及时识别技术公司的真实价值和技术风险。需要一种基于工程指标的结构性框架来更早发现价值并降低投资风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构权力指数(Ps)框架，包含三个核心指标：创新速度(V)、工程稳定性（创收工作与维护工作比率）、熵差(1-H)。该框架基于技术熵理论，认为技术熵是估值衰减的终端领先指标。
AI.method: 对10家企业在2018-2025年进行纵向研究，构建Ps加权投资组合并与基准比较，分析累计超额收益、夏普比率改善和回撤控制效果。
AI.findings: Ps加权组合在8年间累计跑赢基准1405个基点，夏普比率提升51个基点，在下跌年份回撤更小。技术熵是估值衰减的领先指标，结构权力是可持续阿尔法的前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于工程指标的结构权力指数框架；2) 建立技术熵与估值衰减的理论联系；3) 证明工程指标可作为财务表现的领先预测指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供识别隐藏阿尔法的早期工具；2) 帮助规避价值陷阱；3) 提供有效的风险缓释方法；4) 在传统财务周期前获得投资信号。

title: The impact of dynamic asymmetric activity on the evolution of cooperation
affiliations: Guizhou University of Finance and Economics, Guizhou University of Finance and Economics, Guizhou University of Finance and Economics, Tianjin University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The impact of dynamic asymmetric activity on the evolution of cooperation

keywords.keywords: Evolution of cooperation；Dynamic asymmetric； Aspiration； Strategy stickiness

detail.abstract: To characterize the evolution of cooperation in real-world scenarios, this paper develops an evolutionary game model with dynamic asymmetric activity. In the model, individuals are classified into leaders and followers according to the comparison between their strategy persistence 𝜀𝑥 and the threshold 𝛽, and each individual’s node (influence) weight 𝑤𝑥 is adjusted adaptively based on whether the realized payoff meets the individual aspiration level 𝐴𝑥 . Importantly, leaders are allowed to incorporate their node (influence) weights 𝑤𝑥 into fitness evaluation, whereas followers rely solely on payoffs, which induces a role-dependent and dynamically evolving asymmetry in effective competitiveness. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that this mechanism substantially promotes cooperation and mitigates spatial social dilemmas. Micro-level analyses further reveal that cooperation enhancement requires the coordinated emergence of leader cooperators and follower cooperators, which together suppress the spread of defection. Moreover, the statistical results indicate that the facilitating effect of cooperation is not strictly positively correlated with the heterogeneity of node-weight. At last, robustness tests across different dilemma types, network topologies, and strategy update schemes confirm that the main findings remain qualitatively unchanged, demonstrating the generality of the proposed mechanism. These results provide a  parsimonious framework for understanding how dynamic asymmetry can reshape evolutionary pathways  toward cooperative behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个具有动态不对称活动的演化博弈模型，通过领导者-追随者分类和自适应节点权重调整，显著促进了合作行为并缓解了空间社会困境。
AI.research_question: 动态不对称活动如何影响现实场景中合作行为的演化？
AI.motivation: 为了刻画现实世界中合作行为的演化特征，需要建立能够反映个体动态不对称影响的模型，以理解合作如何在社会困境中维持和发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈理论、社会网络理论、领导者-追随者动态、自适应权重调整机制
AI.method: 开发演化博弈模型，将个体分为领导者和追随者（基于策略持久性εx与阈值β的比较），自适应调整节点权重wx（基于收益与期望水平Ax的比较），并进行广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟和微观分析。
AI.findings: 1. 该机制显著促进合作并缓解空间社会困境；2. 合作增强需要领导者合作者和追随者合作者的协同出现；3. 合作促进效果与节点权重的异质性并非严格正相关；4. 主要发现在不同困境类型、网络拓扑和策略更新方案中保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个动态不对称活动的演化博弈框架，揭示了领导者-追随者角色依赖的竞争不对称性如何重塑合作演化路径，为理解现实世界合作行为提供了简约的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计促进合作的社会机制提供了理论指导，特别是在需要协调领导者和追随者行为的组织和社会系统中，有助于缓解社会困境并促进集体利益。
